text.en: You've got this, Endministrator!

text.cn: 也就是说，你是从研究所里面逃出来的。
text.en: So, you escaped from the Research Center.

text.cn: 对，应该是和你那边的采石场同时出事的。
text.en: Yeah. Disaster struck us and your Quarry simultaneously.

text.cn: 谁能想到呢？采石场和研究所同时陷入险境，最安全的地方反而是两者之间的大路……
text.en: The Quarry and RC are both blighted. Only the road is safe.

text.cn: 侵蚀爆发的时候，我正好在一个看得到研究所后方的窗口附近。
text.en: I was in the RC during the Blight rupture.

text.cn: 侵蚀爆发是什么样的？
text.en: What does a Blight Rupture look like?

text.cn: 首先是许多色彩斑斓的异光，我很难给出更具体的形容……
text.en: It's beyond words, but it starts with a burst of light.

text.cn: 然后是侵蚀能量潮，它就像岩浆流一样直接融穿了地表，制造了一条新的山谷。
text.en: Next, Blight energy flow that melts a new ravine.

text.cn: 侵蚀留下的痕迹很耀眼，看着眼睛生痛。
text.en: Those Blight scars are too bright. Hurts to even look at it.

text.cn: 我害怕会有下一道侵蚀毁掉研究所，就立刻下楼往外逃。
text.en: Another Blight would've destroyed the RC. Ran for my life.

text.cn: 你反应够快，所以现在才能在这里……其他人都被封在了里面。
text.en: You got here 'cos you're fast. The others are still trapped.

text.cn: 采石场一定是发生了什么事故吧？
text.en: Something happened at the Quarry, right?

text.cn: 没有，至少我没看到有，整个场地都听到了警报广播，但我没看到具体的灾害。
text.en: I heard an emergency broadcast but saw nothing.

text.cn: 我当时正在一条隧道里检查设备，等我按章程把东西都关停再出来的时候……
text.en: Mid-job when it struck. Killed the power, evacced, then...

text.cn: 我猜猜，其他人已经撤走了？
text.en: Let me guess. Everyone already left and you're all alone?

text.cn: 对，然后我从最近的大门离开，躲过了一些不知从哪来的天使，再就是这里了。
text.en: Yeah. Went for the gate, dodged the bugs, and made it here.

text.cn: 接下来怎么办呢？
text.en: What should we do next?

text.cn: 还能怎么办？坚守，等待，然后服从指示呗，我们和这两兄妹都归工团管。
text.en: Hold, wait, follow UW orders. Like the Collinses.

text.cn: 工团不会就这样撂下整个局面不管，研究所和采石场之后都还得继续用呢。
text.en: UW still needs the RC and the Quarry. They won't forget us.

text.cn: 他们倒是撂下了我……不过也能理解，紧急情况下就是会出紧急问题。
text.en: They forgot about me. Crisis means triage, I suppose.

text.cn: 我听说两兄妹之后还有别的增援，已经在路上了。
text.en: The Collinses aren't alone. More help is coming.

text.cn: 有困难第一时间提，物流部门的职责就是解决问题。
text.en: Don't suffer in silence. Logistics Division exists to fix.

text.cn: 当时我刚付完款，选好东西，锚点就落下来了……
text.en: The Ankhor fell right when I paid and selected my item.

text.cn: 我的到现在也都还没取出来……
text.en: They didn't even give me my money back...

text.cn: 如果将来要分开，我就想办法加入工团……
text.en: If we're getting separated, I'll apply to join the UWST...

text.cn: 不，还是我去申请调到终末地来吧……
text.en: No. I think I'll apply to work at Endfield...

text.cn: 咳咳，这里到采石场的班车有消息了吗……
text.en: Ahem. Any news about the Quarry shuttle?

text.cn: 好家伙，真难拧……
text.en: Gah. This is hard work...

text.cn: 这次会抽到什么补给呢……
text.en: What am I getting in this draw?

text.cn: 课题用的植株又得重新栽培……
text.en: I gotta cultivate a new batch of plants for the project...

text.cn: 你疯了吗？你爸爸好不容易才把你安排到四号谷地……
text.en: You mad? Your dad broke systems to get you a Valley job...

text.cn: 我决定了，要去北边参军，收拾这些怪物！
text.en: I wanna join the Order and fight buggers in the north!

text.cn: 这么多源石电机的负荷，撑不住的！
text.en: So many Originium generators. The load is through the roof!

text.cn: 如果稳定器不堪重负瘫痪了，那……
text.en: If the stabilizer fails due to the excessive load, then...

text.cn: 我们先尝试重新分配负荷，再排查风险……
text.en: Balance the loads first. Then troubleshoot the failures.

text.cn: 该死，闸门的源石电磁阀失灵了……
text.en: Dammit. The Originium solenoid valve of the gate is down.

text.cn: 车库门还没法打开吗……
text.en: Can't we open the garage doors?

text.cn: 当时两只天使一前一后把我们堵在电机外廊……
text.en: Two buggers got us trapped at the gangway, front and rear.

text.cn: 而铳里只剩下一发子弹……
text.en: And I had only one bullet in my gun...

text.cn: 好危险……
text.en: That's so dangerous...

text.cn: 后来怎么样了？
text.en: What happened afterwards?

text.cn: 嗨！工友！能帮帮我吗？我被困在这上面了！
text.en: Hi! Crew mate! I need help! I'm trapped up here!

text.cn: 那颗星球……真美。
text.en: This planet is ... beautiful.

text.cn: 或许塔罗斯上面，也有一双眼睛在看着我们。
text.en: Perhaps someone on Talos is looking at us as well.

text.cn: 秦主管刚刚说……
text.en: Director Qin just said...

text.cn: 这天气……
text.en: This weather...

text.cn: 好多积压的工单……
text.en: I got so many work orders to get through...

text.cn: 刚刚是什么动静？
text.en: What was that?

text.cn: 那边有个好大的钻机……
text.en: That's a huge drill crawler...

text.cn: 秩序恢复了。
text.en: Order has been restored.

text.cn: 好久没见到工团的信使了……
text.en: Haven't seen UWST messengers for a while...

text.cn: 哪哪儿都缺东西……
text.en: Shortages! Shortages everywhere...

text.cn: 天使不会再来吧？
text.en: The Aggeloi aren't coming back, right?

text.cn: 呼……那些裂地者为了拷问情报，把我吊在这上面了。
text.en: Ugh... The breakers locked me up there to interrogate me.

text.cn: 后来他们急着去谷地要塞，就把我丢在这儿。
text.en: They then went to the Valley Fort and left me here.

text.cn: 听说有业务员来谈订单？
text.en: Heard about an agent discussing business with us.

text.cn: 锚点竟那样砸了下来！
text.en: The Ankhor simply fell out of the sky!

text.cn: 还好安德烈总工程师没事……
text.en: Thank goodness chief engineer Andre is alright...

text.cn: 想不到荞花粉末那么有效。
text.en: Buckflower powder works like magic.

text.cn: 米格尔医生说……
text.en: Surgeon Miguel said...

text.cn: 那怪物的残骸碎片还在……
text.en: A shard of that monster has remained...

text.cn: 进度落下不少啊……
text.en: We're really behind target...

text.cn: 天使究竟是什么样的生物啊……
text.en: Aggeloi... What type of creatures are they?

text.cn: 恢复工作的感觉真好。
text.en: Feels great to be able to work again.

text.cn: 我们负责的区块进度远远落后了……
text.en: My area is seriously behind schedule...

text.cn: 一半的备用零件都损坏了，能源系统也……
text.en: The energy system and half of the backup parts are bust.

text.cn: 都别只知道抱怨了，我们得解决问题……
text.en: Stop complaining. Fix the problem already...

text.cn: 仓库和设备的损毁程度……
text.en: Just look at the damages to the depot and machinery...

text.cn: 如果裂地者还敢来……
text.en: If those LBs ever return...

text.cn: 继续做好防备。
text.en: We gotta strengthen our defenses.

text.cn: 每次经过这里都感觉头有点晕……
text.en: I feel a little dizzy every time I pass this area.

text.cn: 去看看集成工业系统……
text.en: Let's take a look at the AIC Factory...

text.cn: 看见那大窟窿就心有余悸……
text.en: That huge pit gives me the shivers.

text.cn: 爆炸声？我没幻听吧？
text.en: Explosion? I'm not hearing things, right?

text.cn: 联系上工团了吗？
text.en: Can we get in touch with the UWST?

text.cn: 多亏了莱科和莱雅……
text.en: Thankfully Lykor and Laeya have arrived...

text.cn: 还好精炼炉没出岔子……
text.en: Thank goodness the refining unit didn't blow up...

text.cn: 上次跳闸的也是这里……
text.en: Last time it was also this switch that tripped...

text.cn: 这里附近的设备经常自动断电……
text.en: Power outage keeps happening to the nearby facilities...

text.cn: 可能不是巧合，得全面排查一遍线路……
text.en: It's no coincidence. We should check the circuits again.

text.cn: 好好休养……
text.en: Rest well...

text.cn: 调拨的物资到了？
text.en: Did the supplies arrive?

text.cn: 这伤……咳咳咳。
text.en: The wounds ... hakk-kaff...

text.cn: 没事……很快就能回到工作岗位。
text.en: It's alright... I'll be back at my post again.

text.cn: 有人打牌吗？
text.en: Anyone up for a game of cards?

text.cn: 偶尔可以放松一下。
text.en: We can take a break every now and then.

text.cn: 有什么新东西？
text.en: Got something new?

text.cn: 来杯咖啡……
text.en: I need a cup of coffee...

text.cn: 我喜欢这音乐……可以抚慰人心。
text.en: I like the music here. It's soothing.

text.cn: 其实埃里克还挺辛苦的……
text.en: Eric has a pretty tough job.

text.cn: 我昨晚又做了噩梦，梦到锚点坠落的时候……
text.en: I had that nightmare again. I saw the Ankhor falling...

text.cn: 这里恢复之后，应该会给我们批特别休假吧……
text.en: Special leave? Better be after all this work.

text.cn: 那颗星球……真美。
text.en: This planet is ... beautiful.

text.cn: 或许塔罗斯上面，也有一双眼睛在看着我们。
text.en: Perhaps someone on Talos is looking at us as well.

text.cn: 不好意思……
text.en: I'm so sorry...

text.cn: 回去休息，不然又要出错了。
text.en: Go take a break or you'll make another mistake.

text.cn: 听说了吗？谷地要塞和发电站那边……
text.en: Heard about the Valley Fort and Power Plant...?

text.cn: 你知道吗？是管理员亲自来恢复了一切！
text.en: Psst. I think the Endmin fixed all this mess!

text.cn: 真想看看那是一位什么样的人物……
text.en: I really wanna meet this legend...

text.cn: 听说是位活了快两百岁的银发长者……
text.en: A silvery sage nearly two hundred years old...

text.cn: 管理员，佩丽卡监督，注意安全……
text.en: Be careful out there, Endmin and Supervisor Perlica...

text.cn: 要是你出了事，这些数据还有什么意义……
text.en: The datasets are worthless if anything happens to you.

text.cn: 秦主管刚刚说……
text.en: Director Qin just said...

text.cn: 忍着点……
text.en: Bear with it...

text.cn: 突然就砸下来了……
text.en: It just came crashing down...

text.cn: 联系上工团了吗？
text.en: Can we get in touch with the UWST?

text.cn: 多亏了莱科和莱雅……
text.en: Thankfully Lykor and Laeya have arrived...

text.cn: 还好安德烈总工程师没事……
text.en: Thank goodness chief engineer Andre is alright...

text.cn: 那怪物的残骸碎片还在……
text.en: A shard of that monster has remained...

text.cn: 别靠近，可能还有危险。
text.en: Don't get any closer! Things might be dangerous.

text.cn: 矿石病抑制剂的储备……
text.en: Our stock of Oripathy Suppressants...

text.cn: 调拨的物资到了？
text.en: Did the supplies arrive?

text.cn: 药品不够，要是有些荞花粉末就好了……
text.en: Meds are running out. Buckflower Powder might work...

text.cn: 真不是我吹牛，那些天使我一点都不怕的。
text.en: Not being arrogant, you know, but I fear no buggerloids.

text.cn: 我可是坚持到弹药打空了。
text.en: I fought till I'm out of ammo.

text.cn: 真的假的，我听说他们找到你的时候你整个人都在抖。
text.en: Really? Weren't you trembling when they found you?

text.cn: 那不是发抖！那是战斗的意志与热血在我体内流动！
text.en: Me? Trembling? It's the shake of eagerness and battle rage.

text.cn: 我觉得单纯只是肾上腺素在刺激你……
text.en: I think it was just adrenaline...

text.cn: 这、这次真是捡回一条命啊……多亏了管理员……
text.en: I almost died out there... But the Endmin saved my life...

text.cn: 是啊，等一切安稳了。
text.en: Yeah. We should wait for this to settle down.

text.cn: 我们找个地方好好喝一顿，庆祝我们劫后余生！
text.en: We should find a nice bar and celebrate our survival!

text.cn: 你说得对……
text.en: You're absolutely right...

text.cn: 等这次事情过去了，我就回去向女朋友求婚！
text.en: And I'll ask my sweetheart to marry me once this is over!

text.cn: 你……你倒下的时候吓了我一跳……
text.en: I ... I was so scared when you collapsed...

text.cn: ……我真的……我当时……
text.en: I was ... really ... you know, when it happened...

text.cn: 真没这个必要！怎么这么肉麻？哦……吓破胆了？
text.en: It's alright! Why are you so awkward? Were you scared?

text.cn: 不是……我对你……唉……对你的伤情比较关心。
text.en: Well, I'm just concerned about y — your injuries, I mean.

text.cn: 得优先检查矿石病感染者……
text.en: We need to check the Oripathy positives first...

text.cn: 米格尔医生说……
text.en: Surgeon Miguel said...

text.cn: 好好休养，我们会没事的。
text.en: Rest well. Things will be alright.

text.cn: 我得赶紧……嘶，真疼。
text.en: I gotta... HNGH! That friggin' hurts!

text.cn: 让我起来吧，我得回工作岗位去。
text.en: Just check me out! I gotta get back to my post.

text.cn: 当时锚点就这么直接砸下来了……
text.en: The Ankhor just came crashing down. Right over our heads.

text.cn: 现在还心有余悸啊。
text.en: I'm still a little affected by the experience.

text.cn: 天使、天使把叔叔给……
text.en: Bugs ... the buggers got uncle...

text.cn: 一半的备用零件都损坏了，这要怎么……
text.en: Half of the backup parts are totaled. Friggin' hell...

text.cn: 别抱怨了，解决问题。
text.en: Stop complaining and start fixing.

text.cn: 上次跳闸的也是这里……
text.en: Last time it was also this switch that tripped...

text.cn: 这里附近的设备经常自动断电……
text.en: Power outage keeps happening to the nearby facilities...

text.cn: 可能不是巧合，得全面排查一遍线路……
text.en: It's no coincidence. We should check the circuits again.

text.cn: 我昨晚都做噩梦了。
text.en: I had a nightmare last night.

text.cn: 之后我一定要申请特别休假……
text.en: I'm gonna apply for special leave...

text.cn: 不好意思……
text.en: I'm so sorry...

text.cn: 回去休息，不要勉强自己了。
text.en: Take a break. Don't push yourself too hard.

text.cn: 你知道吗？是管理员接通了共振塔！
text.en: The Endmin fixed the resonance tower!

text.cn: 真想看看那是一位什么样的人物……
text.en: I really wanna meet this legend...

text.cn: 听说是位活了快两百岁的银发长者……
text.en: A silvery sage nearly two hundred years old...

text.cn: 课题用的植株又得重新栽培……
text.en: I gotta cultivate a new batch of plants for the project...

text.cn: 太乱来了，撑不住的！
text.en: This is too risky! It won't hold!

text.cn: 我们先尝试重新分配负荷，再排查风险……
text.en: Balance the loads first. Then troubleshoot the failures.

text.cn: 该死，闸门失灵了。
text.en: Dammit. The gate isn't working anymore.

text.cn: 车库门还没法打开吗……
text.en: Can't we open the garage doors?

text.cn: 哪哪儿都缺东西……
text.en: Shortages! Shortages everywhere...

text.cn: 这辆似乎还有救……
text.en: I think we can actually repair this one...

text.cn: 还好带了存储设备，不然我们的心血就白费了。
text.en: Luckily we brought backup, or this is one wasted trip.

text.cn: 那些裂地者怎么不怕天使呢？
text.en: The LBs don't seem to mind the buggerloids. Why?

text.cn: 如果裂地者还敢来……
text.en: If those LBs ever return...

text.cn: 继续做好防备。
text.en: We gotta strengthen our defenses.

text.cn: 系统日志真是一团糟……
text.en: The system log is a pile of crock...

text.cn: 下一个派送任务是……
text.en: The next delivery job...

text.cn: 不要紧张。
text.en: Don't panic.

text.cn: 诶，这一届的通过率堪忧啊……
text.en: This cohort has abysmal passing rate...

text.cn: 考试也恢复得太快了……
text.en: What?! Exams are already back on schedule?

text.cn: 嘶，是这样操作的吗？
text.en: By Talos, is that even legal?

text.cn: 紧张到抽筋了……
text.en: I was so scared I was getting cramps...

text.cn: 去看看有哪里能帮忙的。
text.en: Let's see if there's anything I can help.

text.cn: 秩序恢复得很快……
text.en: Place is settling down really quickly.

text.cn: 听说这几位天师正巧路过附近……
text.en: Heard a few Tianshi passed by the place.

text.cn: 只靠这点应急物资的话……
text.en: If this is all the emergency supplies we have...

text.cn: 当时两只天使一前一后把我们堵在电机外廊……
text.en: Two buggers got us trapped at the gangway, front and rear.

text.cn: 而铳里只剩下一发子弹……
text.en: And I had only one bullet in my gun...

text.cn: 好危险……
text.en: That's so dangerous...

text.cn: 后来怎么样了？
text.en: What happened afterwards?

text.cn: 梨诺！梨诺！永远喜欢梨诺！
text.en: LIINO! LIINO! LIINO FOREVER!

text.cn: Twinkle-twinkle!Twinkle-twinkle!
text.en: Twinkle-twinkle! Twinkle-twinkle!

text.cn: 好，再排练一次！
text.en: Great. Now let's go over that again!

text.cn: 一、二、三——Twinkle-twinkle！
text.en: On three. One, two, three — Twinkle-twinkle!

text.cn: 这位置多好！一眼就能看到舞台中央！
text.en: PERFECT! I can see the center of the stage from here!

text.cn: 你还是快下来吧……别把音响坐坏了。
text.en: Get down, dammit! You'll squish the speakers!

text.cn: 这次梨诺小姐会表演哪几首歌呢？好期待！
text.en: What will Miss Liino sing for us? I can hardly wait!

text.cn: 难说，这种演出歌单一般都是赞助方定的……
text.en: Welp, the setlist is usually decided by the sponsors...

text.cn: 你这件T恤也是在线下签名会买的吗？
text.en: Did you get this T-shirt from Miss Liino's meet-the-fans?

text.cn: 对啊！排了一晚上的队，好不容易抢到的！
text.en: YEAH! I camped through the night! They were gone in a sec!

text.cn: 菈梵朵玛那场最棒了！永远忘不了那个开场！
text.en: Her entry at the La Fantoma concert was like ... AAAAH!

text.cn: 我还是喜欢新蓝卡坞那场，比较有纪念意义。
text.en: I prefer her New Wrankwood show. That was so memorable!

text.cn: 那个……你带签名笔了吗？
text.en: Hey ... do you have a signing pen?

text.cn: 啊？你不是带了好几支备用吗？
text.en: Wha? I thought you'd bring a few, just in case.

text.cn: 都被我试没墨了……再借我一支吧！拜托了！
text.en: I kept testing them but they went dry. Please gimme one!

text.cn: 这种时候我们更该好好训练！
text.en: Training time! Perfect our moves, people!

text.cn: 那才是对梨诺小姐的最好支持！
text.en: We gotta be Miss Liino best fans ever!

text.cn: 来，继续！一、二、三，Twinkle-twinkle！
text.en: Alright, on three! One, two, three! Twinkle-twinkle!

text.cn: 怎么听说演出延期了……好突然……
text.en: I heard she's delaying her show... It was so sudden...

text.cn: 不会是出了什么问题吧……
text.en: Did something happen...?

text.cn: 怎么会这样……我只请了一天的假啊……
text.en: Why? HOW?! I only applied for one day off!

text.cn: 呃，说不定就晚半天……要不你再多请一天？
text.en: Just apply for one more day!

text.cn: 等下你来劝？毕竟是帮他买过专辑的交情……
text.en: You should talk to him. You did gift him the album...

text.cn: 一起去吧……我怕他听完消息直接晕过去……
text.en: No, we do it together. I think he'll die when he hears this.

text.cn: 我好不容易才借到了签名笔！怎么会这样……
text.en: I just got this signing pen but... NUUUHHH!

text.cn: 欸？那辆就是梨诺小姐坐的车吗？
text.en: Wait! Is that Miss Liino's ride?

text.cn: 肯定啊，你看附近全是保镖……
text.en: Definitely! Look at all these bodyguards...

text.cn: 那边的路怎么突然封了……出事了？
text.en: They suddenly sealed that road. Did something happen?

text.cn: 车上面的脸好眼熟！是哪个偶像的专车吗？
text.en: That passenger looks familiar. Is she a famous star?

text.cn: 保持戒备！别让裂地者靠近！救援很快就到！
text.en: Stay frosty! Keep the LBs off! Help is on its way!

text.cn: 快看！是管理员！救援来得也太快了！
text.en: Look! The Endmin! Help is already here!

text.cn: 太好了！这下裂地者肯定没法得逞！
text.en: Awesome! Now the pipefaces are finished!

text.cn: 都别急啊，梨诺小姐正在休息室认真签名呢！
text.en: No rush! Miss Liino is signing away in the lounge.

text.cn: 好激动！马上能拥有梨诺小姐的签名唱片了！
text.en: I'm getting Miss Liino's signed album today! KYAA!

text.cn: 这回的限量周边也太贵了……差点超了预算！
text.en: This limited merch is overpriced... I'm totally broke!

text.cn: 人也太多了，这下要排多久才能买到啊！
text.en: This queue is humongous! It'll take us forever!

text.cn: 比起这个，我更担心事务所的备货够不够……
text.en: I'm worried if the agency inventory is large enough...

text.cn: 没事！我有找好哥们帮带，他排得还挺靠前！
text.en: I'm calling my bro. He's got a better queue position.

text.cn: 这些小年轻都在搞什么啊……花里胡哨的……
text.en: What are these kids up to? Looks ridiculous...

text.cn: 外公，这你就不懂了吧，他们是在“追星”！
text.en: They're chasing a super star, Grampa!

text.cn: 就和你爱收集布莱特乐队的旧唱片差不多！
text.en: You used to go mad over vinyls by The Bretts.

text.cn: 放心吧，我和负责这块儿的麦克很熟的！
text.en: No worries. Mike's in charge of this place. I know him well.

text.cn: 真的假的？能不能……再给我一个家属名额？
text.en: Really? Can you ... give me a family opening?

text.cn: 这个嘛，我考虑考虑……要不你先把订金……
text.en: Well, I'll think about it. About that deposit payment...

text.cn: 这么一想，合金萝卜城算最好的选择了吧？
text.en: Alloycarrot sounds like the best choice.

text.cn: 这倒是，那里本来就是我们的友好合作城市。
text.en: Yeah. It's a friendly partner city of ours.

text.cn: 在矿业这块的工作也很对口……
text.en: And they also have a big mining sector...

text.cn: 你也打算去合金萝卜城了吗？
text.en: Are you going to Alloycarrot?

text.cn: 是啊，集团给的待遇……很难不动心啊。
text.en: Yeah. The Group gave me a offer that's just too good...

text.cn: 虽然挺舍不得这里的，也舍不得家里人……
text.en: But I'll miss this place and my family...

text.cn: 干脆一家人都搬去？不是说有家属的名额吗？
text.en: Just move your family. The Group has family packages.

text.cn: 怎么回事？供能不够了吗？
text.en: What's up? Power running low?

text.cn: ？！吓我一跳……怎么突然就……
text.en: WHOA?! Scared the blight out of me...

text.cn: 还得处理这些东西……
text.en: There's so much crap to deal with...

text.cn: 有人看见我的终端了吗？
text.en: Has anyone seen my handyterm?

text.cn: 太好了，这里似乎没怎么出事。
text.en: Great. The place seems relatively unscathed.

text.cn: 面包剩的不多了啊……
text.en: We're low on bread...

text.cn: 得趁现在好好休息一下……
text.en: Gotta take a break while I can...

text.cn: 其实埃里克还挺辛苦的……
text.en: Eric has a pretty tough job.

text.cn: 这里不会又不安全了吧……
text.en: Is this place getting unsafe again?

text.cn: 越是这种时候，秩序越是重要。
text.en: Order and discipline are crucial in times like these.

text.cn: 如果大家有事可做，多少能安心一些。
text.en: People might feel safer if they got something to do.

text.cn: 增援一定会来的。
text.en: Reinforcements are definitely arriving.

text.cn: 再坚持一下……
text.en: Be strong...

text.cn: 信使不会在路上出事了吧……
text.en: Maybe the messenger ran into trouble...

text.cn: 唉，之后该怎么办呢……
text.en: Ugh. What should we do now?

text.cn: 现在还不能放松警惕……
text.en: This is no time to lower our guards.

text.cn: 已派遣外勤人员支援风险地区，但……
text.en: We've sent field operators to help, but...

text.cn: 大量运输机器人丢失了信号，情况不乐观……
text.en: Bad news. We lost contact with a lot of logistics robots.

text.cn: 妈，现在哪里都不安全！
text.en: Mom, dangers are showing up everywhere!

text.cn: 总得有人站出来！
text.en: Someone must stand up to the challenge!

text.cn: 唉，我知道……
text.en: Ugh. I know...

text.cn: 该报名去参加前线支援了……
text.en: Time to volunteer for the frontline...

text.cn: 我们这边还会被裂地者袭击吗？
text.en: Will this place get attacked by the LBs?

text.cn: 我听说武器物资不是很充足……
text.en: We don't have a lot of weapons or supplies.

text.cn: 别瞎想，要相信管理员他们……
text.en: Have faith in the Endmin and the Endfielders.

text.cn: 存货量有点麻烦了……
text.en: There's a little problem with the stockpile...

text.cn: 得想想办法……
text.en: Gotta think of something...

text.cn: 要不要趁现在再玩一把……
text.en: Just one more round while there's still time...

text.cn: 没准之后就……
text.en: This might be my last game...

text.cn: 千万别睡过去啊……
text.en: Don't fall asleep...

text.cn: 吃饱了才能好好干活……
text.en: A full stomach fuels the working limbs.

text.cn: 有点心悸，难道是因为天上的……
text.en: That thing in the sky is making my heart race...

text.cn: 不，一定只是咖啡喝多了……
text.en: Hmm. I think it's just too much coffee...

text.cn: 心情总算平复一些了……
text.en: I'm feeling calmer already...

text.cn: 他们几天前还在供能高地……
text.en: They were at the Power Plateau a few days ago...

text.cn: 供能高地的情况很糟糕……
text.en: Situation at the Power Plateau is really bad...

text.cn: 别担心，大家已经出发去支援了……
text.en: Don't worry. Everyone's off to support them...

text.cn: 源石研究园也有麻烦……
text.en: The Originium Science Park is in trouble too.

text.cn: 也许很快就能恢复了……
text.en: Maybe peace is returning soon.

text.cn: 危难当头，每个人都有责任……
text.en: Danger is upon us! Duty calls for everyone!

text.cn: 有什么是我能做的……
text.en: Is there anything I can do?

text.cn: 真是多灾多难啊……
text.en: What a disastrous day.

text.cn: 我……没能救到……
text.en: I ... couldn't save my...

text.cn: 我们不会被发现吧？
text.en: Will we be spotted?

text.cn: 已经没法藏得更高了……
text.en: Can't hide any higher...

text.cn: 振作起来！一定还有办法！
text.en: Look lively! There's definitely another way!

text.cn: 佩吉……不……
text.en: Peggy... No...

text.cn: 快！核心！打核心！
text.en: Quick! The core! Smash the core!

text.cn: 扶我起来……
text.en: Please help me up...

text.cn: 那边还需要我……
text.en: They still need me...

text.cn: 不能让天使再前进一步……
text.en: Stop the Aggeloi in their tracks...

text.cn: 这里的伤员还需要照护……
text.en: The wounded must receive treatment...

text.cn: 来啊，该死的！冲我来啊！
text.en: Blasted buggerloid! COME AT ME!

text.cn: 这次是这样的结构吗……
text.en: Is this the structure we're getting this time?

text.cn: 必须尽快补上防卫漏洞……
text.en: We gotta plug the holes in our defenses!

text.cn: 呼……终于打退那些怪物了。
text.en: Phew. Finally sent the monsters packing.

text.cn: 不知道中控塔那边怎么样。
text.en: Wonder how the Control Tower is doing.

text.cn: 锚点之后是裂地者……
text.en: First the Ankhors. And now we got the breakers...

text.cn: 今天真是多灾多难啊。
text.en: This is one disastrous day.

text.cn: 不知道系统的受损程度怎么样……
text.en: How badly damaged are the systems?

text.cn: 希望数据已经成功备份了……
text.en: I hope they backed up the data...

text.cn: 损失了三分之二……不，得有四分之三……
text.en: We lost about 60%... No. More like 75%...

text.cn: 我得检查下内部结构……
text.en: Lemme check the interior structure...

text.cn: 好像溅到电线上了，真糟……
text.en: Geesh. I spilled something on the circuit...

text.cn: 唉，不该是这样的……
text.en: Ugh. This shouldn't be happening...

text.cn: 小心别乱动。伤口可能会感染。
text.en: Stop fidgeting or your wound might get infected.

text.cn: 优先把剩下的止痛药给其他人吧，我撑得住。
text.en: I can take this. Let others have the painkillers.

text.cn: 交换机还没修复吗？只能采取备用方案C了。
text.en: Did they fix the switch? No? Alright. Plan C.

text.cn: 该死，完全没法连接……得一个一个排查故障。
text.en: Curses. No connections. Gotta troubleshoot this one by one.

text.cn: 传感模块受损得有点严重……
text.en: Sensor module looks really damaged...

text.cn: 有困难第一时间报告。
text.en: Report all issues immediately.

text.cn: 物流部门的职责就是解决问题。
text.en: Logistics Division exists to fix.

text.cn: 我有点担心源石副产物中心那边……
text.en: I'm a little worried about the Originium BPPC...

text.cn: 听说那里也遭到了袭击，但没有进一步消息。
text.en: The place was attacked but we know little else.

text.cn: 我留下来照顾胖——安德烈先生……
text.en: I'll stay behind and look after Big Ow — MISTER Andre...

text.cn: 这是我第一次遇见这么多的天使……
text.en: I've never seen so many buggerloids before...

text.cn: 那些裂地者是冲着我们工团来的！
text.en: Those LBs are coming for us! The UW!

text.cn: 简直就像当年一样……
text.en: Reminds me of that disaster all those years ago...

text.cn: 我们还在紧急状态，谨慎行动。
text.en: We're in a state of emergency. Move cautiously.

text.cn: 线路被共振塔烧坏了……
text.en: The resonance tower fried the circuitries...

text.cn: 没想到集成工业系统是在这种情况下投入应用的。
text.en: Can't believe we're deploying the AIC in this situation.

text.cn: 见习报告有得写了。
text.en: My internship report will be really long.

text.cn: 我觉得这是场预谋已久的袭击。
text.en: I believe this attack is planned well in advance.

text.cn: 但他们是怎么做到的？
text.en: But how did they pull it off?

text.cn: 紧急状态已解除，我们很快就能恢复运作。
text.en: State of emergency lifted. Time to get back to business.

text.cn: 如果将来要分开，我就想办法加入工团……
text.en: If we're getting separated, I'll apply to join the UWST...

text.cn: 不，还是我去申请调到终末地来吧……
text.en: No. I think I'll apply to work at Endfield...

text.cn: 采石场也出现了天使……
text.en: Buggerloids showed up at the Quarry too...

text.cn: 车子全都坏了……
text.en: All the vehicles are down...

text.cn: 难道那些家伙是故意的？
text.en: Did the pipefaces vandalize them on purpose?

text.cn: 管理员，拜托你们了……
text.en: Please help, Endmin...

text.cn: 你爸爸好不容易才把你安排到四号谷地……
text.en: Your dad broke systems to get you a Valley job...

text.cn: 我决定了，要去北边参军，收拾这些怪物！
text.en: I wanna join the Order and fight buggers in the north!

text.cn: 我总算有勇气重新看天空了。
text.en: I can now look at the sky without feeling scared.

text.cn: 塔罗斯……真美啊。
text.en: Talos is so ... beautiful.

text.cn: 听说了吗？供能高地那边……
text.en: Heard about what happened at the Power Plateau?

text.cn: 你们小组还好吗？
text.en: Your crew doing alright?

text.cn: 唉，不算太糟，但……
text.en: Ugh. Not too bad, but...

text.cn: 果然坏掉了……真可惜。
text.en: It's broke as well... What a shame.

text.cn: 该死，我的腿……
text.en: Ugh. My leg...

text.cn: 你们路上小心。
text.en: Be careful out there.

text.cn: 腿还有点疼，嘶，管不了那么多了……
text.en: Sss! The leg's hurting! Ugh, screw it...

text.cn: 裂地者，哼……
text.en: Friggin' LBs...

text.cn: 一切都准备就绪……
text.en: Everything is good to go...

text.cn: 佩斯凯！别泄气！
text.en: Don't give up, Pesche!

text.cn: 协议核心在地上会是什么样呢……
text.en: What would the PAC look like on the ground?

text.cn: 这一天终于到了……
text.en: The day has finally arrived...

text.cn: 总算把那些垃圾都清走了。
text.en: Finally cleared all that junk.

text.cn: 接下来就看终末地的了。
text.en: Now it's Endfield's show.

text.cn: 是要从天上落下来吗？
text.en: It's gonna fall from the sky?

text.cn: 真期待啊……
text.en: Can't wait...

text.cn: 希望一切顺利……
text.en: Hope it goes well...

text.cn: 看到了不得了的东西啊。
text.en: That looks incredible!

text.cn: 干净又利落，太帅了！
text.en: Such a smooth drop! Awesome!

text.cn: 看来附近暂时安全了。
text.en: This place is safe for now.

text.cn: 第一次运行，不会出问题吧？
text.en: First test run ... hope nothing goes wrong.

text.cn: 得好好监控才行……
text.en: Gotta keep a close watch...

text.cn: 马上就要忙起来了。
text.en: Things will get really busy.

text.cn: 希望这大家伙能尽快帮到大家。
text.en: Hope this big guy can help everyone soon.

text.cn: 表彰就署名“榔头扳手锤小组”……怎么听着更像土匪？
text.en: Sign it as the Wrecker Trio. Wait. That sounds like a gang.

text.cn: 我们早该跳槽去防卫科了吧，工资高还有补贴。
text.en: Should've transferred to Security. They even got hazard pay.

text.cn: 这不是我的配铳啊，得了，顾不上了。
text.en: This isn't my gun. Ugh. So long as it works.

text.cn: 线路接口正常……电力负荷稳定……
text.en: Circuitry interfacing looks good. Power loading is stable.

text.cn: 唉……资料要是真的丢了，要怎么办？
text.en: Ugh. I'll have nothing left if I lose the data.

text.cn: 那小姑娘不得生吞了我……
text.en: The girl will be incredibly furious...

text.cn: 好险……
text.en: That was close...

text.cn: 看来暂时还不能下去……
text.en: We can't go down right now...

text.cn: 接下来才是重头戏……
text.en: The real show is about to start.

text.cn: 得赶紧去把原型机修好……
text.en: Gotta head back and fix the Prototype.

text.cn: 管理员，祝你们一切顺利。
text.en: Good luck out there, Endministrator.

text.cn: 接下来可是个大工程！
text.en: The real work is about to start!

text.cn: 你看到那些长条家伙了吗？
text.en: See those long tube people?

text.cn: 安全是最优先要考虑的……
text.en: Safety must be our top concern.

text.cn: 有点棘手啊……
text.en: This is a little tricky...

text.cn: 数量还在变多……该死……这要怎么……
text.en: Their numbers keep increasing... Crap... What now...

text.cn: 万事俱备，准备开工！
text.en: Everything's covered! Let's start the work, crew!

text.cn: 这就运转起来了，真方便啊。
text.en: It just started running! How convenient is that?

text.cn: 真是百闻不如一见！
text.en: You really have to see this with your own eyes!

text.cn: 记得收集工业点数哦！
text.en: Don't forget to pick up the AIC Index points!

text.cn: 前方正在施工，请留步！
text.en: Place is off limits for construction work!

text.cn: 目前一切顺利……
text.en: Everything's going smooth...

text.cn: 爆炸？发生什么了？
text.en: Was that an explosion? What happened?

text.cn: 天哪，看天空！
text.en: Oh my goodness. Look at the sky!

text.cn: 怎么会这样……
text.en: How could this happen...?

text.cn: 那个方向是供能高地……
text.en: That's where the Power Plateau is...
No...

text.cn: 该死，麻烦一个接一个地来！
text.en: Dammit. These troubles never seem to end!

text.cn: 还好我及时把机器停掉了……
text.en: Thankfully I switched off the machine...

text.cn: 通往源石研究园的路通了。
text.en: The road to the Originium Science Park is open.

text.cn: 路上小心……希望一切都能好起来。
text.en: Be careful out there. Hope everything gets better.

text.cn: 通信干扰还是很严重……
text.en: We're still getting strong signal interference...

text.cn: 正在尝试备用线路……
text.en: I'm trying to use a backup circuit.

text.cn: 裂地者怎么突然这么有能耐……
text.en: Since when did the LBs get so good at fighting?

text.cn: 不可能……不，想不通……
text.en: Impossible... None of this made any sense.

text.cn: 管理员，请务必小心。
text.en: Be careful, Endmin.

text.cn: 管理员，拜托你们了。
text.en: Counting on you, Endmin.

text.cn: 我们很快就会跟上的。
text.en: We'll be right with you.

text.cn: 一定要保护好原型机啊……
text.en: Please, keep the Prototype safe.

text.cn: 刚刚真的很吓人……
text.en: That was really scary...

text.cn: 我的耳朵现在还难受着……
text.en: My ears are still hurting...

text.cn: 那边的情况不太妙啊……
text.en: That place seems to be in serious trouble...

text.cn: 那些裂地者会再出现吗？
text.en: Will those Landbreakers return?

text.cn: 努力干活！为了新的家园！
text.en: Put your back into it! We're rebuilding our homes!

text.cn: 我好担心那些裂地者会不会……
text.en: I'm really worried about those LBs coming back...

text.cn: 那辆车是终末地的？
text.en: Is that an Endfielder vehicle?

text.cn: 终末地又送来了一批物资。
text.en: Endfield has delivered another batch of supplies.

text.cn: 是还要建什么新东西吗？
text.en: Are we building something new?

text.cn: 面包店有新口味了！
text.en: The Bake Shop has a new flavor!

text.cn: 索斯真是不容易啊……
text.en: Soth's job is really tough.

text.cn: 那位胖大鸟师傅的小机器人真是神奇……
text.en: Master Big Owl's robot is amazing...

text.cn: 让那些裂地者也尝尝挨揍的滋味！
text.en: Those LBs are gonna taste my fury!

text.cn: 干了一天活，好想喝点热的……
text.en: I'm totally spent. I need something hot to drink...

text.cn: 刚出炉的烤面包，真香！
text.en: Freshly baked bread smells so delicious!

text.cn: 好饿，什么时候开饭？
text.en: I'm so hungry. When's chow time?

text.cn: 每天最享受的就是坐在这里喝咖啡的时光。
text.en: Sitting here with my daily coffee is the best.

text.cn: 还有温暖的太阳。
text.en: The warm sun makes it better.

text.cn: 阿吉的画真不错。
text.en: Ginny's really good at drawing.

text.cn: 终末地托付的订单，耽搁不得。
text.en: This is an Endfield order. No delays!

text.cn: 好想去玩游戏机啊……
text.en: I wanna play games...

text.cn: 干完手上的活再说！
text.en: Finish your work first!

text.cn: 来再多裂地者我们也不怕！
text.en: We're ready to take on an LB horde!

text.cn: 竟然变成了这么好的地方！
text.en: This turned into a really nice place!

text.cn: 不久之前，还是另一副模样……
text.en: It was completely wrecked not too long ago...

text.cn: 听说有人想来这里做生意？
text.en: I heard someone's interested in business.

text.cn: 卡贾，来帮把手！
text.en: Karja! Give me a hand, boy!

text.cn: 啊——嚏！这里风好大，好冷……
text.en: ACHOOO! The wind is strong here, and so cold...

text.cn: 加把劲，把房子盖起来。
text.en: Come on, people! Let's build the house!

text.cn: 总算回来了……
text.en: We're finally back...

text.cn: 嗯？面包的香味！
text.en: *SNIFF* The smell of bread!

text.cn: 这新房子，可比简易窝棚结实多了。
text.en: Finally, walls that don't fear the wind.

text.cn: 那位戴着面具的“管理员”还会来吗？
text.en: Will the masked Endmin ever return?

text.cn: 又能看到天空了，真好啊！
text.en: This is great! I can see the sky again!

text.cn: 这就是新的家吗？
text.en: Is this our new home?

text.cn: 赶快清除掉这些丑陋的旗帜和涂鸦。
text.en: Gotta remove those buggly flags and graffiti.

text.cn: 我昨晚又梦见了那些裂地者……
text.en: I had a nightmare last night about the breakers...

text.cn: 别怕，一切都过去了……
text.en: Don't worry, it was just a bad dream...

text.cn: 该不会我现在还在做梦吧……
text.en: Oh no, am I still dreaming...

text.cn: 保险起见，你们掐我一下！
text.en: Pinch me!

text.cn: 这是什么东西？
text.en: What's this?

text.cn: 那个叫弧光的姑娘教我做的……
text.en: Miss Arclight taught me to make this...

text.cn: 之前那个姑娘应该是位游人吧？
text.en: That girl is a Songseeker, right?

text.cn: 众生长地的人在这附近不多见啊。
text.en: Hardly see people from the Hannabit Circuit in this place.

text.cn: 肚子饿了……
text.en: I'm hungry...

text.cn: 我的那份吃不完，分你一点吧。
text.en: Here, have this. I can't finish my portion.

text.cn: 我要去给斯托布先生帮忙。
text.en: I'm going to help Mr. Staub.

text.cn: 要注意安全呀。
text.en: Be safe.

text.cn: 必须检测超域能量是否残留……
text.en: Must check for Æther residues...

text.cn: 我们这么多年的心血，被破坏成这样……
text.en: They totally wrecked the place ... years of our hard work...

text.cn: 一定要让那些裂地者付出代价！
text.en: We must make those LBs pay!

text.cn: 都乱成一锅粥了……
text.en: The entire thing is a royal mess...

text.cn: 不是来添乱的就好……
text.en: I just hope we aren't getting any more trouble.

text.cn: 科伦一家也搬完了吗……真快啊……
text.en: The Kehlens are done moving? They're so fast!

text.cn: 明天我也该去收拾行李了……
text.en: I gotta pack my stuff tomorrow...

text.cn: 怎么办？我这边还是缺几个特大号螺丝……
text.en: I'm still missing some extra large screws...

text.cn: 要不你去前面那家杂货店看看？
text.en: You should check that corner store up ahead.

text.cn: 他家的店面虽然不大，东西倒是挺多的。
text.en: It's not a big place, but they have all sorts of stuff.

text.cn: 最后缺的那点零件也到手了，总算可以歇了。
text.en: Got that final missing part. I can finally take a break.

text.cn: 要不是你推荐，我都不知道附近还有这么一家店！
text.en: Thanks to you! I never knew such a store existed!

text.cn: 哈哈，找到了就好，我自己也常去他家淘货呢。
text.en: Hah! I'm glad you found it. I often shop there myself.

text.cn: 随便看，随便挑，都是良心价。
text.en: Take your time. Honest prices, honest deals.

text.cn: 还真是什么东西都有……
text.en: You really have all sorts of stuff...

text.cn: 这次我一定赢你！
text.en: I'll beat you this time!

text.cn: 少说大话了！先比比看呗！
text.en: Whatever. We'll see!

text.cn: 乔伊丝加油！你是最棒的！
text.en: Go, Joyce! Go! You're the best!

text.cn: 麦克斯！可别给我们设备科丢脸啊！
text.en: Max! The Hardware Division is counting on you!

text.cn: 他俩心态一直这么好的吗……
text.en: Are those two always in such a good mood?

text.cn: 压根不像刚被人救出来的。
text.en: They look completely unfazed by their ordeal.

text.cn: 很奇怪吗？那你是没见他们之前有多闹腾……
text.en: Get used to it. They're always making a fool of themselves.

text.cn: 这边……还有这边……还是再加固一遍吧……
text.en: Here ... and here. We gotta strengthen these bits.

text.cn: 应该没什么地方漏了……
text.en: I don't think we missed anything.

text.cn: 挺好的，这样回头交接的时候也好交代点……
text.en: Good. I think I can safely hand over this thing...

text.cn: 真给你们修好了？有点本事……
text.en: You really fixed it? Impressive.

text.cn: 不容易，好久没见“老伙计”这么精神了。
text.en: Haven't seen the old boy working this hard for a while.

text.cn: 抱歉，里面正在进行紧急维修，暂时不能进入……
text.en: Sorry. Place is closed for emergency repairs.

text.cn: 对不住，里面正在进行紧急维修，请过段时间再来。
text.en: Sorry. Place is closed for emergency repairs right now.

text.cn: 唉，没想到这里也有这么冷清的一天……
text.en: Never expected this place to feel so lonely...

text.cn: 大家别着急！今天的烤饼和肉串保证管够！
text.en: No rush! We got enough bread and kebabs for everyone!

text.cn: 给我来一份烤饼！
text.en: Give me some bread!

text.cn: 我要再来三串烤长耳兽！
text.en: And three long-ear kebabs!

text.cn: 真想再吃一次啊……安娜大姐家的烤长耳兽……
text.en: I really miss Anna's special long-ear kebabs...

text.cn: 怎么办……要是恢复不了大门的供电……
text.en: What should I do? If I can't get power to the gate...

text.cn: 再拉一百次开关也开不了门啊……
text.en: Pulling the switch a hundred times won't work...

text.cn: 断在哪里不好，偏偏是这个位置……修起来最麻烦。
text.en: Out of all places! A disconnection here is a nightmare!

text.cn: 等下谁去搬备用耗材？先说好，我肯定扛不动。
text.en: Supplies need carrying. But I'm too weak for the job.

text.cn: 还是你有办法！修好了都不用担心次生灾害的影响了！
text.en: Awesome! This will eliminate secondary disaster effects!

text.cn: 那还得谢谢研究所的工友，多亏他们之前给的新材料。
text.en: Thank the Research Center! Their new materials really work!

text.cn: 我知道你们！你们就是终末地的朋友吧！
text.en: I know you! You're friends from Endfield!

text.cn: 嘿嘿，多谢了！听说就是你们把那些工友救出来的吧？
text.en: Heheh! Thanks! I heard you saved our crew mates.

text.cn: 大家好像都没受什么伤，真是太好了……
text.en: Great. Everyone seems to be in one piece.

text.cn: 不过之后就要考虑撤离的事了吧……唉……
text.en: But we gotta think about the evac. *Sigh*...

text.cn: 总是要走了才觉得舍不得……
text.en: Funny how you start missing a place when you're moving...

text.cn: 但愿新采石场宽敞点，让“老伙计”伸展得开。
text.en: Hope the new place's bigger for the old boy to do his work.

text.cn: 听说下面掉了个锚点？天啊……还好被你们破坏了！
text.en: An Ankhor? Thank goodness you took it out!

text.cn: 不然别说深层管理区，这儿都迟早要被天使包围吧？
text.en: It would've filled the place with buggers if left unchecked.

text.cn: 他们离开前应该有带走一些储备物资……
text.en: They probably brought some reserve supplies when evacuating.

text.cn: 但量没多少，不知道够不够他们撑到现在……
text.en: It's not a lot. I don't know if they could survive on that.

text.cn: 这扇门通往阿伯莉采石场。
text.en: This gate leads to the Aburrey Quarry.

text.cn: 操作一下吊舱，就应该可以过去了……
text.en: We just need to control the lifting cage to get across...

text.cn: 里面很多岔路，很容易被困在里面……
text.en: There are many intersections inside. People often get lost.

text.cn: 零件箱上好像有些提示……
text.en: There are some clues on the spare parts locker.

text.cn: 下一份要录入的资料是……
text.en: The next data to record is...

text.cn: 真舍不得这里啊……
text.en: I really miss this place...

text.cn: 这些年轻人……
text.en: Look at these young people...

text.cn: 怎么突然就通讯断了……
text.en: Why are we disconnected all of a sudden?

text.cn: 要不还是想想办法，把起重机修好吧。
text.en: Maybe we should think of a way to fix the crane.

text.cn: 唉，谁不想呢？但来回几个技术员都没辙……
text.en: I agree. But none of our technicians could pull it off.

text.cn: 或许那些失联的工友就在下面……
text.en: Perhaps the missing crew mates are down there...

text.cn: 终末地的朋友……但愿未来能在别处再会！
text.en: Hope to see you again, Endfielders!

text.cn: 放心吧。有我守在这里，天使过不来的。
text.en: Don't worry. I got this spot. I shall stop every Aggeloi.

text.cn: 每次从吊运中枢那边过来都要绕那么一大圈
text.en: We have to take a really long detour to reach the place.

text.cn: 累死了……
text.en: I'm exhausted...

text.cn: 啊？原来你不知道那边有个临时搭的垂直绳索吗？
text.en: What? Don't you know about the temporary climbing rope?

text.cn: 你说我们这算不算捡回一条命了？
text.en: That was a really close shave and we escaped, right?

text.cn: 算！怎么不算！回去不吃顿好的可说不过去！
text.en: Totally. I say we celebrate this with a feast!

text.cn: 好好歇着，别浪费绷带。
text.en: Rest well and don't waste the bandages.

text.cn: 我的胳膊……！这下得练习左手拧螺丝了……
text.en: My arm...! Guess I'll have to unscrew with my left hand.

text.cn: 恢复得不错，过几天估计就能拆绷带了。
text.en: It's healing nicely. I can take these off in a few days.

text.cn: 嘿嘿，那就好！我正想去师傅那儿帮忙呢！
text.en: Hah. Great! I hope I can help out my master.

text.cn: 这个机器我认得，是伊冯设计的。
text.en: I know this robot. Yvonne designed it.

text.cn: 盘点得怎么样了？
text.en: How's the inventory count?

text.cn: 货物太多太乱了，得花一阵子。
text.en: A gigantic mess. It will take a while.

text.cn: 咱们得抓紧了……
text.en: Please get it done ASAP...

text.cn: 我们在这歇一会儿。
text.en: We should rest here.

text.cn: 嘘，别让诺夫曼听到了。
text.en: Shhh. Don't let Noffman hear that.

text.cn: 多亏了终末地的那种小机器人。
text.en: Thank goodness we got those Endfield robots.

text.cn: 是的，这样送货就快多了。
text.en: Yeah. Delivery is much faster with them.

text.cn: 维拉那边的补给还没送来吗？
text.en: Did Vera's food provisions arrive?

text.cn: 别着急，她知道咱们的情况。
text.en: Don't rush it. She knows everyone's hungry.

text.cn: 听说枢纽区基地那边被锚点袭击了。
text.en: I heard an Ankhorfall struck the Hub Base directly.

text.cn: 嗯，但他们很快就解决了危机。
text.en: Yeah. They also took care of that thing really quickly.

text.cn: 超域试验场丢了什么东西？
text.en: What did the Æther Test Site lose?

text.cn: 各种说法都有，但肯定是重要物件。
text.en: Rumors swirl, but this is big. Trust me.

text.cn: 还是别猜了，干活吧……
text.en: Stop making up stories and focus on your job.

text.cn: 听说醇化合物工厂的负责人……
text.en: Heard about the Kohl Plant monitor?

text.cn: 唉，我记得他刚上任不久，还很年轻。
text.en: Ugh. A pretty young sod who just got promoted.

text.cn: 现在的负责人英格好像是卡尔老师的朋友。
text.en: Monitor Ingol seems like an old friend of Mr. Karl.

text.cn: 刚才有一个怪人过来，被我打发走了。
text.en: I just convinced some weirdo to go elsewhere.

text.cn: 怪人？什么样的？
text.en: Weirdo? What does he look like?

text.cn: 我也看见了，他说自己要建种子库什么的。
text.en: Saw that weirdo too. He wants to build a seed bank.

text.cn: 太倒霉了，被调到这里来帮忙。
text.en: Just my luck. Why did they assign me to this place?

text.cn: 我觉得还好啊，至少伙食比以前好。
text.en: This place is neat. At least the food's better.

text.cn: 谢谢你。我太大意了，撤离的时候没带武器……
text.en: Thanks. I should have brought a weapon during the evac...

text.cn: 真是多亏了法比安。
text.en: Gotta thank Fabian for this.

text.cn: 没错，要不是他组织疏散，我都不知道怎么办了。
text.en: Right. He's the only reason this evac worked.

text.cn: 这些裂地者什么时候冒出来的？
text.en: When did these breakers arrive at this place?

text.cn: 我也不知道，但感觉是蓄谋已久了。
text.en: I don't know. The LBs probably planned way ahead of time.

text.cn: 他们……太可怕了。
text.en: They're ... terrifying.

text.cn: 矿脉源区那边有消息传过来吗？我弟弟还……
text.en: Any news from the Origin Lodespring? My brother's still...

text.cn: 我听说有终末地的人过去了，别太担心。
text.en: Don't worry. Some Endfielders just went there.

text.cn: 是的，听说还送了药过去。
text.en: Yeah. They also brought medication.

text.cn: 原本的扩建计划看来是泡汤了。
text.en: Welp, there goes our original expansion plan.

text.cn: 不要太灰心，只要计划还在……
text.en: Don't let that beat you down. We still have the plan...

text.cn: 先顾好眼前的事情吧。
text.en: Just focus on cleaning up this place.

text.cn: 终末地的这些设备这么纤细，能行吗？
text.en: Endfield machines don't look sturdy. Can they really work?

text.cn: 反正我是不太喜欢。
text.en: I just don't like their flimsy looks.

text.cn: 那是你太古板了……
text.en: Cos you're too old school...

text.cn: 这些裂地者真麻烦，不过……他们别想踏进我的地盘。
text.en: Breakers test my patience. But my turf's off-limits.

text.cn: 大家都安全了吗？
text.en: Is everyone safe?

text.cn: 伊冯在哪儿？
text.en: Where's Yvonne?

text.cn: 你没事吧……
text.en: Are you alright?

text.cn: 有办法回实验室吗？
text.en: Can you make it back to the lab?

text.cn: 裂地者……太可怕了。
text.en: The LBs ... they're so scary.

text.cn: 怎么还没把门打开？
text.en: Can we get the gate opened already?

text.cn: 现在是工作时间。
text.en: We're on a shift.

text.cn: 清点工作还有好多……
text.en: Inventory jobs just keep coming...

text.cn: 以后还是不要招惹伊冯……
text.en: We better not piss off Yvonne again.

text.cn: 人都逃出来了吗？
text.en: Did everyone make it out?

text.cn: 基特还没，他说很多资料没有备份，要想办法带出来。
text.en: Not Kitt. He wants to backup his data and bring them along.

text.cn: 他们好像是冲着研究所去的，有人通知伊冯了吗？
text.en: They're attacking the Center. Anyone told Yvonne about this?

text.cn: 天哪……
text.en: Oh my goodness...

text.cn: 也不用太担心，伊冯的本事你我都知道……
text.en: Meh. Everyone knows Yvonne can take good care of herself.

text.cn: 我的实验数据……
text.en: My research data...

text.cn: 那些实验数据就是我的命啊……
text.en: But my life is all about the research data...

text.cn: 嘘，小声点。外面的裂地者走了吗？
text.en: Shhh. Quiet. Did those LBs leave?

text.cn: 我还是再多等一会儿吧。
text.en: I think I'll stay here for a while longer.

text.cn: 裂地者……他们居然敢招惹工团？！
text.en: Breakers started a scrap with the UWST?! Impossible!

text.cn: 这越界了，不可原谅。
text.en: They crossed the line. We'll show 'em no quarters.

text.cn: 嘘！小心，外面有很多裂地者……
text.en: Shh! There are a lot of LBs outside...

text.cn: 我和帕茜约在这里会合，一起撤离。但她还没来……
text.en: I told Pattsy to meet here for the evac, but she never came.

text.cn: 我的终端……怎么在这个时候坏掉了！
text.en: My handyterm... How could it break at this time?

text.cn: 联系不上雷利了，不知道他还好吗……
text.en: I can't reach Ridley. Is he alright?

text.cn: 本来我今天要做实验，结果全乱套了。
text.en: There goes my research schedule for today. Damn it.

text.cn: 而且伊冯……她还在里面。
text.en: Yvonne... She's still inside.

text.cn: 里面怎么还这么大的动静？
text.en: I hear plenty of crazy noises coming from the inside.

text.cn: 基建前站都开始转运物资了，是不是没事了？
text.en: Infra-Station crew came for supplies. That a good sign?

text.cn: 还是小心点，遇到裂地者可不是闹着玩的。
text.en: We best be careful. Those LBs aren't fooling around.

text.cn: 你也太冒险了，守在门口那么久？你不怕危险吗？
text.en: You kept waiting by the gate? That's so dangerous!

text.cn: 我联系不上你，又怕你出来之后找不到我。
text.en: But you didn't pick up my calls! I don't wanna miss you.

text.cn: 这些机关挡住了裂地者，我的实验样本没怎么受损。
text.en: The traps stalled the LBs. My samples are largely safe.

text.cn: 我们还是先别回去了，等法比安他们清理一下吧。
text.en: Let's wait here and let Fabian's crew clean up the place.

text.cn: 我们还是先别回去了，等法比安他们再清理一下吧。
text.en: Let's wait here so Fabian's crew can clean up this place.

text.cn: 据说，裂地者围攻时，伊冯一直守在她的实验室里。
text.en: Yvonne hunkered down in her lab when the LBs attacked.

text.cn: 真的？真令人同情，我指的是那些裂地者。
text.en: Really? Now I feel bad. For the LBs.

text.cn: 多亏了赫蒂……
text.en: Thank goodness Hedy helped me out...

text.cn: 她给我简单包扎了一下，现在应该没有什么大碍。
text.en: She bandaged my wounds. I should be fine.

text.cn: 不知道现在矿区那边怎么样了……
text.en: I wonder how the mines are holding up...

text.cn: 该死，怎么联系不上杰里米？
text.en: Dammit. Jeremy? Where in the blight are you?

text.cn: 我马上就要成功了……
text.en: I was so close to success...

text.cn: 我没时间，我连吃饭睡觉的时间都没有。
text.en: I got no time. Not even for meals or snoozes.

text.cn: 这里太危险了，我有点怀念故乡的农庄……
text.en: What a dangerous place... I'm missing the farms back home.

text.cn: 听说裂地者是冲着伊冯来的？
text.en: I heard the LBs are going after Yvonne.

text.cn: 伊冯？她不是在做超域研究吗？
text.en: Yvonne? The Æther scientist?

text.cn: 裂地者对这么前沿的东西感兴趣？
text.en: Why are the LBs so interested in fringe science?

text.cn: 下一轮的实验马上就要启动了。
text.en: The next round of tests is about to begin.

text.cn: 我要把更多的时间花在研究上。
text.en: I gotta spend more time on my research.

text.cn: 重建工作很艰巨……但我会努力让工厂尽快恢复生产。
text.en: Rebuilding is a ton of work, but I'll revive the factory.

text.cn: 我的烧瓶呢，谁见到我的烧瓶了？
text.en: Where's my beaker? Anyone seen my beaker?

text.cn: 这么一折腾，谷地扩建的计划也要搁置了。
text.en: This mess is gonna delay the Valley Expansion project.

text.cn: 我听说我马上要被调到三号谷地去了……
text.en: I heard I'm getting re-assigned to Valley III...

text.cn: 在我们回来之前，设备就被人修好了。
text.en: Someone fixed the machinery before we came back here.

text.cn: 用土办法修的，看上去很粗糙，但还能用……
text.en: Very improvised and crude, but it works...

text.cn: 物资什么时候能送到，该到我们了吧？
text.en: When will the supplies arrive? It's our turn, right?

text.cn: 我们要往后排呢，现在需要重建的地方太多了。
text.en: We're at the bottom of the list. Rebuilding is top priority.

text.cn: 跑得太着急了，好多东西都没带出来。
text.en: I evacced too quickly and hardly brought anything with me.

text.cn: 谁看到我的药剂了？不会也没带出来吧……
text.en: Anyone saw my meds? I hope I didn't leave it back there...

text.cn: 外面出了这么大的事，听说下面一点损失都没有。
text.en: I heard things down there are fine despite the chaos.

text.cn: 多亏了那些激光装置，谁装的来着？
text.en: Thank Talos for those killer beams. Who installed them?

text.cn: 肯定有人动过我的终端！
text.en: Someone fooled around with my handyterm!

text.cn: 培育源石也太枯燥了……
text.en: Growing Originium crystals is boring...

text.cn: 谁去跟伊冯说说，这些东西太挡道了。
text.en: Can someone tell Yvonne that her stuff is in the way?

text.cn: 这里信号实在是太差了。
text.en: Signal is really lousy here.

text.cn: 白跑一趟，早知道就在这儿躲着了。
text.en: What a wasted trip. Should have hid here from the start.

text.cn: 哈珀疯了吧……他现在死盯着工作，谁都不搭理。
text.en: Harper's mad. The workaholic won't talk to anyone.

text.cn: 让我来清理废弃研究资料，也不告诉我一共有多少……
text.en: Sort some obsolete files, they said. "Some" ... ffft...

text.cn: 基特的胆子真大……
text.en: Kitt's so brave...

text.cn: 所有人都回来了吗？怎么感觉少了一些人？
text.en: Everyone's back? I think we're missing a few people.

text.cn: 但愿这些裂地者不要动我种植的作物……
text.en: Pray those LBs don't mess with my crops...

text.cn: 至少……放过我的种子。
text.en: Just ... keep my seeds safe, at least.

text.cn: 第一次见到这么多裂地者……
text.en: I've never seen so many breakers before...

text.cn: 好在裂地者没打进来。
text.en: Thank Talos the LBs didn't bust in here.

text.cn: 这可都是珍贵的样品……
text.en: These samples are really important...

text.cn: 这事太吓人了，搞得我连讲解词都忘了。
text.en: The whole thing was so scary I forgot about my speech.

text.cn: 哈珀那边又发来新的模拟需求了……
text.en: Harper sent me a new simulation request...

text.cn: 每次走在这里我都心惊胆战。
text.en: I feel the shivers every time I walk through this place.

text.cn: 植株的盘点还需要一段时间。
text.en: An inventory count of our crop samples will take a while.

text.cn: 最近都不怎么见林奈过来了。
text.en: Why hasn't Linnaeus visited?

text.cn: 还好，他们不是冲着实验室来的。
text.en: Thank the Big Gas they weren't after the lab.

text.cn: 这些源石能够完好无损真是个奇迹……
text.en: It's a miracle that these Originium formations survived.

text.cn: 估计裂地者也没能力把它们都运走。
text.en: The LBs probably couldn't move them away.

text.cn: 工厂已经停产了，不知道要检修多久……
text.en: The factory is down. I don't know for how long...

text.cn: 我跑不动了……
text.en: I can't run anymore...

text.cn: 这里还不安全，哨站就在前面了。加把劲！
text.en: This place isn't safe. Keep going! The outpost is up ahead!

text.cn: 整个反应炉都要更换？是个大工程！
text.en: A reactor change? That's like serious work!

text.cn: 你的活忙完了吗，就跑过来找我？
text.en: Come to see me again? Are you done with work?

text.cn: 现在有这么多货积压着，活是干不完的，总得休息。
text.en: So much stuff to move around... We need a break.

text.cn: 样本都还好吗？
text.en: Are the samples alright?

text.cn: 完好无损，这里没有遭到破坏。
text.en: They're untouched. This place is completely undamaged.

text.cn: 你听说了吗？这些裂地者在里面遭了大罪了。
text.en: You heard? The LBs got wiped in the Center.

text.cn: 想象得到。呵，他们居然敢在那个伊冯的地盘撒野。
text.en: One does not simply mess with Resident Yvonne the Vouivre.

text.cn: 内雷奥真的太好了。
text.en: Nereo is so nice.

text.cn: 他把我推荐给了研究部门，接下来我会留在园区工作。
text.en: He got me in R&D. I'll be working at the Science Park.

text.cn: 供能高地的路断了，斯科特他们还没回来……
text.en: Path to the Power Plateau is out but Scott isn't back yet.

text.cn: 只能祝他们好运了。
text.en: Best of luck to them.

text.cn: 大潘师傅在不在，直接关系到我们这里的伙食水平。
text.en: The presence of Master Da Pan directly impacts chow quality.

text.cn: 到头来，工地的伙食是最好的。
text.en: Site chow is always best.

text.cn: 大潘师傅不但饭做得好吃，说话也有趣。
text.en: Master Da Pan is a chef of awesome food AND jokes.

text.cn: 吃饱了才有力气干活……
text.en: A full stomach gives power to our working limbs...

text.cn: 这个工地的环境还不错。
text.en: This construction site is in a pretty good area.

text.cn: 现在我们与外界的交通还没恢复。
text.en: Gotta restore our roads to the other sites.

text.cn: 不要担心，面包的供应是充足的。
text.en: Don't worry. There's enough bread for everyone.

text.cn: 大难不死，必有后福……
text.en: Fortune favors those who survive the nastiest stuff...

text.cn: 待在这里肯定是安全的。
text.en: This is the safest place to be at.

text.cn: 琼怎么不见了，我见她跑出来了啊？
text.en: Where's Joan? I saw her leaving the place.

text.cn: 终末地的设备风格和我们完全不一样。
text.en: Endfield machinery is really different.

text.cn: 听说矿区那边的路已经断掉了……
text.en: I heard the road to the mines is completely out...

text.cn: 那片裂谷……深不见底。
text.en: That chasm is literally ... bottomless.

text.cn: 这个基建前站建得还真是时候。
text.en: They built the Infra-Station at the right time.

text.cn: 超域试验场那边究竟发生了什么……
text.en: What happened to the Æther Test Site?

text.cn: 供能高地那边还有很多需要重建的建筑……
text.en: The Power Plateau needs a ton of rebuilding.

text.cn: 诺夫曼怎么整天板着个脸……
text.en: Noffman is looking pretty glum...

text.cn: 各方重建的需求都往这里发，根本接不过来。
text.en: We're drowning in work orders for the rebuilding.

text.cn: 园区里那个终末地小姑娘太闹腾了。
text.en: That Endfielder girl is really messing with this place.

text.cn: 听说咱们在这儿干活的都有表彰。
text.en: I heard everyone who works here will get a commendation.

text.cn: 好险……差点就被甩到侵蚀里了。
text.en: That was close... I almost got thrown into the Blight.

text.cn: 别乱动，这个伤口很深。
text.en: Stop fidgeting. The wound cuts deep.

text.cn: 这么大一个工程，我们做到了！
text.en: We actually completed this massive project!

text.cn: 生产工作一点不比建设工作轻松……
text.en: Production is just as tiring as construction...

text.cn: 以前的那个厨子现在也去工地支援了。
text.en: I heard that chef is helping out at the construction site.

text.cn: 我已经习惯了四处奔波。
text.en: I'm used to life nomadic.

text.cn: 谢天谢地，那些裂地者过不来。
text.en: Thank Talos. The LBs will never make their way here.

text.cn: 诺夫曼肯定能把他们救回来，我相信他。
text.en: Noffman will save them. I have faith in him.

text.cn: 听说奥莉加他们的设备全都坏了……唉……
text.en: Olga's crew might have no working equipment left...

text.cn: 信号接收器总算装好了，希望能找到他们……
text.en: Signal receiver is finally up. Hope we'll find them...

text.cn: 我相信诺夫曼的判断！
text.en: I have faith in Noffman's judgment!

text.cn: 以目前的消息来看，情况并不乐观……
text.en: Things aren't looking very good from what I've heard...

text.cn: 这下恐怕更难搜寻到他们的信号了……
text.en: Tracking their signals would only get harder...

text.cn: 别高兴得太早，还不清楚他们现在的情况……
text.en: We got no idea how they're doing. Don't get too optimistic.

text.cn: ……我们还要在这儿被困多久……
text.en: How long are we going to be trapped here?

text.cn: 迟迟没有救援队伍的消息，我们只能靠自己了……
text.en: No news of SAR teams. We gotta find a way ourselves.

text.cn: 大家什么风浪没有见过，都会好起来的。
text.en: The UW is no stranger to hardship. Things will get better.

text.cn: 吃完饭了……继续回去工作吧。
text.en: I'm stuffed. Back to work.

text.cn: 还好食物的储备还够，大家不用饿肚子。
text.en: No one's starving. Thank Talos for our huge larder.

text.cn: 奶奶，这个好吃。
text.en: This is yummy, Granny.

text.cn: 奶奶还不饿，乖，你多吃点。
text.en: I'm not hungry, sweetheart. Have some more.

text.cn: 还得再加快一些速度，还有人饿着呢。
text.en: Gotta pick up the pace. We still have mouths to feed.

text.cn: 要注重营养和出餐速度，但味道也不能差。
text.en: Gotta make it quick, nutritious, and delicious.

text.cn: 有人还没吃饭吗？正宗武陵炒饭，马上出锅。
text.en: Hungry? Authentic Wuling Fried Rice coming right up!

text.cn: 我想要一点……
text.en: I want s'more...

text.cn: 人是铁饭是钢，再忙再累也不能对吃的将就。
text.en: Never compromise on food. No one can work while starving.

text.cn: 一点胃口都没有，唉……
text.en: I don't feel like eating. Ugh...

text.cn: 不知道负责维修的工友们有没有吃东西。
text.en: I wonder if the repair crew got anything to eat.

text.cn: 天空的样子变回来了……
text.en: The sky isn't looking weird anymore...

text.cn: 人渐渐多起来了，这是好兆头。
text.en: We're getting quite a crowd. This is a good sign.

text.cn: 多吃点，吃饱了才有力气干活。
text.en: Have some more. You work better with a full stomach.

text.cn: 大家都来吃饭了，太好啦！
text.en: Everyone's getting chow? Wonderful!

text.cn: 外面好起来了，总算有时间吃饭了。
text.en: Things are getting better, and we are getting lunch breaks!

text.cn: 终末地的管理员……真好奇那是个什么样的人。
text.en: Really curious about that Endmin of Endfield Industries.

text.cn: 再来一碗吧，可把我饿坏了。
text.en: More please. I'm starving.

text.cn: 大家受苦了……都好好歇歇吧……
text.en: Y'all really had it hard out there. Get some proper rest.

text.cn: 来吃点东西，搜救工作就快要开始了。
text.en: Eat something, folks. SAR work is about to start again.

text.cn: 要为之后的重建工作养精蓄锐。
text.en: Gotta stay in shape to help the rebuilding.

text.cn: 希望这一切真的结束了……我还是有些后怕。
text.en: I think I got PTSD... I really hope this is truly over.

text.cn: 是那位管理员做了什么吧？我就知道一定可以成功的。
text.en: This must be the Endmin's work! I knew they could do it!

text.cn: 这些设备的损坏情况很严重……
text.en: These facilities look seriously damaged...

text.cn: 不行，工具不够用了，得去商人那儿碰碰运气。
text.en: Gah. We're short on tools. Gotta talk to the vendor.

text.cn: 现在全靠它们运送物资了，得尽快修好才行。
text.en: We need them fixed to get the supplies delivered.

text.cn: 我知道，已经尽全力在修了。
text.en: I know. We're already on it.

text.cn: 又有一批需要维修的器械送过来了。
text.en: They sent us a new batch of machinery that must be repaired.

text.cn: 零件还够……但是工具不够分了。
text.en: We got enough parts ... but not enough tools.

text.cn: 源石电路系统彻底损坏……
text.en: The Originium circuitry is completely fried...

text.cn: 只能放弃了，这种情况已经没人能修好了。
text.en: I don't think anyone can fix that. Just scrap it.

text.cn: 回收来的报废器械，可以拆成零件用来维修。
text.en: Strip the scrap for parts and use them for repairs.

text.cn: 不好处理的先放在那边，等一下我来想办法。
text.en: Set these units aside. I'll think of something later.

text.cn: 这些器械的损坏程度太严重了……
text.en: These machines are way beyond repairs...

text.cn: 危机还没结束，还不能放松警惕。
text.en: The crisis isn't over. We can't let our guard down.

text.cn: 执行搜救任务，要先把载具都修好。
text.en: Can't SAR with broken trucks. Gotta get them fixed.

text.cn: 快去准备，我们也要跟着搜救队去救人。
text.en: Get prepped. Gotta join the SAR crew and save lives.

text.cn: 都准备好了，就等搜救队出发了。
text.en: All set to go. Waiting for the crew to start moving.

text.cn: 一些医疗器材出了问题，得去处理一下。
text.en: Some med equipment are down. Need to fix them.

text.cn: 这些都可以投入使用了。
text.en: We can start using these.

text.cn: 等修好这台设备，我就和搜救队一起去找我的家人。
text.en: I'll fix this, then join the SAR team to look for my kin.

text.cn: 还有些旧矿区的工业设备需要我们维修。
text.en: We need to fix some factory machines at the Old Mines.

text.cn: 这些孩子们都已经能独当一面了啊……
text.en: The children are really taking matters into their own hands.

text.cn: 你盯着天上干什么？
text.en: Why are you staring at the sky?

text.cn: 我在想，天上的裂缝会不会是什么设备故障导致的……
text.en: I'm wondering if a machine failure ripped that rift open.

text.cn: 要是有能协助修理设备的源石技艺该有多好。
text.en: If only there were a form of Originium Arts for repairs.

text.cn: 枢纽区基地也能联系上了。
text.en: The Hub Base is back online.

text.cn: 他们的情况也不乐观啊。
text.en: They got hit pretty hard too.

text.cn: 还有不知道多少人困在外面……
text.en: I don't know how many people are trapped outside...

text.cn: 这里现在禁止通行，都回去吧。
text.en: No entry. This area is off limits.

text.cn: 外面的情况很危险，请好好待在营地里。
text.en: Stay in the living quarters. It's really dangerous outside.

text.cn: 提高警惕，不能让居民们涉险。
text.en: Stay alert. We can't let the residents face the dangers.

text.cn: 外面依然有很多危险区域，外出要有安保人员陪同。
text.en: Get a security escort if you wanna head out there.

text.cn: 希望被困在外面的人们平安无事。
text.en: I hope those trapped outside are alright.

text.cn: 要远离外面还有侵蚀残留的地方。
text.en: Stay away from Blight residues when you're out there.

text.cn: 要在规定时间内回来，外面依然有危险。
text.en: Don't delay your return. It's dangerous outside.

text.cn: 刚才的光，就像当年……
text.en: That light... Reminds me of that incident years ago.

text.cn: 这些载具还能用，要运走进行维修吗？
text.en: We should move these vehicles elsewhere for proper repairs.

text.cn: 拖车现在被占用了，我们直接在这里修好它们吧。
text.en: The trailer's taken. We can only fix them here.

text.cn: 这里还有些剩余物资，你那边呢？
text.en: We got some supplies left. How about you?

text.cn: 订单上显示这些都是商品，但先别管那么多了。
text.en: The order listed them as merch. Ignore that for now.

text.cn: 这是越医生需要的那台设备吗？
text.en: Is this the device that Medical Officer Yue needs?

text.cn: 对，他说已经故障很久了，只能试试看能不能修好了。
text.en: Yes. Told us it's down for a while. Let's try fixing it.

text.cn: 我这边的巡逻结束了，你那边的情况怎么样？
text.en: I've done my patrols. How's your situation?

text.cn: 一切正常，该交换巡逻区域了。
text.en: Sitch is normal. Time to switch the patrol areas.

text.cn: 你好勇敢啊！
text.en: You're so brave!

text.cn: 你叫塔塔吗？我们做朋友吧！
text.en: Is your name Tata? Let's be friends!

text.cn: 这些天使是从哪儿冒出来的，明明之前还没有……
text.en: Why did these buggers show up? They were never here before.

text.cn: 还好有洛茜和终末地的人帮忙啊。
text.en: Thank goodness Rossi and the Endfielders are here to help.

text.cn: 你刚才看到了吗？那两个人消灭了那么多天使！
text.en: Did you see that? They wrecked all those buggers!

text.cn: 大家都没受伤吧！
text.en: Is anyone hurt?

text.cn: 该怎么办才好，难道就要在这里……
text.en: We're so screwed. Is this the end...?

text.cn: 冷静一点！快看，有人来了，肯定是来救我们的！
text.en: Calm down. Look! Someone's here to help us!

text.cn: 不许再往前走了，前面可是我们的秘密基地！
text.en: Don't take another step forward! That's our secret base up ahead.

text.cn: 说出来就不叫秘密啦！
text.en: It wouldn't be a secret if I told you!

text.cn: 太好了，门卫叔叔说他们可以去帮我找爸爸妈妈了。
text.en: The guard told me they're gonna search for Mom and Dad.

text.cn: 物资很快会被送过来，得先把这些都修好……
text.en: The supplies will be here soon. We gotta fix this first...

text.cn: 别急，你很久没休息了，我们慢慢来。
text.en: Take a break, we're in no rush.

text.cn: 把货物和设备转移一下，给后续物资腾出空间。
text.en: Move the cargo and machinery for the arriving supplies.

text.cn: 我们真的得救了吗……一切都太突然了……
text.en: Are we really saved? Everything happened so quickly...

text.cn: 不能再这么下去了，我们得做些什么才能自救！
text.en: We can't sit around anymore. We gotta do something!

text.cn: 但我们又能做些什么？就只能在这里祈祷了。
text.en: But what could we do? Pray?

text.cn: 这些应该撑得到后续物资送达，太好了。
text.en: Wonderful. This should last till the next supplies delivery.

text.cn: 病人伤情紧急，得通知越医生……
text.en: Patient is going critical. We gotta tell Surgeon Yue...

text.cn: 他们、他们还在里面……我还不能走……
text.en: I can't leave... They ... they're still inside...

text.cn: 天上突然像被撕开了一般……
text.en: It looks as though someone tore open the sky...

text.cn: 没事的，现在你已经安全了。
text.en: It's alright. You're now safe.

text.cn: 我们为什么会遇到这种事……
text.en: Why did this happen to us?

text.cn: 我的伤不重，我能帮得上忙。
text.en: I only have a few bruises. I think I can help.

text.cn: 越医生那边已经忙不过来了，我们再坚持一下。
text.en: Surgeon Yue's swamped with work. Gotta do this ourselves.

text.cn: 还有伤员等着救治，这里的人手也不够了……
text.en: We got more injured to treat but we're short on hands.

text.cn: 咬紧牙关，别担心，你的伤没有那么重。
text.en: You'll pull through. Those wounds aren't that serious.

text.cn: 我、我的腿好痛……我还能再站起来吗？
text.en: My leg ... it's hurting... Can I ever stand again?

text.cn: 我不能就在这里躺着，工团需要我。
text.en: Not gonna just lie here and do nothing. The UW needs me.

text.cn: 等伤好以后，还有很多事情等着我。
text.en: Once I get better, I'll have plenty of things to do.

text.cn: 天上的那个裂缝……那就是真正的裂隙吗……
text.en: Look at that hole in the sky. Can that be THE rift?

text.cn: 我们的工作就是先养好伤，一切都会好起来的。
text.en: Our job is to nurse our wounds. Things will get better.

text.cn: 太好了，听说情况好转了。
text.en: Heard some great news. The sitch is getting better.

text.cn: 你们休息一下吧，我已经好很多了。
text.en: Take a break, people. I'm feeling much better already.

text.cn: 没关系，我还能坚持。
text.en: Don't worry. I'll live.

text.cn: 太好了，太好了，大家有救了……
text.en: Wonderful! Everyone is saved...

text.cn: 可能还有很多伤员没有回来……
text.en: A lot of the injured might still be out there...

text.cn: 这里交给我吧，你已经很长时间没休息了。
text.en: Leave this to me. You haven't rested for a while.

text.cn: 谢谢了……危机解除，疲劳一下子涌上来了。
text.en: Thanks... The crisis is over, and I feel so depleted.

text.cn: 现在正是缺人手的时候。
text.en: We really need every helping hand we can get.

text.cn: 多亏了医护人员，我感觉好多了。
text.en: Feeling better already. Thank Talos for our med team.

text.cn: 希望能早日痊愈……日子还长着呢。
text.en: I hope I recover soon... I got plenty of days ahead.

text.cn: 好想出去看一下现在的天空……
text.en: I wanna head out and look at the skies...

text.cn: 等你的情况再稳定一点，我们就一起去看看。
text.en: We'll do it together once you get better.

text.cn: 大部分资源都集中到这里了，希望一切顺利。
text.en: Most resources are stored here. Hope everything works.

text.cn: 护士们允许我出去帮忙了，太好了！
text.en: I'm glad the nurses finally agreed to let me help.

text.cn: 一些轻症病人先集中起来做紧急处理……
text.en: Move the lightly injured together for first aid...

text.cn: 都已经安排好了，但现在最缺的是人手……
text.en: It's arranged, but we still need more people...

text.cn: 这可怎么办，已经没有空病床了。
text.en: What should we do? We're out of beds.

text.cn: 多亏有越医生……可他也不是铁打的……
text.en: We're lucky to have Surgeon Yue, but we gotta let him rest.

text.cn: 就算物资紧缺也得保障基本的消毒环境。
text.en: Supplies may be low, but we must keep the place sanitized.

text.cn: 还没有进行紧急处理的到我这里来。
text.en: If you did not receive any first aid, come over to my side.

text.cn: 我的伤应该不重，就不给医生们添加负担了。
text.en: This is just a scratch. I won't bother our med team.

text.cn: 还是要让护士们看一下，别硬撑。
text.en: Drop the act. Those wounds need treatment.

text.cn: 到换药时间了……
text.en: Time to change the bandages...

text.cn: 还有什么我能帮上忙的吗？
text.en: Is there anything I can do to help?

text.cn: 我自己做了紧急处理，把这些药留给其他人吧。
text.en: I dressed my own wounds. Leave the meds for the others.

text.cn: 这就是全部了……不知道这些能帮助我们坚持多久。
text.en: This is everything... Not sure how long it could last.

text.cn: 有些伤员的情绪很不稳定，得想想办法。
text.en: Some of the sick are very emotional. We need to think fast.

text.cn: 我还能坚持……没事的，救援就快来了。
text.en: I'm alright ... I'll live. Help is on its way.

text.cn: 所缺药品的清单已经列好了。
text.en: We made a list of the meds we really need.

text.cn: 还会来新的伤员，第二批也要提前准备好。
text.en: More injured are on their way. Get batch 2 prepped early.

text.cn: 终于……能喘口气了……
text.en: I can ... finally ... breathe easy...

text.cn: 总算看到些希望了……
text.en: Hope is finally within sight...

text.cn: 伤情严重的病人会先被转移到越医生那里救治。
text.en: Critical cases will be moved and treated at the base.

text.cn: 太好了……这我就放心了。
text.en: Good... I'm glad they're being cared for.

text.cn: 药品都送到越医生那里了吗？
text.en: Have we delivered all the meds to Medical Officer Yue?

text.cn: 全部都送过去了，但缺口似乎依然严重……
text.en: We did, but the MO probably needs a lot more...

text.cn: 这里还有些紧急物资出售，太好了。
text.en: Great. We can buy essential supplies here.

text.cn: 我需要一套新的防护服……
text.en: I need a new suit of PPE...

text.cn: 这种情况最缺的是各类工具……
text.en: We're really short on all sorts of tools...

text.cn: 这里会有好吃的吗……
text.en: Is the food good here?

text.cn: 这里非但没有涨价，反而降价了……
text.en: I'm surprised. Things actually got cheaper...

text.cn: 老板说不愿意发灾难财。
text.en: The boss said she's not going to profit off the disaster.

text.cn: 我还以为会有很多人来这儿买东西。
text.en: I thought more people would shop at this place.

text.cn: 外面怎么会变成这样……这里还安全吗……
text.en: The sitch is a royal mess. Is this place still safe?

text.cn: 越医生那边需要一些能用来当支架的东西……
text.en: Surgeon Yue kinda needs something to make a splint...

text.cn: 这里应该有卖的，去问问老板吧。
text.en: The boss probably has something in store. Let's go ask her.

text.cn: 大家都怎么了……为什么没有人陪我玩了？
text.en: Everyone's so busy. Nobody's playing with me.

text.cn: 整理好的货物先放在那边，等清点完再运走。
text.en: Put the sorted cargo over there for an inventory count.

text.cn: 又可以委托老板采购一些好东西了。
text.en: Time to ask the boss to buy something nice again.

text.cn: 道路不知道什么时候才能恢复。
text.en: When will the roads get fixed?

text.cn: 土地很长一段时间都难以恢复原状了……
text.en: It will take a really long time for this land to heal...

text.cn: 不知道会对日常的出行产生多大的影响。
text.en: Wonder how this might affect daily commute...

text.cn: 给孙子买点礼物，等他伤好了给他个惊喜。
text.en: Gotta surprise my grandkid with a gift when he gets better.

text.cn: 不少重建工作都需要补充建材。
text.en: Rebuilding will require plenty of construction materials.

text.cn: 这里变成这个样子……唉……
text.en: This place is really devastated. Ugh...

text.cn: 再过一段时间，这里就会恢复如常吧，但愿……
text.en: Things will be back to normal after a while, I hope...

text.cn: 如果是前几年，我兴许还能帮上点忙，唉……
text.en: If I were younger, I would've rolled up my sleeves to help.

text.cn: 这里的物资少了一部分，得重新清点一下……
text.en: We're missing a few. Gotta do a recount...

text.cn: 先统一做好物资的清点和分类……
text.en: Gotta sort and inventorize the supplies...

text.cn: 各个区域的物资都送过去了吗？
text.en: Have the supplies been delivered to the various areas?

text.cn: 都到位了，但还得迅速补充后续的物资。
text.en: It's all en route, but we gotta prep the next batch.

text.cn: 抓紧时间……不能再耽搁了。
text.en: Watch the time. No more delays.

text.cn: 食材先送到用餐点，目前的存量……我看看。
text.en: Checking inventory... And send the food to the canteen.

text.cn: 医疗器材已经出现短缺了。
text.en: We're low on medical equipment again.

text.cn: 伤员太多了……
text.en: So many wounded...

text.cn: 特殊时期必须要保障物资的安全。
text.en: These are trying times. We gotta keep the cargo safe.

text.cn: 把原本要对外运输的货物先投入使用吧。
text.en: Hold the supply delivery. Use them for ourselves first.

text.cn: 只靠这些物资，我们还能撑多久……
text.en: How are these supplies going to last?

text.cn: 哥哥，我也想帮忙。
text.en: Brother, please let me help.

text.cn: 你去用餐点那边看看晚饭做得怎么样了吧。
text.en: Go to the canteen and see if they need help with dinner.

text.cn: 在支援抵达前，还得指望这些物资。
text.en: These supplies are all we have till the next batch arrives.

text.cn: 太好了，数字都对上了。
text.en: Great. The numbers finally add up.

text.cn: 终于不用那么紧张了。
text.en: I don't need to panic anymore.

text.cn: 剩下的交给我吧，你先去歇会儿。
text.en: Leave the rest to me. Go and take a break.

text.cn: 呼……那太好了，我去去就回。
text.en: Phew. Alright. I'll be back in a bit.

text.cn: 我们打算组建搜救队，需要一批额外物资。
text.en: Need some supplies to create an SAR crew.

text.cn: 嗯，我们收到消息了，先来这边登记一下。
text.en: Yeah. We got the message. Please register here.

text.cn: 这批物资要尽快分发完才行……
text.en: We gotta give out these supplies ASAP...

text.cn: 这就是最后一批要清点的货物了。
text.en: This is the final batch of supplies to inventorize.

text.cn: 不知道是谁帮助了我们，终于脱离险情了。
text.en: Dunno who helped us, but the crisis has finally ended.

text.cn: 等运力恢复，物资就可以得到补充了。
text.en: Supplies will flow once transport capacity is restored.

text.cn: 外面的破坏情况太严重了，还有裂地者在。
text.en: The place is totally wrecked and we got LBs as well.

text.cn: 现阶段先老实躲在这里吧。
text.en: We should just stay put for now.

text.cn: 这么一直躲着也不是个办法。
text.en: But we can't keep hiding forever.

text.cn: 但裂隙的影响还没消除，不能轻举妄动。
text.en: The effects of the rift remain. Don't do anything funny.

text.cn: 我不要在这里……妈妈，妈妈在哪里……
text.en: I don't want to be here! MOMMY! WHERE'S MY MOMMY?

text.cn: 这可怎么办才好……
text.en: Bummer. What should I do?

text.cn: 你的妈妈叫什么，还记得在哪里分开的吗？
text.en: What's your mommy's name? Remember where you lost her?

text.cn: 我不知道……我要妈妈，呜呜呜呜……
text.en: I don't know... I just want Mommy. *Hik, hik*...

text.cn: 我们能渡过这次难关吗……我有些不安……
text.en: Can we survive this? I don't feel too safe here...

text.cn: 顺其自然吧，至少我们现在还活着。
text.en: Just take it in stride. At least we're alive.

text.cn: 这里的重建工作已经开始了吗？
text.en: Are we rebuilding this place already?

text.cn: 我们还在进行评估，矿区的情况怎么样？
text.en: We're still assessing the sitch. How goes the mines?

text.cn: 只能依靠时间去抹平这片大地上的伤痕……
text.en: Only time can heal the wounds suffered by this land...

text.cn: 这可怎么办，让她看到了我被裂地者吓哭的模样……
text.en: I'm screwed. She saw the LBs turn me into a groveling mess.

text.cn: 但你依然挡在了她身前，不是吗？
text.en: But you stood up to protect her, right?

text.cn: 别闹别扭了，她在找你呢。
text.en: Stop sniveling already. She's looking for you.

text.cn: 重建初步估算也要花不少时间……
text.en: From what I'm seeing, rebuilding will take us some time...

text.cn: 听说终末地的工业系统测试成功了，他们或许会帮助我们。
text.en: Endfield just tested a new factory. Maybe they can help.

text.cn: 那些裂地者不在了吧……这里真的安全了吧？
text.en: The breakers are gone? Is this place really safe?

text.cn: 哥哥……我们还要躲到什么时候，我好怕……
text.en: Brother, how long are we gonna hide? I'm so scared...

text.cn: 这里被弄得一团糟，好多资料都找不到了……
text.en: They turned this into a dump site. I lost tons of data...

text.cn: 我打听过，你妈妈就在不远处的据点，我带你过去吧？
text.en: Your Mommy is at a nearby outpost. I'll take you there.

text.cn: 真的吗？谢谢你了，叔叔！
text.en: Really? Thank you so much, Uncle Wooster!

text.cn: 我其实才二十出头……
text.en: Uncle Wooster? I'm just 20, kid!

text.cn: 外面好像已经安全了，听说是多亏了终末地的人。
text.en: Things have settled down. They say the Endfielders helped.

text.cn: 真的吗？我和他们的技术员关系不错。
text.en: Really? I got a buddy who's an Endfield technician.

text.cn: 到这里就安全了……呼……
text.en: We should be safe here... Phooo...

text.cn: 姐姐的体力真差呢。
text.en: You need more exercise, Miss.

text.cn: 在这儿工作了几十年，第二次看到如此严重的事故。
text.en: Worked here for decades. This is the second disaster I saw.

text.cn: 之前发生过什么？是世代摇篮那里吗？
text.en: Did it start at the Cradle? What happened?

text.cn: 我的女儿……是我不好，是我没有照顾好她……
text.en: My poor baby girl... Should've kept my eyes on her...

text.cn: 我听说有人遇到你女儿了，他们正在赶往这里的路上。
text.en: Someone found your baby. They're on their way.

text.cn: 快下来吧！万一摔了可怎么办哟……
text.en: Get down here! You might fall and hurt yourself....

text.cn: 不！我要和警卫叔叔一样站岗保护大家！
text.en: NO! I'm gonna protect everyone like the guards!

text.cn: 需要物资的填好表格来这里领取喔。
text.en: Fill out the forms and get your supplies here, people!

text.cn: 经历这样的事故，我想去文明环带发展了，一起走吗？
text.en: This convinced me to live in the Band. You coming with?

text.cn: 不，我要留在工团，我在这里还有未尽的责任。
text.en: No. I'm gonna stay. My duty is with my fellow crew.

text.cn: 你你你你是谁？我在这里很安全！
text.en: Who! WHO ARE YOU!? I'm super safe here!

text.cn: “烙铁”……工团有多久没有发送过这条指令了。
text.en: Utjug ... it's been a while since UWST last issued that.

text.cn: 重视质量，同时也得提高效率……
text.en: Quality first. But efficiency is also important...

text.cn: 这片土地在低声悲鸣……
text.en: This place rumbles with sorrow...

text.cn: 这会成为重建四号谷地的新起点……
text.en: This will be the starting point for rebuilding Valley IV.

text.cn: 人逐渐多起来了！
text.en: We're getting more people!

text.cn: 预备的食物品类不多……但我会想办法的……
text.en: Food reserves aren't diverse, but I'll think of something.

text.cn: 重建指挥部的工作事关重大。
text.en: Reconstruction is an important undertaking.

text.cn: 多亏了终末地帮忙，顶棚总算到位了。
text.en: We finally raised the roof, all thanks to Endfield.

text.cn: 我得去通知其他人！
text.en: Gotta notify the others!

text.cn: 要时刻警惕四周……
text.en: Need to stay alert and monitor the surroundings...

text.cn: 还有一些区域需要规划……
text.en: A few areas still need planning...

text.cn: 那两个人会不会太依赖终末地的帮助了……
text.en: Those two are too reliant on the Endfielders...

text.cn: 还有多处供能问题得解决……
text.en: Power supply is still an issue for many places...

text.cn: 这帮裂地者……瞧好吧，工团的报复才刚刚开始。
text.en: These thugs ... just wait. Revenge has only just begun.

text.cn: 要让他们付出代价……
text.en: Make them pay the price...

text.cn: 要尽快推进建设……
text.en: Gotta speed up the construction...

text.cn: 嗯，是适合远行考察的天气。
text.en: Hmm. Weather seems perfect for a field survey.

text.cn: 大型地质探针的建设要推进到下一阶段了。
text.en: The large geological probe project is entering a new phase.

text.cn: 我们需要能放得下大型储液罐的空间。
text.en: We need space to place a large fluid tank.

text.cn: 面包的供给稳定下来了！把这里扩张一下。
text.en: Bread supply is finally guaranteed! Time for an expansion.

text.cn: 我去多选几种受欢迎的口味！
text.en: I'll select the most popular flavors!

text.cn: 这里与一开始相比，完全换了副模样啊。
text.en: This place looks so different now.

text.cn: 病房终于建成了，可以把病人们都转过来了。
text.en: The clinic is up and running. Time to move the patients in.

text.cn: 希望大家在研究过程中也多小心，别受伤了。
text.en: Be careful during your research. Don't get hurt.

text.cn: 大型地质探针，等建好之后会更壮观吧？
text.en: The completed geological probe should look awesome.

text.cn: 得为大型储液罐选一下位置……
text.en: I must choose a spot for the large fluid tank...

text.cn: 他们两个……还需要磨练啊……
text.en: Those two ... are in need of proper training...

text.cn: 地质探针就快完成了，真期待啊。
text.en: The geological probe is almost done!

text.cn: 这里将会供应重建指挥部的伙食。
text.en: The Reconstruction HQ crew will get their food here.

text.cn: 越是最后关头，越不能放松……
text.en: Can't afford to slip, especially during the final phase...

text.cn: 大家齐心协力比什么都重要。
text.en: Nothing beats a united crew.

text.cn: 我们就要成功了！
text.en: We're really close to success!

text.cn: 希望大家喜欢我挑选的面包！
text.en: I hope y'all like the bread flavors I picked!

text.cn: 重建工作可能要持续很长一段时间……
text.en: Rebuilding might take quite a while...

text.cn: 通风问题总算解决了。
text.en: We fixed the ventilation problem.

text.cn: 多亏了终末地提供的通风装置。
text.en: All thanks to the ventilators from Endfield!

text.cn: 大型储液罐的数量可能还不太够……
text.en: We might need more large fluid tanks...

text.cn: 等下阶段开始，大型储液罐的规模就不够了。
text.en: We'll be short on fluid tanks when the next phase begins.

text.cn: 别担心，我已经派人去负责扩建计划了。
text.en: Don't worry. I got someone to plan an expansion.

text.cn: 真不放心交给年轻人……
text.en: Can I trust these youths...?

text.cn: 那位卡普里尼小妹妹帮我们做了不少规划。
text.en: That young Caprinae girl came up with very good plans.

text.cn: 她可是终末地派来的技术专员，来帮我们的。
text.en: She's an Endfield tech specialist. She's here to help.

text.cn: 我们还做得不够好……
text.en: Our work is far from perfect...

text.cn: 不能辜负克劳老师的信任……
text.en: Gotta live up to Professor Crowe's expectations...

text.cn: 小家伙们，要说再见啦。
text.en: Good bye, little ones.

text.cn: 研究数据将会从这里源源不断地送上来……
text.en: This will keep outputting useful research data...

text.cn: 还有谁没领到面包吗？
text.en: Is there anyone who missed out on the bread?

text.cn: 果然花生果酱味是最受欢迎的！
text.en: I knew peanut butter would be the most popular!

text.cn: 重建指挥部的工作才刚开始呢！
text.en: Work at the Reconstruction HQ has just begun!

text.cn: 接下来就静待伤员们恢复了。
text.en: Now we'll wait for the injured crew mates to recover.

text.cn: 希望别再有人受伤了。
text.en: Hopefully no one gets hurt again.

text.cn: 和我想的一样壮观……震撼……
text.en: It's just as I thought... Spectacular ... and monumental...

text.cn: 注意记录每一条参数！
text.en: Make sure you record every figure!

text.cn: 得提前测试好下个周期的提取物储存环境。
text.en: Gotta test sample storage conditions before the next cycle.

text.cn: 有不少人在碾骨氏族的袭击中负伤了……
text.en: Plenty of people got hurt by the Bonekrushers...

text.cn: 伤员的情况不太好，医疗条件太差了……
text.en: Medical conditions aren't good enough for the wounded...

text.cn: 我们需要建造一个正规的病房……
text.en: We should build a proper clinic...

text.cn: 两个让人不省心的家伙……
text.en: Those two are really making a mess of things...

text.cn: 这份工作的使命重大……
text.en: This task is extremely important...

text.cn: 滚出去！这是我们的地盘！
text.en: Get out! This is our turf!

text.cn: 今天是折了也不能锈了，跟你们干了！
text.en: Even if we break today, we won't rust. We're going all in!

text.cn: 全都宰了！
text.en: ALL IN!

text.cn: 风紧扯呼……
text.en: The wind's picking up, time to bail...

text.cn: 这水车不转，桥就过不去啊……
text.en: If this waterwheel doesn't turn, we can't get across...

text.cn: 大好人啊！
text.en: What a great person!

text.cn: 他们应该不是从武陵来的吧……
text.en: They don't seem to be from Wuling...

text.cn: 帮大忙了！
text.en: That was great help!

text.cn: 刚修好的又被冲坏了，唉……
text.en: Just got it fixed and it's already washed out again... *Sigh*.

text.cn: 摸会儿鳞，希望没人注意到我。
text.en: Slacking off ... hope no one notices.

text.cn: 屋漏偏逢连夜雨……
text.en: When it rains, it pours...

text.cn: 我感觉不到我的脚了……
text.en: I can't feel my feet anymore...

text.cn: 最近的袭击怎么越来越频繁了呢，怪事儿。
text.en: Strange, how come the attacks got more frequent lately?

text.cn: 呦，二姑娘请到高人了啊。
text.en: Huh, Younger Dame has hired herself some expert help, huh.

text.cn: 你们能留下来就太好了！
text.en: It's great that you all can stay!

text.cn: 那混账，得找他明算账！这事儿不能糊弄过去了！
text.en: That bastard, we can't just let this slide!

text.cn: 嘁，二姑娘，什么二姑娘。二*清波寨俚语*姑娘吧！
text.en: Tsk, Younger Dame? More like *Qingbo Stockade expletive*!

text.cn: 这次不会真栽了吧……
text.en: We're not really gonna bite it this time ... are we?

text.cn: 别轮到放我的水竹铃啊……
text.en: Please don't tell me it's my bamboo water chime's turn...

text.cn: 得去求援……
text.en: Gotta call for backup...

text.cn: 光照参数又不对了……最近天气变化好频繁啊。
text.en: Light parameters are off again... Weather's unpredictable.

text.cn: 拍下来，请同事鉴定一下这种生物……
text.en: Take a picture and ask your coworkers to identify it...

text.cn: 怎么办，大当家去哪里了……
text.en: What do we do? Where has Chief gone...
Less than 0.05... PLEASE let it be less than 0.05...

text.cn: 我养的菌还活着！
text.en: My bacteria are still alive!

text.cn: 神农保佑……
text.en: Shennong, grant us your protection...

text.cn: 要是我的源石技艺是施肥就好了！
text.en: If only my Originium Arts were good for fertilizing!

text.cn: 我想哭，刚砌好的墙……
text.en: I'm gonna cry. The wall I just finished building...

text.cn: 经得住这么来回造么……
text.en: Can it really hold up under all this back and forth...

text.cn: 这些麻烦精……
text.en: They're giving me a headache...

text.cn: 出不去了！这机关得一直转才行！
text.en: We're trapped! This mechanism has to keep turning nonstop!

text.cn: 那“汤汤大王”，何时才能逮捕归案啊？
text.en: When will they throw "Chief Tangtang" into the slammer?

text.cn: 收拾麻烦？不如直接把那群麻烦精全收拾了！
text.en: Deal with trouble? Might as well just get rid of them all!

text.cn: 这块地儿不能放给它们！
text.en: We can't let them have this land!

text.cn: 唉，可算……
text.en: *Sigh*, finally...

text.cn: 赶紧出去看看又少了多少东西！
text.en: Go outside NOW and check how much more is missing!

text.cn: 管理员？那是管理员？
text.en: Endmin? That's the Endministrator?

text.cn: 存那么多东西在这儿，不是把贼往家里带嘛……
text.en: Storing so much here is just an invitation for thieves...

text.cn: 姑奶奶，可别再来了！
text.en: Miss, please don't come back again!

text.cn: 多谢，多谢。
text.en: Thanks a lot!

text.cn: 好身手啊，大当家这次是捡到真宝了！
text.en: Impressive skills! Chief found a real treasure this time!

text.cn: 那些水花子哪儿冒出来的……
text.en: Where did those splatters come from...

text.cn: 逃过一劫……谢谢你们。
text.en: Phew, that was a narrow escape... Thank you so much.

text.cn: 之前混哪儿的，这么轻松就把水花子搞定了？！
text.en: Who are you guys? You took down those splatters so easily!

text.cn: 破水花子，我弄死你！
text.en: Damn splatters, I'll end you!

text.cn: 希望食物储备没受影响……
text.en: Hope the food supplies weren't affected...

text.cn: 阮哥和二姑娘怎么把外人领进来了？
text.en: Why did Big Bro and Younger Dame bring outsiders in?

text.cn: 没你们，靠我们自己也能解决……
text.en: We could've handled it ourselves...

text.cn: 之前没见过你们，武陵来的？
text.en: I've never seen you before. You from Wuling?

text.cn: 有谁看到我的宝贝儿了吗？
text.en: Has anyone seen my baby?

text.cn: 感谢你们出手相助！
text.en: Thanks for lending a hand!

text.cn: 来得太及时了。
text.en: You showed up just in time.

text.cn: 别、别过来啊，我手里有家伙的！
text.en: D-don't come any closer! I've got weapons!

text.cn: 眼前好黑……
text.en: I feel dizzy...

text.cn: 别想过来！
text.en: Don't you dare come any closer!

text.cn: 好险守住咯……这个可不能丢！
text.en: That was a close one... Can't afford to lose this!

text.cn: 明明水质数据每天都一样，还要天天测……
text.en: We test every day even though the readings never change...

text.cn: 我就知道会有人来救我们！
text.en: I knew someone would come to rescue us!

text.cn: 得赶紧检修设备……
text.en: We need to get these devices fixed, fast...

text.cn: 谢谢你们！我得赶紧回去给女儿报平安！
text.en: Thank you! I need to let my daughter know I'm safe!

text.cn: 欸，侬觉着伐，城外头搿两礼拜，一直勿大好哦？
text.en: Outside's been a mess for weeks. Watchu think?

text.cn: 哎呀，庄天师一直盯辣海，覅紧个。
text.en: Don't worry, Tianshi Zhuang is right on top of it.

text.cn: 不要怕，我会保护你的。
text.en: Don't worry. I'll keep you safe.

text.cn: 我要回家……我想妈妈……
text.en: I wanna go home... I miss my mama...

text.cn: 别急……你的伤我能处理……等我缓口气。
text.en: Patience, I can treat your wounds. I just need a break.

text.cn: 送伤员回城……往返好几趟，跑断气了……
text.en: Hoo... I carried so many wounded back to town...

text.cn: 别忙活了，你扶我起来，我自己能走回去。
text.en: Take a break. Just help me up and I'll walk back myself.

text.cn: 别担心，有我在！
text.en: Don't worry. I'm here!

text.cn: 这边由我守着，不会让你们出事的。
text.en: I'm defending this spot. Nothing will happen to you.

text.cn: 别哭了，有组长在，他们几个不会有事的。
text.en: It's okay. Our leader is here. They'd be alright.

text.cn: 呜呜……都怪我乱跑，被隔离在这边了……
text.en: Hik, hik... I should've stayed. Now I'm stuck over here...

text.cn: 啊，流血了……我是不是要死了！
text.en: ARGH! I'm bleeding! Am I gonna die?!

text.cn: 喂，别乱动了……
text.en: Hey, quit fidgeting already...

text.cn: 再动你这小口子就愈合了，没法包扎了！
text.en: Stop moving so I can at least bandage your wounds!

text.cn: 兄弟，咱们这天师桩阵列顶得住吗……
