text.en: Bro, is our Tianshi Pillar Array gonna hold...?

text.cn: 信不过我，你还信不过庄管代？
text.en: I know I suck, but at least have faith in our Viceroy.

text.cn: 这可是人家牵头设计的，稳得很！
text.en: She designed the entire setup. It's gonna work!

text.cn: 老板，别整这批货了，小命要紧啊！
text.en: Boss, just leave these goods behind. Save your skin!

text.cn: 你懂啥，等守住了，这些货可是能救人的……
text.en: You know nothing. These goods will be saving lives...

text.cn: 这位同学，赶紧去避难，外面有危险。
text.en: Evac right now, disciple. It's dangerous out here.

text.cn: 我明白……我们组还有两个女生。
text.en: I know... but we got two missing team members.

text.cn: 她们被隔在另一边了，我得去找她们！
text.en: They're trapped on the other side. I gotta find them!

text.cn: 奇怪，怎么多出来一箱，刚才清点过啊？
text.en: I just counted them. Where did this extra crate come from?

text.cn: 不行，我得再数一遍！
text.en: No. I must do a recount!

text.cn: 手脚麻利点，这么多人排着队呢！
text.en: Please hurry up. We got a huge queue going on!

text.cn: 这还得等上多久啊……
text.en: How long do we have to wait...?

text.cn: 等得我肚子都饿了。
text.en: I'm starving.

text.cn: 之前多亏你出手，不然我就躺着进医疗室了。
text.en: I'd be on a stretcher if you didn't show up.

text.cn: 好说，咱俩什么关系了，简单送点东西就成。
text.en: Come on, we're best buddies. A token gift would suffice.

text.cn: 龙泡泡“武陵队长”特典款，我就挺喜欢的。
text.en: "Captain Wuling" Chubby Lung sounds good.

text.cn: 千万别多送，什么宏山特别联名款……
text.en: And definitely "not" that Hongshan special crossover...

text.cn: 嘿，可惜了。你当时不在……
text.en: Heh. Too bad you weren't there...

text.cn: 没能见到我斩杀天使的英姿，足足十几只啊！
text.en: Should've seen me squish a dozen Aggeloi! A dozen!

text.cn: 欸，我怎么听说，有个头铁的被天使追着打。
text.en: I thought a dolt got chased around by the Aggeloi!

text.cn: 你这人咋不听劝呢，疗程没结束，不能出院！
text.en: You just can't head out! Your treatment hasn't ended!

text.cn: 嘿，我这身子骨，好得不得了……哎哟，疼！
text.en: I'm made of super tough stuff... HNGH! THE PAIN!

text.cn: 爸！不是说好躲起来，你怎么又跑出去逞强！
text.en: Just hide, Dad! Why are you charging out again?

text.cn: 还好你没出事，这不是给人巡卫添乱嘛！
text.en: My goodness. Did you get in the Watchguards' way?

text.cn: 别急……我没添乱，还帮忙引导疏散了呢……
text.en: Don't worry. I actually helped with the evac...

text.cn: 侬讲是伐，阿拉庄天师，结棍哦！
text.en: Yeah, totally. Our Tianshi Zhuang is super terrific.

text.cn: 吾觉着，伊个终末地搿管理员还老来三个！
text.en: I think that Endmin from Endfield is really something too.

text.cn: 你话呢，走去学点上战场搏杀会唔会好啲呢？学咗嘅话，下次咪可以打头阵啰！
text.en: Sigh. Maybe I should learn to fight. I could be a vanguard.

text.cn: 哈，讲呢啲，武陵城日日都有啲噉嘅大战咩……
text.en: Take it easy, buddy. Wuling is not a warzone, okay?

text.cn: 哎呀！杠！我手气来登了！
text.en: KONG! Check out my streak!

text.cn: 哦！清一色杠上开花，嘞个好巴适哦！
text.en: Heheh! Flush with a bloom on a KONG! HAHAHA!

text.cn: 不是我掏钱，是巡卫奖励……十张奖券！
text.en: Watchguard bonus incoming! Ten free gift certs!

text.cn: 嗯，你是不是瞒着我干啥了！
text.en: Hmm. Are you hiding secrets from me?

text.cn: 也没什么，就是帮巡卫打天使……才三只。
text.en: No. I helped the Watchguards and killed three buggers.

text.cn: 我没骗你们吧，天师桩阵列这回立下大功了！
text.en: See! Told you! The Tianshi Pillar Array stopped everything!

text.cn: 那时侵蚀潮掀起滔天之势，阵列硬是顶住了！
text.en: The Array took the massive Blight Tide like a champ!

text.cn: 我说过的，息壤粒子构成坚壁，屹立不倒！
text.en: A barrier of Xiranite particles never falls!

text.cn: 来，干了这杯庆功酒！我们这回胜利了！
text.en: Drink up! We won! Time to celebrate!

text.cn: 不是我煞风景，被弭队发现要挨训的。
text.en: But Captain Mi Fu doesn't like us drinking.

text.cn: 哇，是新的超级龙泡泡！
text.en: Wow. A new super Chubby Lung!

text.cn: 哇，这次是“武陵队长”特典款！
text.en: Wow. This one's the "Captain Wuling" special!

text.cn: 爸爸，我也想要！
text.en: Dad! I want one too!

text.cn: 爸爸也……也得请示妈妈才行！
text.en: Welp, Dad gotta ... get permission from Mom.

text.cn: 对面奶茶店搞新活动了，说是庆祝大战胜利……
text.en: The tea shop has a sales event to celebrate the victory.

text.cn: 购买庄天师严选口味，据说还能买一送一！
text.en: Tianshi Zhuang's Favorite. Buy one get one free!

text.cn: 不行，我们也得搞新活动才行！
text.en: No way. We gotta start our own event as well!

text.cn: 大战中见巡卫们英勇作战……我想去当巡卫！
text.en: The Watchguards fought like heroes. I wanna be one of them!

text.cn: 我还是想做材料天师，继续研学……
text.en: I prefer being a Cailiao Tianshi and focus on materials...

text.cn: 你们太善变了，我还要养驮兽，坚持初心！
text.en: Stop changing your focus. Burdenbeast is still my thing!

text.cn: 听说了吗，庄天师回学校了……
text.en: Hey, I heard Tianshi Zhuang is back in the Academy...

text.cn: 材料研究专业开了很多门新课！
text.en: Materials Science just posted a lot of new courses!

text.cn: 我们加把劲，抢到庄天师的课。
text.en: Gotta apply for Tianshi Zhuang's course.

text.cn: 绝不能输给那些本部交流生……
text.en: I'll show those transfer disciples from HQ...

text.cn: 避难时，遇到一位从四号谷地来的植物学家。
text.en: I met a botanist from Valley IV during the evac.

text.cn: 外面的天地，竟有那么多没见过的风景。
text.en: There are plenty of places I never visited before.

text.cn: 等毕业后，我们一起去看看吧！
text.en: We'll go on a tour once we graduate!

text.cn: 欸，师兄，怎么是你！我明明赶早到的……
text.en: Can't believe it's you, Bro! I thought I got here early...

text.cn: 怎么，不是约好一起做小组作业吗？
text.en: Why so surprised? I thought we got a team project.

text.cn: 可没到时间呢，师兄你来这么早干什么？
text.en: But this is way too early! Why are you here already?

text.cn: 工程学作业，我不早点来准备，你们能行吗？
text.en: 'Cos it's engineering. Can I trust you with early prep?

text.cn: 想和师兄独处才早到，小豪怎么在？
text.en: Why is Xiao Hao here? There goes our private moment.

text.cn: 老师，我搞不来材料！顶在前线更适合我……
text.en: Materials Science isn't my thing. I prefer the frontlines.

text.cn: 不用息壤材料拦住侵蚀潮，哪儿还有前线！
text.en: The material called Xiranite gave you the frontlines, kid.

text.cn: 大战时你跑去哪里了！到处都找不到人！
text.en: Couldn't find you anywhere during battle! Where did you go?

text.cn: 我遇到避难的人群，去帮忙引导疏散了……
text.en: I ran into a crowd and helped with the evac...

text.cn: 呜呜，我想去看羽兽……
text.en: *Sobs*... I wanna see the fowlbeasts...

text.cn: 侵蚀潮退却了，羽兽会回来的……
text.en: The Blight Tide has receded. The fowls will return...

text.cn: 我没骗你！真有个老天师，就在侵蚀潮前！
text.en: I'm being serious! An Old Tianshi went to the Blight Tide!

text.cn: 我眼睁睁看着他挥鞭把侵蚀潮抽成了两半……
text.en: He used his whip and cleaved the tide in two...

text.cn: 哈，我劝你去找大夫挂个号，查查视力。
text.en: Hah. A physician should check your eyes.

text.cn: 听说了吗？这回咱们要加薪了！
text.en: Hey! We're getting a raise!

text.cn: 你从哪儿打听的啊，消息保真吗？
text.en: You serious? Where did you hear that from?

text.cn: 我舅姥爷那儿，说巡卫作战有功，统统涨薪！
text.en: My uncle. Said the Watchguards fought well and deserved it!

text.cn: 你舅姥爷说的，那只能信一半，不能再多了。
text.en: Your uncle? The old man is fifty percent unreliable.

text.cn: 您请我的这点钱，可没说一人要干两人活儿！
text.en: You paid me buckberries yet expect me to do two jobs?

text.cn: 别催了，要再快，得给我涨工资！
text.en: Sheesh. If you want speed, pay me more!

text.cn: 唉，技术局完全复工要等到什么时候啊？
text.en: When will they fix the bureau of applied tech?

text.cn: 要是能修好侧门的息壤导流轨道就好了。
text.en: Wish someone could fix the side gate's Xiranflow Track.

text.cn: 只剩这扇门了，打开它就能完全恢复运行了。
text.en: Open that last gate. It'll get things working again.

text.cn: 先得修复这扇门附近的息壤导流轨道系统。
text.en: Gotta fix the Xiranflow Track System near this gate.

text.cn: 同学们，息壤是武陵城发展的重中之重。
text.en: Disciples, Xiranite is essential to Wuling's development.

text.cn: 在这儿你们能学习到息壤块定型的原理。
text.en: I shall teach you Xiranslab fixing and shaping.

text.cn: 我得认真记下来！
text.en: I gotta jot down these notes!

text.cn: 息壤能量定型的完整流程……
text.en: The complete process of Xiranite energy fixation...

text.cn: 不能错过《宏山洗剑录》的最新连载……
text.en: Can't miss the latest The Spirit of the Hongshan Sword.

text.cn: 让我看看剑圣究竟能否一剑劈开生死路！
text.en: Gotta see if the Sword Saint can turn things around!

text.cn: 这回太危险了，侵蚀潮遮天蔽日！
text.en: This Blight Tide is dangerous! It blotted out the skies!

text.cn: 那个直攻总桩的敌人更加可怕……
text.en: The one who attacked the Main Pillar was even worse...

text.cn: 甭管侵蚀潮还是敌人，武陵不都顶住了嘛！
text.en: Blight Tide and enemy boss? Pfft. Wuling fought them off.

text.cn: 姐姐太厉害了，我长大也要当巡卫！
text.en: You're so cool! I wanna be a watchguard when I grow up!

text.cn: 多亏你们保护，我们才逃得出来。
text.en: We escaped with our lives thanks to you!

text.cn: 老人家，您还是去诊所检查一下吧。
text.en: You really should get a health check.

text.cn: 老师，这一次咱们的天师桩阵列立大功了。
text.en: Instructor, our Tianshi Pillar Array saved the day.

text.cn: 侵蚀读数峰值时，部分天师桩阵列失效了。
text.en: Part of the array went down when Blight readings peaked.

text.cn: 咱们的研究还是有缺漏，得解决问题。
text.en: Our research probably missed something. Time for a fix.

text.cn: 我们队这次拦下了十三只天使！
text.en: Our team took down thirteen Aggeloi!

text.cn: 更难得的是全队上下几乎没有伤亡。
text.en: And we barely suffered any casualties.

text.cn: 都全须全尾，说明咱们研发的装备靠谱。
text.en: No horns, ears, or tails were harmed. Our gear is legit.

text.cn: 别担心了，危机已经过去了。
text.en: Don't worry. The crisis has ended.

text.cn: 再大的潮水，武陵都会屹立不倒。
text.en: No tide is big enough to bring down Wuling.

text.cn: 庄天师那一剑，无人能挡！
text.en: Tianshi Zhuang's blade was unstoppable!

text.cn: 我觉得管理员的源石控制更加关键……
text.en: The Endmin's Originium Arts were more crucial...

text.cn: 管理员和庄天师，缺了谁都不行。
text.en: The Endmin and the Viceroy are truly indispensable.

text.cn: 排队的人也太多了吧……赶得及吗？
text.en: This queue is massive... Can we make it?

text.cn: 还是得检查一下才能放心……
text.en: I gotta get checked to feel safe...

text.cn: 各位请放心，我会按顺序叫号的。
text.en: Don't worry. I'll call the queue numbers.

text.cn: 顺便帮队里多带些药吧。
text.en: I should get more meds for the team.

text.cn: 爸爸，今天看病的人好多啊。
text.en: Dada, so many people are sick today.

text.cn: 别担心，大夫可厉害了，会治好每个人的。
text.en: Don't worry. Our physician will heal everyone.

text.cn: 后面的患者请不要急，一个一个来。
text.en: Patients, one at a time. Please don't rush.

text.cn: 各位请有序排队，今天患者比较多。
text.en: I know there's a crowd today, but please queue properly.

text.cn: 别担心，今天的门诊时间会延长……
text.en: Visiting hours will be extended for today.

text.cn: 每个人都能得到妥善治疗。
text.en: Everyone will be getting proper treatment.

text.cn: 当初就劝过他，不要逞强，安全第一。
text.en: I told him to be safe and stop being so hotheaded.

text.cn: 他骨子里就爱逞强，何况这次也是为了救人。
text.en: But it's in his bones. He just gotta save more people.

text.cn: 唉，摊上这么一位，只能盼他早日康复吧。
text.en: I feel for you. Hope he gets better for your sake.

text.cn: 你别担心，已经和老师打过招呼了。
text.en: Don't worry. The instructor just notified us.

text.cn: 好好养伤，早点回到学校……
text.en: Focus on recovery and return to the Academy when you can.

text.cn: 班上的同学都帮你整好课堂笔记了。
text.en: We compiled the lecture notes for you.

text.cn: 弭弗，有些工作之后得交给你负责了……
text.en: Mi Fu, you'll be in charge of certain things afterwards.

text.cn: 留书呗，头儿你不是不喜欢当面讲吗？
text.en: I thought you didn't like face-to-face discussions, boss.

text.cn: 你生气了……？
text.en: Are you angry...?

text.cn: 哼，你是头儿，我可不敢。
text.en: Hmph. Get mad at my boss? I'm not that brave.

text.cn: 可算是忙完了，一起去吃点什么吗？
text.en: It's finally done. Should we grab something to eat?

text.cn: 头儿你吃吧，我不饿。
text.en: Go ahead, boss. I'm not hungry.

text.cn: 忙了一整天，怎么会不饿？
text.en: Not hungry? But you've been busy all day.

text.cn: 你不是留书要把武陵托付给我？
text.en: Someone left a letter. Said I'll be in charge of Wuling.

text.cn: 责任重大啊，我怎么好辜负你的期望呢？
text.en: That's tough work. Can't let that someone down.

text.cn: 我知道，你因为之前的事怪我。
text.en: I know you're still blaming me for what happened back then.

text.cn: 但事情紧急，我来不及与大家告别。
text.en: But it was urgent. I didn't have time to say goodbyes.

text.cn: 我从没怪过你，头儿。
text.en: Blame you? Never, boss.

text.cn: ……我只怪我自己。
text.en: I only blame myself.

text.cn: 怪我在这件事上，帮不到你。
text.en: I blame myself for being unable to help you in your thing.

text.cn: 青竹口味软糖限时返场，嘎嘎便宜！都来尝口呗！
text.en: Bamboo gummies are back for a limited time! Come give them a try!

text.cn: 妈妈，软糖滋滋地甜！
text.en: Mom, the gummies are so sweet and fizzy!

text.cn: 喂，来试下哩涯这条能量棒嘞，食哩有料，撞到天使都唔少惊哦！
text.en: Bite this energy bar, and not even an Aggelos can scare you!

text.cn: 再斗两个人嘛？我去城外头劈个台子血战到底。
text.en: I'll go set up a table and let's play til sunrise!

text.cn: 要得要得，刚好认到两个娃娃儿互相有点意思！
text.en: Sounds good! I'll get a couple of young folks to join us.

text.cn: 不要插队，最新主题还剩很多！
text.en: No cutting in line! Plenty of the new theme left!

text.cn: 刮奖可以去旁边的桌子！
text.en: Scratch your tickets at the table over there!

text.cn: 一天天的，就知道来抽奖，浪费时间浪费钱！
text.en: All you do all day is come waste money on the lottery!

text.cn: 其实我……中了。
text.en: I, uh, actually ... won.

text.cn: 嗯，还浪费了运气！
text.en: Yeah, and you're wasting your luck too!

text.cn: 人人都知道天师桩阵列能阻挡侵蚀和天使，但——
text.en: We know the Tianshi Pillar Array holds back danger, but...

text.cn: 知道为什么阵列的间隙这么大，它们都进不来吗？
text.en: Know why they can't get through the wide gaps?

text.cn: 是息壤粒子！那些流动的粒子构筑了真正的坚壁！
text.en: It's the Xiranite particles! They form the real barrier!

text.cn: 小庄她应该已经回来了吧？
text.en: Zhuang should be back by now, right?

text.cn: 宏山的店也去过好几家，都没这家味道正。
text.en: None match the authentic taste of this place in Hongshan.

text.cn: 这可是潘叔的老店啊！难得回来一趟，多吃几顿吧。
text.en: Make sure to eat at Uncle Pan's place a few more times!

text.cn: 我也想喝红红的汤……
text.en: I wanna try that red soup too...

text.cn: 技术开发局、天师府学院、选剑局……都不太好找。
text.en: So many bureaus ... so hard to find.

text.cn: 武陵城实在太大，没人带，真容易迷路……
text.en: Wuling's huge. Prone to get lost without a guide...

text.cn: 唉，这趟从塞梦珂过来交流学习，开局不顺啊。
text.en: This exchange trip from Simonch's off to a rough start.

text.cn: 看，又有超级龙泡泡勇士金色特典款！
text.en: Look, Chubby Lung's Warrior Gold Edition is back!

text.cn: 上个月你就有了，这次轮到我要个更大更新的！
text.en: You got one last month! My turn for a bigger, newer one!

text.cn: 爸爸，我都想要。
text.en: Papa, I want them all!

text.cn: 说好了只是看看——欸，怎么有初版复刻？！
text.en: Just looking... Wait, a first edition reprint?!

text.cn: 感觉对面新上的奶茶卖得不太好呀……
text.en: New bubble tea across the street's not selling well...

text.cn: 下个月店里上茶饮的规划还是推迟吧。
text.en: Let's postpone next month's tea drink plans.

text.cn: 巡卫的武器需求量又增加了，上升趋势非常明显。
text.en: The watchguards' weapon demand's rising again, pretty sharp.

text.cn: 产能短期内提不了，晓雾姐让我们实验组想想办法。
text.en: Can't do short-term. Xiaowu wants our lab to find a way.

text.cn: 这批新枪手感就是好！
text.en: These new lances feel great!

text.cn: 动作慢点儿，我得记录材料反应。
text.en: Slow down, I need to record the material reactions.

text.cn: 打得好！
text.en: Well done!

text.cn: 这俩小子真是在试武器吗……
text.en: Are these two really testing weapons...

text.cn: 我有了个灵感，为什么不用天使残骸制作武器呢？
text.en: Wait. Why don't we make weapons with Aggeloi wreckage?

text.cn: 没有这么简单……
text.en: It's not that simple...

text.cn: 先生，选剑局尊重每一位市民的奇思妙想。
text.en: Sir, HS.Swords respects every citizen's creativity.

text.cn: 欢迎您在开放日过来，到时候我带您参观一下。
text.en: Feel free to visit on our open day. I'll give you a tour.

text.cn: 以后报哪个专业比较好呢……
text.en: Which major should I apply for later...

text.cn: 考校近在眼前，我还有那么多课题没解决！
text.en: The exam's almost here, and I still have so many issues!

text.cn: 这水里有鳞吗？
text.en: Are there any fins in this water?

text.cn: 息流系统里自然是没有的。
text.en: Naturally, there aren't any in the Xiranflow system.

text.cn: 那你在钓什么？
text.en: Then what are you trying to catch?

text.cn: 钓闲人。你看，又上钩一个。
text.en: Idlers. Look, another one just took the bait.

text.cn: 赶紧结束吧……
text.en: When will it come to an end...

text.cn: 我就不是这块料，只想早点回去养驮兽……
text.en: It's not my thing. I wanna go back and raise burdenbeasts.

text.cn: 今年专程从宏科院本部来交流的人变多了啊……
text.en: More exchange folks from the HAS HQ this year, huh.

text.cn: 毕竟这两年从我们这儿去本部交流的人也不少。
text.en: Plenty of our folks have gone to HQ on exchange too.

text.cn: 息壤堰的那边是什么呀？
text.en: What's on the other side of the Xiranite Dam?

text.cn: 侵蚀？天使？应该和我们城外的情况很像吧。
text.en: Blight? Aggeloi? Pretty much the same as the outside.

text.cn: 你想去看的话，我陪你。
text.en: I'll come with you if you're curious.

text.cn: 好困啊……下一堂课是几点来着？
text.en: I'm falling asleep... When's the next class?

text.cn: 今天课又排满了，在这儿凑合一下吧。
text.en: Classes are packed again. Let's just grab a quick bite here.

text.cn: 一！
text.en: ONE!

text.cn: 二！
text.en: TWO!
THREE—

text.cn: 三。
text.en: Three.

text.cn: 你报错了！
text.en: WRONG!

text.cn: 谁缺课了，怎么人数点来点去都差一个？
text.en: Who's absent? We're missing one no matter how we count!

text.cn: 再睡会吧，老师肯定不会费力点名！
text.en: Sleep a bit longer. No way they'll bother taking attendance!

text.cn: 教材里有说过，雷法的本质是内在和大地化为一体。
text.en: It says the Thunder Arts involve becoming one with the land.

text.cn: 是不是有点太玄了……我先感受一下。
text.en: Sounds a bit too mystical... Let me get a feel first.

text.cn: 等等，雷声？！
text.en: Wait... Thunder?!

text.cn: 你感受一下，就成了？快把雷引到水里，别伤到自己。
text.en: Channel the lightning into the water. Stay safe.

text.cn: 控水塑形得先手稳。
text.en: Steady hands shape water first.

text.cn: 我可是从环塔商会派来交流的术师手里偷学了点经验。
text.en: I picked up some tricks from that caster sent by the TGCC.

text.cn: 但你不觉得，有点酥酥麻麻的……
text.en: But don't you feel that tingling...

text.cn: 总感觉是电流？哪儿漏电了？
text.en: Feels like electric current? Where's the leak?

text.cn: 特意赶来武陵看息壤堰，果然壮观……
text.en: Came all the way to see the Xiranite Dam. Impressive.

text.cn: 得有多大魄力才能想出用这种办法遏制裂隙！
text.en: Only a great mind can propose this rift containment method!

text.cn: 庄天师，求你保佑我通过考校！
text.en: Tianshi Zhuang, please let me pass the exam!

text.cn: 师兄，其实我这次约你出来是想问……
text.en: I actually asked you out to ask about...

text.cn: 小组作业分队？刚好我也约了小豪，一起吧。
text.en: Group assignment teams? I asked Xiao Hao too. Let's team up.

text.cn: 到底该怎么向她表白呀……
text.en: How do I even confess to her...

text.cn: 小豪，打直球！长痛不如短痛！
text.en: Xiao Hao, be direct! Quick pain beats long suffering!

text.cn: 但要讲究氛围！小豪，试试约她去桃花树下。
text.en: But set the mood! Xiao Hao, ask her under the peach tree.

text.cn: 老师，我、我想换课题组……
text.en: Professor, I, I want to switch research groups...

text.cn: 我们项目可是庄天师牵头的院管项目啊。
text.en: But our project is led by Tianshi Zhuang!

text.cn: 我、我实在不适合搞材料！
text.en: I... I'm just not cut out for materials research!

text.cn: 你们分享一下这周学习的论文，谁先来？
text.en: So, this week's research papers. Who wants to go first?

text.cn: 我读到一篇十几年前的热门论文，潘远天师写的。
text.en: I read a paper from over a decade ago by Tianshi Pan Yuan.

text.cn: 北部禁区的资料都在这儿了……
text.en: All the data on the North Wuling Exclusion Zone is here.

text.cn: 我得查清十年前科考站那场事故的细节！
text.en: Must find out about the Science Station incident back then!

text.cn: 你故意定了能看到天师府学院的位置？
text.en: You picked a seat with a view of the TBA on purpose?

text.cn: 都请假了，为什么不挑个远点的地方？！
text.en: Why not pick somewhere else since you're already on leave?!

text.cn: 呜呜，今天不是亲子活动嘛！
text.en: But today's family day!

text.cn: 对面的人一定想请我喝一杯……
text.en: That person across must want to buy me a drink...

text.cn: 对面的人一直盯着我干嘛？
text.en: Why's that person across staring at me?

text.cn: 你以前做信使的时候，还去过塔罗斯城？
text.en: You've been to Talos City as a Messenger?

text.cn: 对呀，可惜那座城市的建设被搁置很多很多年了。
text.en: Yeah, too bad its construction stalled long ago.

text.cn: 今年有你加入，我们比赛的胜算更大了！
text.en: With you this year, our odds just got better!

text.cn: 再比一轮？
text.en: Another match?

text.cn: 休息一下吧，别赛前受伤！
text.en: Nah, let's take a break. Better safe than sorry!

text.cn: 别过去，那边被天使袭击了！
text.en: Don't go! That area's been hit by Aggeloi!

text.cn: 幸好有天师帮我们撤出来……
text.en: Thank goodness the Tianshi helped us evacuate.

text.cn: 今年的比赛我们输定了……
text.en: We're doomed to lose this year...

text.cn: 坚持到终点就是胜利，我会陪着你。
text.en: Just reaching the end is victory. I'll stay with you.

text.cn: 教练，今年的比赛有没有什么奇招？
text.en: Coach, any surprise tactics for this year's match?

text.cn: 脚踏实地，别想走歪路。
text.en: Stay grounded. Don't even think about shortcuts.

text.cn: 东边的太阳别探头！
text.en: Sun in the east, stay out of sight!

text.cn: 竹笋的小角会戳穿楼！
text.en: Bamboo shoots, don't poke the building's height!

text.cn: 源石虫咕噜排好队！
text.en: Originium slugs, line up neat and tight!

text.cn: 跟着节奏扭呀扭！
text.en: Move to the beat, sway left and right!

text.cn: 要忍不住跟着跳起来了——
text.en: Can't help but start dancing along!

text.cn: 羽兽变少了。城外的情况已经影响到生态了吗？
text.en: Fewer fowlbeasts. Is the outside affecting the ecology?

text.cn: 看病、逛街、入学、住宿，下来个里问啰！
text.en: Health, shopping, admissions, or boarding — ask me anything!

text.cn: 青竹味不是你家爆款吗？怎么反复下架上架？
text.en: Isn't that your top seller? Why keep taking it down?

text.cn: 横掂都挨到而家嘞，唔争在嚟多杯，顶埋天光算数！
text.en: We've made it this far, let's just tough it out till dawn!

text.cn: 唔使咁搏嘅，今年唔得咪出年再嚟过啰！
text.en: Why so serious? Just try again next year if you fail.

text.cn: 快出来，息流系统的水大家都要用的！
text.en: Hurry up! Everyone needs to use the Xiranflow's water!

text.cn: 不要！我和人约好要顺着水流走遍全城！
text.en: No! I promised to follow the flow and see the whole city!

text.cn: 让他玩吧，反正里面的水会被息壤净化。
text.en: Let him play. The Xiranite will purify the water anyway.

text.cn: 是你和他约好要顺着水流走遍全城？
text.en: You promised to follow the flow and see the whole city?

text.cn: 对呀！他说到做到，我喜欢他！
text.en: Yeah! He's a keeper, I like him!

text.cn: 侵蚀怎么会毫无预警，突然蔓延到观测站？
text.en: How could the Blight spread to the monitoring center?

text.cn: 先回去上课吧，师兄也没讲错什么呀？
text.en: Go to class for now. He's not wrong, is he?

text.cn: 他能力还不如我就是最大的错误。
text.en: His biggest mistake is that he sucks.

text.cn: 爬不动了，还是去旁边坐电梯吧。
text.en: I'm out. Let's go take the elevator.

text.cn: 上去就是天师府学院了……
text.en: The TBA is right up there...

text.cn: 多休息一会儿再回去上课吧……
text.en: Let's take a break before going back to class...

text.cn: 庄天师的课题组还招生吗？
text.en: Is Tianshi Zhuang's research group still accepting students?

text.cn: 好像材料研究所的课题组都招满了……
text.en: The Institute of Materials Science is probably full...

text.cn: 我一定要去旁听庄天师的公开课！
text.en: I have to sit in on Tianshi Zhuang's public lecture!

text.cn: 嘿嘿，庄天师一般都走这儿去学院……
text.en: Heh, Tianshi Zhuang usually takes this path to the academy.

text.cn: 到底是谁设计了这么多台阶……
text.en: Who thought it was a good idea to design so many steps?!

text.cn: 还是这里清静些，方兴衢对我来说太吵了。
text.en: Finally some peace of mind. Fangxing Avenue is way too loud.

text.cn: 毕竟上面也算是武陵城的核心区域了。
text.en: It is the core area of Wuling up there after all.

text.cn: 这个天桩充能站是不是该维护了？
text.en: This sky pole charging station needs some maintenance.

text.cn: 武陵城十年就发展成安尼哦，全靠息壤！
text.en: Xiranite! That's how they built Wuling in a decade!

text.cn: 我倒是感觉，庄天师的功劳上大。
text.en: I'd rather give credit to Tianshi Zhuang, though.

text.cn: 安全起见，请尽快从主道入城。
text.en: Be safe. Use the main road and get in the city now.

text.cn: ……里面还有人没撤出来吗？
text.en: ...Is there still anyone inside who hasn't evacuated?

text.cn: 前面区域很危险，暂时不向游客开放。
text.en: Area closed to visitors. Things are getting dangerous.

text.cn: 稍、稍安勿躁，等首墩区域的例行维护完成再去参观吧。
text.en: Easy. Just wait till they're done with Marker Stone repairs.

text.cn: 各位从本部来武陵交流的同学们，这就是息壤堰。
text.en: A warm welcome to all students from HQ. This is the Xiranite Dam.

text.cn: 息壤堰是目前武陵城内最重要的息壤设施之一……
text.en: It stands as one of the most critical Xiranite facilities in the entire city...

text.cn: 也是你们在接下来一学期会更深入研究学习的对象。
text.en: ...and it will be the main focus of your advanced studies this semester.

text.cn: 甚至，你们都有机会进到息壤堰内部做实验。
text.en: Moreover, each of you may get to actually run experiments within the Xiranite Dam.

text.cn: 当然，这需要经过严格的程序审批和安全演练。
text.en: But of course, that entails passing rigorous approval procedures and safety training.

text.cn: 抱歉，息壤中心实验室事关重大，需要权限才能进入。
text.en: You need clearance to enter the Xiranite Central Lab.

text.cn: 这都是用息壤建成的？
text.en: This whole thing is made from Xiranite?

text.cn: 好壮观，这得消耗多少息壤呀……
text.en: It's massive... How much Xiranite did it take to make this...?

text.cn: 进入息壤堰内部……
text.en: Run experiments within the Xiranite Dam...

text.cn: 那里面，是不是离裂隙更近啊……
text.en: Wouldn't its interior be ... closer to the rift?

text.cn: 我爸说过，这趟来，必须得进去看看！
text.en: My father told me I'm not coming back unless I've seen the inside for myself!

text.cn: 齐天师，情况如何了？
text.en: How's the situation, Tianshi Qi?

text.cn: 我们尽可能撤离了所有人，但是设备……
text.en: We evacuated everyone we could, but the devices...

text.cn: 变故很突然，不是你们的问题。我们会解决的。
text.en: This was sudden. It's not your fault. We'll handle it.

text.cn: 但千万小心里面的天使，它很危险！
text.en: But be aware of the Aggeloi in there! Don't mess with them.

text.cn: 这些天使，都是从观测站方向冒出来的。
text.en: These Aggeloi, they all emerged from the monitoring center.

text.cn: 还有人没撤出来，得赶紧去帮忙！
text.en: There are still people trapped inside! We need to help now!

text.cn: 那个人连阮哥都保不住，真会管我们吗……
text.en: That person couldn't even protect Ruan... Would they really care about us?

text.cn: 断桥总算修好了。
text.en: The bridge is finally fixed.

text.cn: 这桥就不该修！就断着！看看阮一做了啥！
text.en: Should've left it broken! Look what Ruan Yi did!

text.cn: 方兴衡！方兴衡！就念方兴衡！
text.en: It's FANCY! FANCY AVENUE! I'll only read it this way!

text.cn: 不仅念，我还要上武陵把路牌摘了都改成衡！
text.en: I'm gonna change the signs of Wuling to FANCY!

text.cn: 不教了！朽木难雕，还是弭队好，一点就通。
text.en: I give up. Captain Mi was a far better student.

text.cn: 说谁比不上红脸婆！回来！重教！
text.en: Better?! THAT MAD WOMAN?! Get back here and teach me again!

text.cn: 四个月！三棵树！一棵树每月产五颗果！
text.en: You get five fruits in a month. What do you get after four?

text.cn: 你怎么算出来十八颗的？！
text.en: How did you end up with just two fruits?

text.cn: 果子放久容易坏，我时不时要吃两个啊。
text.en: I ate the rest, duh. Nobody keeps fruits around for months.

text.cn: 哎哟，小祖宗……可是让你算明白了。
text.en: My goodness... You're being so difficult.

text.cn: 你说，清波寨外是什么样啊？
text.en: Say, what are things like outside Qingbo Stockade?

text.cn: 清波寨外有宏山，宏山外还有工团、商会……
text.en: You'll find Hongshan, UWST, and TGCC outside Qingbo...

text.cn: 风土人情各不一样，你想问哪个？
text.en: Each of them is quite different. Which one interests you?

text.cn: 我只想知道，外面还有好吃的小河鳞吗？
text.en: I just wanna know if I can get yummy little fins out there.

text.cn: 那些离开寨子的人，他们还吃得到吗？
text.en: Many left the Stockade. Dunno if they can still have that.

text.cn: 先混着，肯定能找到机会动手。
text.en: Lay low. Wait for our chance to strike.

text.cn: 祝我活下去……
text.en: Just let me survive this...

text.cn: 以前这里不是这样……
text.en: It wasn't like this before...

text.cn: 阮哥一走，我们更没希望了……
text.en: With Ruan gone ... there's no hope left.

text.cn: 祖泉被搞成这样，阮一死有余辜！
text.en: The Ancestral Spring's ruined! Ruan Yi deserved to die!

text.cn: 他已经走了，算了吧。
text.en: He's gone. Let it be.

text.cn: 我更担心大当家的情绪……
text.en: I'm more worried about the chief...

text.cn: 唉，阮一也的确为我们做了很多的事情。
text.en: But Ruan Yi did do a lot for us...

text.cn: 想去更上面？从围栏破损处跳进去就行。
text.en: Wanna go higher? Just jump through the broken part.

text.cn: 寨子怎么会变成这样……
text.en: How did our village come to this...

text.cn: 同意动手的兄弟都准备好了吗？
text.en: Is everyone ready to move?

text.cn: 嗯。阮哥的仇，一定要报，哪怕是二姑娘。
text.en: We'll avenge him. Even if it's Younger Dame.

text.cn: 还有人没放出来吗？
text.en: Anyone still trapped?

text.cn: 还有很多失踪的人，也不知道去了哪儿……
text.en: So many missing ... where did they all go?

text.cn: 火……天上……船……屁股……
text.en: Fire... Sky... Boat... End...

text.cn: 据说那边还有奇景……
text.en: They say there's a wonder over there...

text.cn: 管他洪水滔天，钓点儿鳞先。
text.en: Let the flood come. I'm angling.

text.cn: 什么日子照过，都是屁话！
text.en: "Life goes on"? Blighted nonsense!

text.cn: 这些武陵的竹筏还挺好用。
text.en: These Wuling rafts work surprisingly well.

text.cn: 我保护你们，没人能妨碍我们修缮寨子！
text.en: I'll cover you. No one stops our repairs!

text.cn: 大当家明明也是为了寨子好……
text.en: The chief only wants what's best for us...

text.cn: 得赶紧把这些铁笼弄走！
text.en: Get these cages out of here! Now!

text.cn: 阮哥也走了……
text.en: Even Ruan's gone...

text.cn: 幸好，我留下的水竹铃都还完好。
text.en: Thank goodness my bamboo water chimes are safe.

text.cn: 阮哥当时为什么要这么做……
text.en: Why did Ruan do it...?

text.cn: 都巡视十次了，我真顶不住了……
text.en: I'm finished. I already performed ten patrols...

text.cn: 蓄水站很重要嘛。再说，人孔工都没喊累呢！
text.en: Mr. Kong is still working too. This is an important place.

text.cn: 能在永垂壁上留名，真是件光荣的事。
text.en: Having one's name etched on the Eternal Wall is glorious.

text.cn: 我倒希望别再有牺牲了。
text.en: I just hope we stop getting KIA reports.

text.cn: 别担心，你孩子现在过得很好。
text.en: Don't worry. Your kid is doing fine.

text.cn: 爷爷，结束了吗？我想去栖云林地找念念玩！
text.en: Grampa, I wanna play with Babbles at Cloudrest Woods!

text.cn: 得留在这儿继续清理周围的天使……
text.en: Gotta stay here and take out the remaining Aggeloi...

text.cn: 妈妈，我想爸爸了，他什么时候回来啊？
text.en: Mama, I miss Dada. When is he coming back?

text.cn: 芳芳乖，爸爸的工作是照料首墩，保护大家。
text.en: Listen, Fangfang. Dada has to work at the Marker Stone.

text.cn: 老方！太好了，没想到我们俩能在这儿碰到。
text.en: Old Fang! Never expected to meet you here.

text.cn: 是啊，谁能想到首墩会遇到这样的意外……
text.en: Yeah. Nobody expected an accident at the Marker Stone.

text.cn: 妈妈，广播里的首墩，是爸爸上班的地方吧？
text.en: Mama, they mentioned Marker Stone on radio. Is Dada there?

text.cn: 芳芳，别担心。爸爸他不会出事的，一定不会……
text.en: It's alright, Fangfang. Dada will be alright...

text.cn: 总算忙完这个阶段了，糟糕——
text.en: We can finally end this phase. Wait—

text.cn: 我得发条消息报平安，老婆和芳芳一定很担心……
text.en: Should message my wife and Fangfang and tell them I'm safe.

text.cn: 妈妈，爸爸有说什么时候回来吗？
text.en: Mama, when is Dada coming back? Did he say anything?

text.cn: 芳芳，妈妈过些天带你去首墩看爸爸吧……
text.en: Fangfang, why don't we visit Dada at the Marker Stone...?

text.cn: 老方，给你介绍下，这是我老婆和儿子。
text.en: Old Fang, this is my lady, and my boy.

text.cn: 不知道啥时候才能忙完，见到老婆和闺女……
text.en: I hope this is over so I can see my wife and baby girl...

text.cn: 乖女儿，这次我带你去首墩探望爸爸。
text.en: Alright, baby. Let's go see Dada at the Marker Stone.

text.cn: 我们两个给爸爸一个大惊喜好不好？
text.en: We'll give Dada a big surprise.

text.cn: 哇，这是爸爸修好的东西吗，好厉害啊！
text.en: Wow. Did Dada fix this? So awesome!

text.cn: 没错，这是爸爸和其他叔叔阿姨一起修好的。
text.en: Yeah. Dada fixed this with the other grownups.

text.cn: 巨兽心脏修缮工作由武陵和终末地配合进行。
text.en: Feranmut Heart remediation is an Wuling-Endfield project.

text.cn: 关系到息壤堰的安全，请大家务必认真对待。
text.en: The Xiranite Dam depends on it. We must do it well.

text.cn: “苦恼的天师”，没想到连老师们也在其中。
text.en: "The Perplexed Tianshi". Our Instructor's featured in it.

text.cn: 这就是老师讲过的“济事人为本”理念吗？
text.en: Is this what he meant by being "people-oriented"?

text.cn: 修缮并非单纯的技术问题，涵盖不同领域……
text.en: Remediation is not a simple technical issue...

text.cn: 听得头晕，什么时候能休息啊？
text.en: I'm lost in confusion. Can we take a break?

text.cn: 这就是心音仪的功效吗？卜圆老师好厉害啊。
text.en: Is this the Cardiograph? Instructor Bu Yuan is incredible!

text.cn: 我得把频率特征总结出来，一定能帮到老师。
text.en: Gotta identify the frequency profile features.

text.cn: 我看别人都在研究，咱们在这儿喝茶不好吧。
text.en: Everyone's working. A tea break won't look good on us.

text.cn: 这不是偷懒啊，是效法卜天师，寻找灵感。
text.en: Look, we're getting inspirations using Tianshi Bu's method.

text.cn: 工作完成得很好，尤其是你提交的特征材料。
text.en: Job well done. The profile features are great.

text.cn: 大大推进了研究进度，老师们都在夸你呢。
text.en: We made good progress with it. The instructors are pleased.

text.cn: 其他同学都在努力，你倒好，跑到这边偷懒！
text.en: Everyone's working hard except for you, slacker.

text.cn: 老师，我错了……饶过我吧，我肯定改！
text.en: Forgive me, Instructor... I'll change my ways!

text.cn: 天气真好，偷得浮生半日闲啊……
text.en: Fine weather. Perfect for a cozy break...

text.cn: 我得躺好点，别被老师逮住……
text.en: Fingers crossed that my instructor won't catch me lying here...

text.cn: 嘘，要安静点，大鳞会被吓跑的。
text.en: Shh. Quiet. Don't scare off the mega-fin.

text.cn: 好，我不出声……
text.en: Fine. I'll stop talking...

text.cn: 哈哈，没想到我也能参与巨兽心脏的修缮。
text.en: Hah. I got to join the Feranmut Heart Remediation project.

text.cn: 别傻乐啦，赶紧想想该怎么配合几位天师吧。
text.en: Stop joking around. Go and help the Tianshi in your team.

text.cn: 首墩这次遭了大灾，还有几个人没找到。
text.en: The Marker Stone got hit real bad. We still got some MIA.

text.cn: 我该怎么跟他们家人交代啊……
text.en: What should I tell their families...?

text.cn: 赶紧盘点清楚，别漏了，那边等着开工呢。
text.en: Need a proper inventory count. The shift is about to start.

text.cn: 放心吧，早就点清楚了，不会误事的。
text.en: It's done already. No one's getting delayed.

text.cn: 好不容易盼到天晴，大家加把劲。
text.en: Finally! The sun is out again. Make use of it, people.

text.cn: 雨过天晴，正好给咱们抢进度的机会！
text.en: Sunshine at last! Time to double our progress!

text.cn: 你说，等工程结束了，这里会有什么变化啊？
text.en: Once this project ends, what will happen to this place?

text.cn: 谁知道呢，说不定到时有吃有喝有茶摊呢……
text.en: Who knows. Maybe they'll build a resto or a tea stall.

text.cn: 没想到都被你说中了，这地方连餐饮都有了。
text.en: Your words came true. We got a neat resto now.

text.cn: 说明进展顺利，才有余力改善生活设施啊。
text.en: This means progress is great and comfy is now a focus.

text.cn: 人是铁，饭是钢，可别饿着肚子啊。
text.en: People can't work on an empty stomach.

text.cn: 老板，这地儿来回就我们几人，别吆喝了……
text.en: Boss, we're the only crew here, so quit yelling already.

text.cn: 最近的天气变好了，我们抓紧时间干活。
text.en: Weather's great again. Let's throw our backs into it.

text.cn: 放心吧，来得及，不会误了后面的事情。
text.en: Ease up, friend. I don't see any risk of delays.

text.cn: 这就是巨兽心脏啊，完全是另一种技术路线嘛。
text.en: Is that the Feranmut Heart? It looks like foreign tech.

text.cn: 不只你觉得惊奇，我们看到也觉得心潮澎湃。
text.en: We're just as shocked. It can be very awe-inspiring.

text.cn: 大家注意点，小心湿滑，安全第一。
text.en: Watch it. Floor may be slippery. Safety first.

text.cn: 唉，我要是再年轻几岁，肯定能干满一整天。
text.en: If I were a few years younger, I could work all day.

text.cn: 少说大话，前几年又不是没见过你干活……
text.en: I saw you a few years younger. You never worked all day.

text.cn: 水质比上次好多了，之前的影响在消退了。
text.en: Water quality is improving. The pollutants are subsiding.

text.cn: 希望修缮工作早日完成，让一切重回正轨。
text.en: Once this remediation is done, we'll get back to our lives.

text.cn: 听说了吗？完工的那天有庆功宴啊。
text.en: Haven't you heard? We're getting a feast on the final day!

text.cn: 是吗，你在哪儿听说的？
text.en: Really? Where did you hear that from?

text.cn: 只差一步，咱们就要大功告成了！
text.en: One final push and the entire work is done!

text.cn: 是啊，不知道巨兽心脏重启是怎样的景象！
text.en: What will happen if the Feranmut Heart starts working again?

text.cn: 没想到宏味的分店都开过来了……
text.en: Hmm. Hongwei has opened a branch here.

text.cn: 我觉得宏味咖啡不如岳研香茶铺的茶饮……
text.en: Hongwei Coffee isn't as good as Eureka Teashop.

text.cn: 这是息壤能量定型装置，可以产出息壤块。
text.en: This Xiranite Energy-Fixing Facility produces Xiranite blocks.

text.cn: 好厉害，息壤块竟然是这样生产出来的！
text.en: Awesome. So this is how Xiranite blocks are made.

text.cn: 处理那些怪物得千万小心！
text.en: Careful when handling that creature!

text.cn: 不能拖了，得尽快确认首墩内各处的受损情况。
text.en: No more delays! Marker Stone damages must be assessed ASAP.

text.cn: 按之前说的，分组行动，切忌单独离队！
text.en: Follow the plan! Stay with your team! Do not stray off!

text.cn: 好在画卷没有受损……
text.en: Thankfully the Scroll is unscathed...

text.cn: 那位少校和阿达希尔真在画卷里吗？
text.en: Is the Major and Ardashir still in the scroll?

text.cn: 很难想象她怎么做到的……
text.en: I could hardly imagine how she did it...

text.cn: 多亏了管理员和诀少校，这颗心脏才被保住。
text.en: The Heart is safe, thanks to the Endmin and Major Arcane.

text.cn: 如果这颗最关键的心脏都被破坏了……
text.en: If they manage to injure the most crucial Heart...

text.cn: 惊心动魄，当年科考站的事故差点要重演了！
text.en: No! That'd be the Science Station Incident deja vu!

text.cn: 想吃热米糕……
text.en: I miss the hot rice cakes...

text.cn: 都检查过了，这附近没有安全隐患。
text.en: I ran the checks. No safety hazards nearby.

text.cn: 我还是每天来检查一遍吧，念念的安全要紧。
text.en: Babbles doesn't look very safe. I should visit everyday.

text.cn: 很多东西是不是可以再翻修一次……
text.en: Maybe I can overhaul the stuff here...

text.cn: 解决天使的方案，奚墨天师他们敲定了吗？
text.en: Did Tianshi Xi Mo's team finish the bug-elimination plan?

text.cn: 还没，要不直接开闸把它们全淹死算了。
text.en: No. Why don't we open the gates and drown them all?

text.cn: 答应我，你是在开玩笑，对吧？
text.en: Alright. You were only joking, right?

text.cn: 蓄水站的应急措施得再加强，之前太懈怠了。
text.en: We need proper contingency plans for the Reservoir Station.

text.cn: 听说有一位应龙特勤队的人在首墩里牺牲了。
text.en: I heard a YSTF member got killed at the Marker Stone.

text.cn: 牺牲？不可能吧……
text.en: Killed? That's impossible...

text.cn: 奚墨老师的心情好像不怎么好……
text.en: Mr. Xi Mo doesn't look too happy...

text.cn: 出这么大事，能好才怪。
text.en: How could anyone stay happy after that huge mess?

text.cn: 最近老师心情好像变好了？
text.en: Our instructor seems happier now.

text.cn: 我也发现了！难道遇上了什么喜事？
text.en: I noticed that too! Did something nice happen to him?

text.cn: 再调整一遍数据吧……
text.en: We should adjust the parameters again...

text.cn: 现在没了小机芯，真有点不习惯了……
text.en: The little cores are gone. Things feel very different.

text.cn: 是啊，以前还总嫌它们闹腾……
text.en: Yeah, I used to be annoyed by them.

text.cn: 老师，这就是辅桩的原型吗？
text.en: Instructor, is this the prototype of the auxiliary pillar?

text.cn: 嗯，从概念上而言，确实是这样。
text.en: Yes. Indeed, in a conceptual sense.

text.cn: 这次的课题也太难了……
text.en: This project is just so tough...

text.cn: 哼，谁叫你上课从不做笔记。
text.en: Says the smart-ass who never took lecture notes.

text.cn: 走之前别忘了收集附近的湖水——
text.en: Gotta collect lake water samples before I leave—

text.cn: 下回数据分析要用的！我都会背了……
text.en: Need it for data analysis! I know what you want.

text.cn: 唉，之前撤离得太仓促……
text.en: Ugh. We left in a real hurry last time...

text.cn: 现在好了，只能慢慢收拾了……
text.en: It's better now. We can take our time...

text.cn: 总觉得那只长股兽在瞪我……
text.en: I think that lankybeast is staring at me...

text.cn: 你们看，这里的水质明显更好……
text.en: Look. The water quality here is obviously better.

text.cn: 全靠天师桩的净化功能……
text.en: Thanks to the Tianshi Pillar's purification...

text.cn: 首先，对于秧苗的选取……
text.en: First, for the selection of the seedlings...

text.cn: 得是对侵蚀环境有抵抗能力的……
text.en: They must be resistant to ambient Blight...

text.cn: 但愿这次的选题能过……
text.en: I hope they'll approve my project proposal this time.

text.cn: 唉，育种又失败了……
text.en: Ugh. The new batch of seeds failed...

text.cn: 早知道就听学长的，换个课题了……
text.en: Should've listened to my senior and switched project...

text.cn: 累死了……总算把数据录入完了……
text.en: Finally done with data entry. I'm so tired right now.

text.cn: 我还差好多！唉，需要备份的太多了……
text.en: I still got pages to go! They need so much backup!

text.cn: 这次真是多亏了陆学姐和管理员！
text.en: We got Lu and the Endmin to thank!

text.cn: 嗯，没想到丙型天师桩藏了那样的设计……
text.en: Never knew that Type-C Tianshi Pillars had such designs.

text.cn: 看见了吗？这就是丙型天师桩的最终形态……
text.en: See that? The final form of Type-C Tianshi Pillars.

text.cn: 老师！听说管理员亲自改造过它？
text.en: Instructor! I heard the Endmin modified it before!

text.cn: 真的吗？那、那我们能和它合个影吗？
text.en: Really? So ... can we take a group photo with it?

text.cn: 四舍五入就是和管理员合影了！
text.en: It'd be an indirect group photo with the Endmin!

text.cn: 可惜园区还没完全开放，不然……
text.en: Most of the Park is still locked. Otherwise...

text.cn: 是啊，我还想多拍几张照片……
text.en: Yeah, I wanna take a few more photos...

text.cn: 你们不知道吧？这丙型天师桩也是按首墩造的……
text.en: This Type-C Tianshi Pillar is based on the Marker Stone.

text.cn: 里面可藏了不少秘密，比如什么机芯技术……
text.en: It's got secrets in it. Like core technology.

text.cn: 可玄乎着呢！我有个研究天师桩的兄弟说过……
text.en: Hardcore secrets. Said a bro who's a Tianshi on the pillars.

text.cn: 走过路过都来看看！新一届环园区赛跑即将开始！
text.en: Come! A New Test Area Athletic Race is about to start!

text.cn: 怎么还没排到我……
text.en: When will it be my turn...?

text.cn: 小组间保持协同，有任何情况，立刻回报。
text.en: Teams are to keep in touch and report any situation.

text.cn: 为了天师桩安全抵达，要劳烦各位费心了。
text.en: We're counting on you to deliver the Tianshi Pillar.

text.cn: 职责所在。
text.en: We'll see it done.

text.cn: 禁区中危机重重，我有一些对行进的建议……
text.en: The EZ is dangerous. I got an idea about the march.

text.cn: 是危险，也是千载难逢的机会。
text.en: It's dangerous, but it's a rare opportunity.

text.cn: ……回家。
text.en: We're going home...

text.cn: 放心前进，我会保护好头儿跟天师队伍的。
text.en: Just go ahead. I'll protect the boss and the Tianshi.

text.cn: 这次，也许有机会找到爸妈的……
text.en: This is a chance to find mom and dad's belongings...

text.cn: 侵蚀瘴控制住了，目前的深度读数还算稳定。
text.en: The Blight Miasma is contained. Depth readings are stable.

text.cn: 有个小组一直没有回话……
text.en: One of the teams just went dark...

text.cn: 需要散出更多天桩，监测瘴气的状况。
text.en: We must send out more sky poles to monitor the Miasma.

text.cn: 嗯，医疗用品的数量还够。
text.en: Good. We still have enough medical supplies.

text.cn: 犯人在里面，目前没有异常。
text.en: The prisoner's inside. Nothing weird so far.

text.cn: 因蚀影袭击，前方道路塌陷，暂时无法通行。
text.en: The road is out due to Blightshade attack.

text.cn: 应该不会有敌人从这儿过来吧……
text.en: I don't think any enemy would come from that side...

text.cn: 别杞人忧天了！这里坚如磐石，易守难攻！
text.en: Stop worrying. Our position is unassailable!

text.cn: 那两个家伙，不干活，偷什么懒呢？
text.en: What are those two doing? Slacking off?

text.cn: 我们需要更多检测水体的设备。
text.en: We need more water quality testing devices.

text.cn: 已经向天师府学院打了申请……
text.en: I've sent an application to the TBA...

text.cn: 之后要不要搭个大型监测站？
text.en: Maybe we should build a large monitoring center.

text.cn: 接触烽燧桩的机会可不多，我要好好观察。
text.en: A Balepyre Tower! I gotta study it well.

text.cn: 好想跟那个应龙队员做朋友……
text.en: I really wanna be friends with that Yinglung...

text.cn: 这些特殊水体很宝贵，能帮助我们研究侵蚀……
text.en: This special water body can help us study the Blight.

text.cn: 还需要进一步的检测。
text.en: We need to run more tests.

text.cn: 有关于应龙关的疑问，随时可以找我们。
text.en: Ask us if you got questions about Yinglung Pass.

text.cn: 没问题，之后肯定要麻烦各位。
text.en: No problem. We'll have plenty for you.

text.cn: 武器的储备充足。
text.en: We're well stocked in weapons.

text.cn: 记录好每一条数据，千万别搞乱……
text.en: Note down each data string properly. Don't mess up.

text.cn: 不积跬步，无以至千里……
text.en: A journey of a thousand miles start with a single step.

text.cn: 整理杂物，也是科研路上的重要一步！
text.en: Cleaning up trash is also a key step of science!

text.cn: 没想到我能得到参与建设应龙关的机会……
text.en: I actually got the chance to expand Yinglung Pass!

text.cn: 不管看几次，都觉得集成工业系统很了不起。
text.en: I'm always amazed whenever I look at the AIC!

text.cn: 水体的勘测已经初步完成了。
text.en: Preliminary water body surveillance completed.

text.cn: 接下来是植被的问题，点对点解决吧。
text.en: Gotta focus on vegetation. We do it site by site.

text.cn: 道路终于整修好了。
text.en: We finally repaired the roads.

text.cn: 去那一带考察变得更方便了。
text.en: Survey work in that area will be easier now.

text.cn: 水中的侵蚀残留物极其微小，肉眼不可见。
text.en: Waterborne Blight residues are barely visible.

text.cn: 对环境的影响是悄无声息的……
text.en: Silently they exert quite the environmental impact.

text.cn: 不积小流，无以成江河……
text.en: You need a trickle to create a river.

text.cn: 唉……什么时候轮到我去勘察呢……
text.en: Ugh. When do I get to go on a survey mission?

text.cn: 这些批注似乎出自一位已故的天师……
text.en: The Tianshi who wrote this probably passed away.

text.cn: 曾经的建设者们，也在尝试汲取前辈的智慧。
text.en: The builders also tapped into historical wisdom.

text.cn: 有了样本，可以开展植物培育工作了。
text.en: The sample will let us start plant breeding programs.

text.cn: 我觉得，果然还是要考虑美观性。
text.en: I think aesthetics should be considered.

text.cn: 多筛选一些适合应龙关风格的植被品种吧。
text.en: Let's choose plants fitting of Yinglung Pass.

text.cn: 息壤存量告急的事，仿佛已经过去很久了。
text.en: That Xiranite shortage felt like a lifetime ago.

text.cn: 多亏了终末地。
text.en: All thanks to Endfield.

text.cn: 在重度侵蚀环境中生长的植物……
text.en: Plants that thrive in heavily Blighted areas...

text.cn: 对污染物的吸附能力有明显提升……
text.en: Pollutant adsorption is significantly increased...

text.cn: 这些植物，之后还要在息壤地块移栽几次。
text.en: Multiple transplanting in Xiranite plots is required.

text.cn: 锲而舍之，朽木不折……
text.en: A sculptor who can't commit won't even chip rotten wood.

text.cn: 怎么感觉整理工作越来越重了？
text.en: Is it me or is the clean up work getting tougher?

text.cn: 候羽针跟盈天台的结合很完美。
text.en: The Migratory Fowl Rod is perfect for the Cloudseeder.

text.cn: 这下不需要再担心息壤浪费的问题了。
text.en: The problem with excessive Xiranite use is now history.

text.cn: 有集成工业系统在，应龙关的扩建指日可待。
text.en: With the AIC, Yinglung Pass expansion will be on schedule.

text.cn: 盈天台已经非常接近完成态了。
text.en: The Cloudseeder is almost in its final form!

text.cn: 再加把劲，争取月内完工！
text.en: Final push! Let's finish it before this month ends!

text.cn: 应龙关的景色很宏伟，看十年也不会腻。
text.en: Yinglung Pass is simply breathtaking!

text.cn: 我决定留在这里，长期参与建设了。
text.en: I'll apply for a permanent post to work on the expansion.

text.cn: 盈天台竣工了，但我们的工作还没有结束。
text.en: The Cloudseeder is complete, but our work is far from over.

text.cn: 没错，还要继续推进扩建方案呢！
text.en: That's right. We still got that expansion project.

text.cn: 哈哈，我的脑子里已经有它未来的图景了。
text.en: Hah. I'm already seeing the completed vision in my mind.

text.cn: 再微小的工作，也是整个扩建计划的一部分。
text.en: Even the smallest errand is part of the expansion project.

text.cn: 天见其明，地见其光……我彻底悟了！
text.en: A light witnessed by heavens and earth... I got it!

text.cn: 盈天台建成后，完全没清闲，更忙了……
text.en: The Cloudseeder is complete but we're getting more work.

text.cn: 不过，也挺有成就感的。继续努力吧！
text.en: But I'm also getting a sense of achievement. Let's carry on!

text.cn: 完全消失了，他到底是怎么做到的……
text.en: Completely disappeared? How did he do it...?

text.cn: 先采集残留的能量，报给队长跟祀小姐。
text.en: Get energy readings! Report this to the Captain and Lady Si.

text.cn: 这儿的土倒是挺适合做试验田……
text.en: The local soil feels good. We can have a few test plots.

text.cn: 要不要搭个临时休息处呢……
text.en: How about a temporary resting place?

text.cn: 前方有沉积酸，注意安全。
text.en: Precipitation Acid up ahead. Watch your step.

text.cn: 这里先不要放东西，留空出来。
text.en: Don't place anything here. Leave it empty.

text.cn: 如果后续需要加装组件，就不用退线了。
text.en: We won't need to rewire if they add a new module here.

text.cn: 扩建中遇到问题先找我，不要自己乱动。
text.en: Got problems? Don't do anything crazy. Talk to me first.

text.cn: 扣学分事小，耽误进度就麻烦了。
text.en: A GPA dip is okay, but we can't afford any delays.

text.cn: 老师您放心……等等，扣学分？！
text.en: Don't worry, mentor... Wait. GPA DIP?!

text.cn: 不可放松警惕。
text.en: Stay vigilant.

text.cn: 沉积酸储备还挺充足，不用愁液化重息壤了。
text.en: We have enough acid for Liquid Heavy Xiranite.

text.cn: 解决甚大裂隙后，学院应该能腾出更多人手……
text.en: Sealing the VLR should free up more TBA people.

text.cn: 说起来，弭弗队长还问要不要派巡卫过来呢。
text.en: Captain Mi actually asked if we need more watchguards.

text.cn: 看什么呢，这么认真？
text.en: Why so serious? What are you looking at?

text.cn: 烽燧桩、盈天台、集成工业系统……未来。
text.en: The Balepyre Tower, the Cloudseeder, the AIC ... our future.

text.cn: 你说，在这儿搭个观景台怎么样？
text.en: Say, maybe we can build an observation deck here.

text.cn: 每次休息，都会撞到那俩人……
text.en: I always see those two together...

text.cn: 这是第几处了……我的风水宝地……
text.en: How many sites are there? This place has nice fengshui.

text.cn: 设备运作正常……耗能如何？
text.en: The machinery is working properly. How's the power usage?

text.cn: 正常。
text.en: Normal.

text.cn: 不知不觉，已经有这么多年轻人能挑大梁了。
text.en: Our youths are actually taking on responsibilities.

text.cn: 好啊，真好啊。
text.en: Good. Very good indeed.

text.cn: 稍微再调整一下手势……嗯，可以了。
text.en: Just adjust your hand gesture... There, good.

text.cn: 盈天台构造精密，用天师仪维护时要多注意。
text.en: Careful with the repairs. The Cloudseeder is very touchy.

text.cn: 你们一直在这儿看着，是发现了什么异常吗？
text.en: You've been staring at this for a while. Noticed a problem?

text.cn: 没事没事，看风景有点入迷……
text.en: No, not at all. Just ... enraptured by the view.

text.cn: 我们这就回去工作了！
text.en: We'll head back to work, right now!

text.cn: 不要松懈，确保天师桩的稳定运转。
text.en: Stay vigilant. Keep the Tianshi Pillar running.

text.cn: 下一次铺设天师桩也能用到这次的数据。
text.en: The data can be reused to raise the next Tianshi Pillar.

text.cn: 要时刻监控这部分的损耗情况。
text.en: Monitor damages of this part at all times.

text.cn: 我知道，这套流程我已经练习了数百遍。
text.en: Got it. I practiced this process a few hundred times.

text.cn: 这里先交给你们了，我去看看其他模块。
text.en: I'll let you handle this. Gotta go check the other modules.

text.cn: 和预期参数几乎没有误差……
text.en: There's hardly any difference with the expected parameters.

text.cn: 这项工作我们准备了太多年……
text.en: I've spent too many years prepping for this job.

text.cn: 接下来还有三座天师桩要铺设……
text.en: There are three more Tianshi Pillars to deploy.

text.cn: 后续的工作更加艰苦，不能松懈。
text.en: Work will only get tougher. Let's keep it up.

text.cn: 终于迈出了这一步……
text.en: We finally made our very first step.

text.cn: 听好了，帮我盯好红脸婆，被发现马上开溜！
text.en: Spy on that mad woman! And run like hell if she finds out!

text.cn: 大当家……我可能跑不过她……
text.en: Chief, she's probably faster than me...

text.cn: 怕什么，到时候我来帮你断后！
text.en: Don't be scared. Your Chief will totally wreck her!

text.cn: 我四处看看，别让那些鬼魂一样的东西伤人。
text.en: I gotta look around and keep those shady ghosts out.

text.cn: 鬼……鬼魂……
text.en: Gah... G-ghosts...?!

text.cn: 枢壤仪的容量……穿过高浓度侵蚀瘴有些极限。
text.en: The Xiranite Nexus is not enough to get through the Miasma.

text.cn: 老师……我来替你去走没走完的路……
text.en: My Mentor, I shall finish the journey that you've started.

text.cn: 任务还很重，要看好这些物资。
text.en: This is an important job. Keep your eyes on the supplies.

text.cn: 集结了全武陵的力量，后备物资在路上了。
text.en: The whole of Wuling is mobilized. Supplies are on the way.

text.cn: 天师桩研究也是从北部禁区开始的……
text.en: The EZ is where Tianshi Pillar research begun.

text.cn: 不仅天师桩，还有息壤……这里是一切的开始。
text.en: And Xiranite too. Everything started here.

text.cn: 看好四周，那些蚀影不知道会从哪里出现。
text.en: Look out for the Blightshades. They might show up anytime.

text.cn: 我……不会手软的。
text.en: I ... I won't go easy on them.

text.cn: 发现蚀影的踪迹立刻通知应龙。
text.en: Report all Blightshade sightings to the YSTF.

text.cn: 我知道，真的交战起来也会以拖延为主的。
text.en: Roger that. I'll focus on slowing them down in the fight.

text.cn: 我的老师总说起他在谈剑堂学习的事……
text.en: My mentor won't stop talking about studying in Tanjian Hall.

text.cn: 竺创办了谈剑堂，让随行来的孩子可以读书。
text.en: Zhu founded the school for the kids of people working here.

text.cn: 我也听老师提过。他们总说一定要重回这里……
text.en: My mentor too. Everyone wants to be back here.

text.cn: 武陵一直没有建新的谈剑堂，我们坚信……
text.en: We didn't build a new Tanjian Hall in Wuling. We believe...

text.cn: 抓紧时间，最好能提前完成任务。
text.en: Stay on track. Try to finish the task early.

text.cn: 现在轮到我们为先锋队伍开辟道路！
text.en: Our turn to pave the way for our vanguards!

text.cn: 地形可能还变化，趁现在稳定，我们得提速。
text.en: Get it done quickly before the ground shakes again.

text.cn: 都注意安全。
text.en: Safety, people! Safety!

text.cn: 息壤研究所……父亲就是在那里……
text.en: Xiranite Research Labs... Dad was there...

text.cn: 北部禁区啊北部禁区，没想到真能回到这里……
text.en: The North Wuling EZ... I never thought I'd return.

text.cn: 有不少生面孔……看来其他部门也被派来了。
text.en: Plenty of new faces. The other bureaus are here too.

text.cn: 休息时间还有三分十秒……不行，这太紧张了……
text.en: 190 seconds of break time left. Ugh... It's too tight!

text.cn: 多久了，你还记得吗？你弟弟的事。
text.en: How long has it been? Still remember your baby brother?

text.cn: 五年零七个月，没办法，谁让他是应龙。
text.en: Five years seven months. Well, he's an Yinglung.

text.cn: 息壤桥准备得怎么样了？
text.en: How fares the Xiranite bridge prep work?

text.cn: 大部分在运送，还有一部分刚通过质量测试。
text.en: Some parts just passed QC. Most is still on the way.

text.cn: 短期建息壤桥，结构强度有限，希望能顺利。
text.en: Xiranite bridges built on short notice might be weaker.

text.cn: 竺老师……此前没有机会向你道别……
text.en: Instructor Zhu... I never had the chance to say goodbye.

text.cn: 授艺之恩不敢忘，我会继续砥砺前行。
text.en: I'll always remember your lessons and keep fighting.

text.cn: 李织烟那家伙，看着还是让人着急。
text.en: And that Li Zhiyan is still as frustrating as ever.

text.cn: 只要再坚持一会儿……
text.en: I must be strong, just for a while longer...

text.cn: 此行只有成功，没有失败……
text.en: Failure is unacceptable in this mission...

text.cn: 再让我看一遍前两次推演的结果。
text.en: Show me the results of the previous two simulations.

text.cn: 搭建桥体所需的息壤已经准备好了。
text.en: We have the Xiranite for the bridge.

text.cn: 强度测试没问题。我们还准备了备案。
text.en: Strength testing is green. We even prepped a backup.

text.cn: 先在预定位置待命，搭建工作马上开始。
text.en: Standby at location. We're starting construction.

text.cn: 准备情况如何？
text.en: How goes the prep?

text.cn: 再等一小会儿……好了！
text.en: Almost done... THERE!

text.cn: 帮我扶着点，谢谢。
text.en: Need a hand here. Thanks.

text.cn: 这一批材料是备用的。
text.en: These are the backup materials.

text.cn: 这是第二组，之后还会运来第三组。
text.en: This is batch two. Batch three will arrive later.

text.cn: 希望我们用不到这些。
text.en: Hope we don't need to use them.

text.cn: 别担心，我们测试过好多次了。
text.en: Don't worry. I ran the tests like umpteen times.

text.cn: 这是最后的检查了。
text.en: Final round of checks.

text.cn: 我希望今天就能成功。
text.en: I hope to see it done today.

text.cn: 今天有什么特别的吗？
text.en: Today? Is there a special meaning to it?

text.cn: 我女儿过生日，我想把最好的消息带给她。
text.en: It's my darling girl's birthday. She'll love the news.

text.cn: 替我祝贺一下，希望今天就能成功。
text.en: My best regards. And yes, let's hope it gets done today.

text.cn: 我原本不想来的……
text.en: I didn't want to be here...

text.cn: 我怕自己忍不住眼泪……
text.en: I was afraid that I'd get too emotional...

text.cn: 太好了，第一步很顺利！
text.en: Great! The first step is a success!

text.cn: 最难的工作已经完成了！
text.en: The toughest part is out of the way!

text.cn: 接下来只需要把桥体展开。
text.en: We just need to expand the bridge.

text.cn: 就快了，就快了！
text.en: We're almost done!

text.cn: 先别急着庆祝，工作还没结束呢。
text.en: Don't celebrate just yet. We got plenty of work.

text.cn: 我知道，我只是有点激动……
text.en: I know, but I'm just super excited...

text.cn: 还有一点时间，我们等你。
text.en: There's still time. We'll wait for you.

text.cn: 我那边检查结束了。
text.en: I'm done with my inspection job.

text.cn: 情况稳定。
text.en: Situation normal.

text.cn: 多盯着点，别遗漏了什么安全事项。
text.en: Don't miss anything on the safety checklist!

text.cn: 胜利就在眼前了。
text.en: Victory is at hand.

text.cn: 要喝水的话趁现在，马上要忙起来了。
text.en: Take a sip now. Work is getting more intense.

text.cn: 我有些紧张……
text.en: I'm a little nervous...

text.cn: 放松一点，庄天师也在，还有管理员。
text.en: Relax. Tianshi Zhuang is here. And the Endmin.

text.cn: 我过去只在资料上了解过北部禁区的情况……
text.en: Before this, I only read about the North Wuling EZ...

text.cn: 这里远比资料中描述的更加危险、骇人。
text.en: The actual place is far more dangerous and terrifying.

text.cn: 真没想到，我们终于到这一步了……
text.en: I could hardly believe we finally made it here...

text.cn: 管理员，谢谢你把我们带到这里……
text.en: Thank you for leading us here, Endmin.

text.cn: 越是最后关头，越不能松懈。
text.en: Don't relent! Not when we're so close to the finishing line!

text.cn: 站好这班岗。
text.en: Gotta do this shift properly.

text.cn: 该结束了，该结束了……
text.en: We're finally ending it. Finally...

text.cn: 我求了老师很久，他才答应带我参与行动。
text.en: I had to beg before my mentor let me join.

text.cn: 老师在这里失去了太多东西……
text.en: My mentor lost too much at this place...

text.cn: 这么多年，我第一次看到他目光如炬。
text.en: It's my first time seeing life in his gaze.

text.cn: 我们不会让老师失望的。
text.en: We won't let our mentor down.

text.cn: 虽然有些波折……天师桩总算布设完成了。
text.en: We had problems, but we finally deployed the Tianshi Pillar.

text.cn: 剩下的就相信管理员吧。
text.en: We can count on the Endmin to handle the rest.

text.cn: 材料就先放到这里吧……
text.en: Just stash the materials here...

text.cn: 听说了吗？管理员把诀队长带回来了。
text.en: Hey! The Endmin came back with Captain Arcane.

text.cn: 就知道相信管理员准没错！我们可以继续了！
text.en: I knew we can count on the Endmin! Let's continue!

text.cn: 还好诀队长平安无事，不然我内心……
text.en: Thankfully Captain Arcane is alright. I was so...

text.cn: 继续工作吧，这才不辜负她和终末地的努力。
text.en: Back to work! Don't let Arcane and Endfield down!

text.cn: 沟壑下的冲击远超桥体的可承受强度。
text.en: The gorge shockwave far exceeds bridge tolerance.

text.cn: 这是我们的失误……如果不是管理员和诀队长……
text.en: Our mistake. If not for the Endmin and Captain Arcane...

text.cn: 现在想这些也没用，先准备后续工作吧。
text.en: Save that for later. There's more work to be done.

text.cn: 新方案已经发过来了。
text.en: They've sent us the new plans.

text.cn: 那道冲击究竟是……沟壑下到底藏着些什么？
text.en: Where did that come from? What's down there in the gorge?

text.cn: 我们还能成功吗……我有点害怕……
text.en: Can we really pull this through? I'm a little scared.

text.cn: 别担心，我们与你同在。
text.en: Don't worry. We're here with you.

text.cn: 多亏诀和管理员，没出现伤情。来再试一次。
text.en: Thanks to the Endmin and Arcane, we got zero casualties.

text.cn: 基座还算完好，需要重新填装息壤。
text.en: Base of the bridge looks good. Just refill the Xiranite.

text.cn: 不幸中的万幸。
text.en: A stroke of fortune for us.

text.cn: 尽快把桥修好吧，后面的兄弟还在赶来。
text.en: Fix the bridge ASAP. We got more people waiting to cross.

text.cn: 终点近在眼前，却……
text.en: Our destination is right over there, but...

text.cn: 那就再走他一遭！
text.en: But what? I'm gonna march straight in.

text.cn: 我们要做的，就是将天堑变通途。
text.en: We must make a passage to cross the chasm.

text.cn: 师姐，您实话告诉我们，桥体损伤严重吗？
text.en: The truth, please. How badly damaged is the bridge?

text.cn: 我们做好准备了，多危险的工作我们都愿意……
text.en: We're ready for anything. No matter how dangerous it is.

text.cn: 放心，没多严重，耐心点准备更稳定的方案。
text.en: It's not serious. Be patient and wait for a better solution.

text.cn: 还好大家都没事……
text.en: Thank goodness everyone's alright...

text.cn: 李织烟，我就知道你没事！
text.en: Li! Oh, I knew you'd be alright!

text.cn: 下一次，我一定会抓住你的！
text.en: I'll definitely catch you next time!

text.cn: 那个蠢货……喊什么……
text.en: That silly creature... Everyone can hear her...

text.cn: 老师他知道我们做到了，一定会很欣慰的。
text.en: My mentor would be proud to know we did it.

text.cn: 这消息得你亲口告诉他，你们俩也该和好了。
text.en: You should go and tell him, and hopefully reconcile.

text.cn: 我会考虑的……
text.en: I'll consider it...

text.cn: 听说前线的人吃了不少苦头，还差点出意外……
text.en: The frontline ran into trouble. It almost went sideways.

text.cn: 那位应龙队长和管理员吗？情况竟那么凶险……
text.en: The Yinglung Captain and Endmin? That was so terrifying.

text.cn: 但我们总能逢凶化吉不是吗？继续工作吧。
text.en: But we always turned things around. Focus on your task.

text.cn: 我家里那位听说我要来，哭了一个下午。
text.en: My family heard I was coming here and couldn't stop crying.

text.cn: 这儿可是北部禁区，谁都会担心的。
text.en: It's the North Wuling EZ. Anyone would be worried.

text.cn: 今天她却起了个大早，帮我把袍子熨了两遍……
text.en: She woke up early today and ironed my robes twice.

text.cn: 早点回去吧，告诉她你平安无事。
text.en: End your shift early. Tell her you're fine.

text.cn: 还有一些后备材料需要清点……
text.en: We got reserve materials to inventorize...

text.cn: 这次行动可把大半个武陵城都动员了。
text.en: More than half of Wuling mobilized for this operation.

text.cn: 看来假期得搁置一下了，后面还有得忙呢。
text.en: Gotta delay my vacation. Things will only get busier.

text.cn: 十年前没能带出的数据，也能帮后来者的忙。
text.en: Data from ten years ago. Hope they can help this generation.
Ugh...

text.cn: 还有什么遗漏的吗？我怕耽误事情。
text.en: Did we miss anything? I don't want to mess things up.

text.cn: 不用着急，现在不用那么紧张了。
text.en: Stop worrying. No need to be so tense.

text.cn: 那些令我们望而却步的侵蚀瘴终于消散了。
text.en: That terrible Blight Miasma is finally gone.

text.cn: 危险还没解除，除了应龙和巡卫外不能进入。
text.en: Yinglungs and watchguards only. Place is still dangerous.

text.cn: 干好我们的这份活吧，还有设备要修呢。
text.en: Focus on the job. We got plenty of machines to fix.

text.cn: 别急，我马上来。
text.en: No rush. I'm heading over.

text.cn: 我父亲是跟着林宇天师一起来武陵的。
text.en: My dad came to Wuling with Tianshi Lin Yu.

text.cn: 这是你选择来这里的理由吗？
text.en: Is that why you chose to be here?

text.cn: 嗯，我想看看他为之奉献生命的事业。
text.en: He gave his life for this endeavor. I need to see it.

text.cn: 我在武陵的心愿已了，该去赴友人之约了。
text.en: I fulfilled my wish in Wuling. Time to meet an old friend.

text.cn: 打算去哪里？
text.en: Where are you going?

text.cn: 特里格拉夫，我想尝点那里的烈酒。
text.en: Triglava. I'm curious about their kohl liquor.

text.cn: 算我一个？我也想见识一下那座山中之城。
text.en: Count me in. Always wanted to see that mountain city.

text.cn: 前期计划要处理遗留的废墟，还有勘测土壤……
text.en: First, we need to clean up the ruins and test the soil...

text.cn: 允许勘测的区域有限，具体计划书还没下来。
text.en: Survey access is incomplete. They're still writing the plan.

text.cn: 先把工作跑起来吧，你们多催催其他部门。
text.en: Get the work started, and ping the other departments.

text.cn: 谈剑堂，之后会怎么样呢……
text.en: Tanjian Hall... What will happen to it?

text.cn: 都说武陵城缺了座谈剑堂，或许就是在等待……
text.en: Wuling lacks a Tanjian Hall. Maybe the city's waiting...

text.cn: 希望不久后就能听到这口钟再次被敲响。
text.en: Hopefully we'll hear the tolling of the gateway bell.

text.cn: 不仅有人类形态，居然还有动物形态的蚀影……
text.en: There are also beast-form Blightshades...

text.cn: 从这些痕迹来看，噪雷一直没有离开谈剑堂……
text.en: From the looks of it, Blitzcrash never left Tanjian Hall.

text.cn: 虽然裂隙威胁轻了，但附近读数依然不稳定。
text.en: The Rift has weakened, but readings remain unstable.

text.cn: 当心，可能还会有蚀影出现，抓紧时间勘测。
text.en: Finish the survey quickly. And watch out for Blightshades.

text.cn: 可以考虑加固方案了，这座桥还有很大用处。
text.en: We should fit some reinforcements. This bridge is crucial.

text.cn: 之前那样的冲击还会再发生吗？
text.en: Will that shockwave hit us again?

text.cn: 就是为了应对那样的情况才需要加固。
text.en: That's why we need reinforcements to resist the shockwaves.

text.cn: 测算工作怎么样了？
text.en: How goes the survey work?

text.cn: 几次结果都在误差范围内，暂时告一段落了。
text.en: All readings are within error range. We're done for now.

text.cn: 这些数据或许能填补如今研究上的一些空缺。
text.en: The data will fill up the gaps in our research.

text.cn: 这些资料若能救出，定能帮我们少走些弯路。
text.en: Salvaging the data will keep us on the right track.

text.cn: 这里的设备需要在特殊环境中处理。
text.en: These machines must be handled in a special environment.

text.cn: 这里就是息壤研究的起点……
text.en: The very starting point of Xiranite research...

text.cn: 这都是前人们的心血……
text.en: The great work of our predecessors...

text.cn: 这些名字，都曾在学院的书中见过，唉……
text.en: I read these names in the Academy library. *Sigh*...

text.cn: 根据保存情况分类，剩下的资料就这些了吧。
text.en: Categorize according to state of preservation. Is this it?

text.cn: 提取样本的时候要注意安全。
text.en: Keep yourself safe during sample collection.

text.cn: 有些特性和实验室推演的不太一致。
text.en: Some Blight properties may differ from lab simulations.

text.cn: 再去拿一些容器过来吧。
text.en: I need more containers.

text.cn: 各位，我们这次的工作圆满结束了！
text.en: Team, our job has been successfully concluded!

text.cn: 太好了，我骨头都要散架了，剩下靠大伙了。
text.en: Great. My bones are breaking apart. Carry on, people.

text.cn: 感觉浑身都是用不完的劲！第一次这么兴奋！
text.en: My body's roaring to go! I've never been this excited!

text.cn: 刚才……莫非是传闻中的代理人？
text.en: Was that ... the legendary proxy?

text.cn: 辛苦大家了，接下来交给我们。
text.en: Thanks, everyone. We'll take it from here.

text.cn: 刚才的战斗……附近的读数似乎又不稳定了。
text.en: That battle... Local readings are fluctuating again.

text.cn: 我已经安排人手严密监控裂隙了。
text.en: I assigned people to closely monitor the rift.

text.cn: 小时候，父亲带我们走过这条路。
text.en: Dad used to take me along this path.

text.cn: 我也记得……他说总有一天会让这里充满花香……
text.en: He said a day would come when we have flowers here.

text.cn: 真没想到，我们也能坚持到最后。
text.en: We made it to this place. I can hardly believe it.

text.cn: 比起管理员一行人遇到的危险，这不算什么。
text.en: This is nothing compared to what Team Endmin faced.

text.cn: 我打算总结一下这次行动，写成论文……
text.en: I'm gonna write a paper about this operation.

text.cn: 我现在只想早点回去休息……
text.en: I just wanna hit the bunk and sleep...

text.cn: 我第一次看到那几位老前辈笑。
text.en: It's my first time seeing those old people smile.

text.cn: 别说你了，我也没见过。
text.en: My first time too, not gonna lie.

text.cn: 我也是第一次见你笑。
text.en: Is that a smile on your face? Never saw it before.

text.cn: 是吗？嗯……看来我和他们彼此彼此。
text.en: Really? Hmm. Maybe I'm one of the old people.

text.cn: 收复了北部禁区，庄天师能够喘口气了吧。
text.en: We reclaimed the EZ. Tianshi Zhuang should breathe easy now.

text.cn: 这多亏了管理员的助力啊。
text.en: We got the Endmin to thank.

text.cn: 还有些临时设施要搭建，动作快点。
text.en: I need the temporary facilities up! CHOP-CHOP!

text.cn: 先锋们的工作结束了，到我们使劲了。
text.en: The vanguards have done their work. Now it's our turn.

text.cn: 就等着这一刻呢！
text.en: I've been waiting for this!

text.cn: 这边干完，天师桩那里也需要搭建。
text.en: Finish up here. They need builders at the Tianshi Pillar.

text.cn: 我想写一封信……不，写两封……
text.en: I need to write a letter... No. I need to write two.

text.cn: 我是带着大哥的遗物来的，是它保佑了我。
text.en: I brought my brother's keepsake along. It kept me safe.

text.cn: 黎风说，不久后我们都能去找亲人的遗物了……
text.en: Lifeng said we'll get to find our families' belongings.

text.cn: 我……想帮你们一起。
text.en: I ... I wanna go with you.

text.cn: 其他人都累坏了，我得顶上。
text.en: Everyone's exhausted. I gotta keep going.

text.cn: 这次算你老实，我姑且放过你。
text.en: Since you behaved, I'm letting you go.

text.cn: 分明是抓不着我，谁怕你似的！
text.en: Oh yeah? It's totally cos you suck and can't catch me!

text.cn: 我想带回去一捧这里的土……
text.en: I want to bring some of this earth back home...

text.cn: 你父亲经常提起在这里的工作吗？
text.en: Did your father talk about his work here?

text.cn: 嗯，当他说起研究时，总是两眼放光……
text.en: Yeah. His eyes would sparkle when the talk gets scientific.

text.cn: 就像你刚才那样？
text.en: Just like you, right?

text.cn: 我……有吗？
text.en: Me? My eyes can sparkle?

text.cn: 禁区地下还有不少侵蚀物质渗透和残留。
text.en: The EZ has serious Blight percolation and residual buildup.

text.cn: 想重建这里，先得处理好这个问题。
text.en: We gotta handle these problems to rebuild this place.

text.cn: 之前庄管代提过天师桩阵列的方案……
text.en: Viceroy Zhuang proposed another Tianshi Pillar Array.

text.cn: 那可是个大工程啊。
text.en: That will take forever to build.

text.cn: 那就更得早点规划了。
text.en: That means we better start early.

text.cn: 压哨送达，终于能挪开这些东西了。
text.en: Right on time. We can finally move this stuff away.

text.cn: 终末地的技术有点意思……
text.en: Endfield tech is pretty interesting.

text.cn: 我看到了，回收装置快抵达了！
text.en: I saw it. The salvager is almost here!

text.cn: 真有人能在侵蚀瘴中活动吗？连应龙都……
text.en: Can anyone move in the Miasma? Even the Yinglungs...

text.cn: 那可是诀队长和终末地。
text.en: We're talking about Captain Arcane and the Endmin.

text.cn: 侵蚀瘴就那么消失了……枢壤仪太神奇了。
text.en: The Miasma just disappeared. The Xiranite Nexus is amazing.

text.cn: 管理员又不是第一次打破人们认知了。
text.en: The Endmin has surprised us all. Again.

text.cn: 如果管理员能早点来……那就好了……
text.en: If only the Endmin arrived sooner... It'd be so awesome.

text.cn: 看，是管理员！还有佩丽卡监督！
text.en: Look, it's the Endmin! And Supervisor Perlica!

text.cn: 救命恩人！终于又见面了！
text.en: Our heroes! We finally meet again!

text.cn: 请二位替我们向柯烈科医生道谢，我欠他一条命……
text.en: Pass my gratitude to the Surgeon Korlek. He saved my life.

text.cn: 我们都欠他一条命。
text.en: He saved all of our lives.

text.cn: 他是我见过的最有责任感的医生。
text.en: No med officer matches his professionalism.

text.cn: 我已经重复过很多次同样的话了……
text.en: I've said this so many times already...

text.cn: 但我们的担忧也是合理的啊！
text.en: But we got our right to be concerned!

text.cn: 没错，我们根本不知道你们在暗中捣鼓什么。
text.en: Yeah! We got no idea about your secret projects!

text.cn: 回去告诉别人，来这儿领救灾物资。
text.en: Just tell the others to claim disaster relief supplies here.

text.cn: 真不该误会终末地……
text.en: Why are they so suspicious of Endfield?

text.cn: 幸亏管理员做了解释。
text.en: Thank you for clearing up things for us, Endmin.

text.cn: 太过分了……
text.en: They've gone too far...!

text.cn: 该死的裂地者……
text.en: It's those damn breakers...

text.cn: 必须得做完……
text.en: We gotta get it done...

text.cn: 扫描一下看看是不是有隐藏讯息？
text.en: Scan it to check for hidden clues.

text.cn: 我们一定能调查清楚这个大阴谋！
text.en: We'll reveal the truth of this evil scheme!

text.cn: 如果那些胶棉炸药落到裂地者手里……
text.en: If the LBs seize those gel-cotton explosives...

text.cn: 那么高那么远……我怎么有点发怵呢……
text.en: This height ... and this distance... Honestly, I'm a little nervous.

text.cn: 疼……好疼啊……
text.en: It hurts ... it really hurts...

text.cn: 这开拓区，老子真是一辈子都不来了……
text.en: Blasted frontiers... I'm never coming back here again...

text.cn: 这……这都什么事啊……
text.en: What ... on Talos ... is going on?

text.cn: 我们门德斯工业可是最靠谱的……
text.en: You can definitely count on Mendez Manufacturing.

text.cn: 克莱韦思才是双赢的选择……
text.en: It's a win-win if you choose Clavis.

text.cn: 相信管理员的判断。
text.en: I have faith in your choice, Endmin.

text.cn: 我……不能再往里面走了。
text.en: I ... I can't go any further.

text.cn: 药品和物资是目前最迫切需要的……
text.en: We're desperately in need of meds and supplies...

text.cn: 接下来可以从运输线路着手……
text.en: We can focus on the transport route...

text.cn: 天呐！原来是管理员在这里！
text.en: Wow! The Endmin is here!

text.cn: 一定要找到米娅……
text.en: I gotta find Mia...

text.cn: 暗门的开关应该就在附近……
text.en: The switch for the secret door should be nearby...

text.cn: 那个小房间里可能有钥匙……
text.en: The key might be in that small room...

text.cn: 这铁门，还有没有别的办法？
text.en: Perhaps we can do something else about this iron gate?

text.cn: 搓个“热指头”就能把他们救出来。
text.en: Make a hot finger and I'll get them out.

text.cn: 哥哥，我再也不会乱跑了……
text.en: I won't run away again...

text.cn: 我会好好保护你的……
text.en: I'll always keep you safe...

text.cn: 我昨晚做了个噩梦，又梦见了那些裂地者……
text.en: I had a nightmare last night. I dreamed of those breakers...

text.cn: 别说了别说了，刚回家，干嘛再想那些可怕的事情……
text.en: Stop! We got home. Leave it all behind us.

text.cn: 一提那个又暗又冷的地方，我汗毛都竖起来了。
text.en: Just thinking about that place is giving me the shivers.

text.cn: 被关着的时候，我也梦见过逃出来。
text.en: I dreamed of escaping when I was locked in there.

text.cn: 结果一觉醒来，发现自己还在笼子里。
text.en: I woke up ... and found myself still locked in there.

text.cn: 说不定我们其实根本就没有获救。
text.en: Maybe we were never freed.

text.cn: 现在的好日子只是在梦里……
text.en: All this good, happy stuff I'm seeing ... is just a dream...

text.cn: 别——说——了！那我宁愿一辈子都别醒过来！
text.en: STOP IT! If this is a dream, then I hope I never wake!

text.cn: 你这是什么东西？
text.en: What's this?

text.cn: 是那个叫弧光的姑娘教我做的。
text.en: Miss Arclight taught me to make this.

text.cn: 你知道那个姑娘是哪儿来的吗？
text.en: Do you know where Miss Arclight is from?

text.cn: 她好像是众生长地的“游人”，居无定所的。
text.en: She's a nomad Songseeker of the Hannabit Circuit.

text.cn: 要赶紧把东西找回来……
text.en: Best hurry, my good people, and recover the lost cargo...

text.cn: 二，四，六……还不够……
text.en: Two, four, six... There should be more...

text.cn: 即便是一个罐头，也不能放弃。
text.en: No tins left behind. Not even one.

text.cn: 这下我怎么跟人交代啊！
text.en: I'm in super deep trouble right now!

text.cn: 居然变成这样了……
text.en: Now that's unexpected...
Uh...

text.cn: 不愧是我……
text.en: Only I could have pulled this off...

text.cn: 那个环塔商会的记者到底要搞什么……
text.en: What is that Bander journalist trying to do here...?

text.cn: 总之，先找找线索吧。
text.en: Well, let's look around for clues.

text.cn: 放我出去！我、我不会再逃了！真的！
text.en: Let me out! I won't run off again! I promise!

text.cn: 詹娜女士，管理员说你可以尝尝这道菜，也很好吃的！
text.en: Miss Jenner, the Endmin said you can try this! It's good!

text.cn: 管理员说的？好吧，那我就尝一下……
text.en: The Endmin did? Sure. I'll take a bite...

text.cn: 先堵住这边……别让她过去……
text.en: Plug this gap... Don't let her through...

text.cn: 唉，詹娜奶奶怎么会……
text.en: Oh dear, what happened to Granny Jenner?

text.cn: 没想到她连马特维都认不出了……
text.en: She didn't even recognize Matvei...

text.cn: 她最后的时光，应该是没有遗憾的……
text.en: I believe she moved forward, and had no regrets...

text.cn: 詹娜奶奶……我、我还没能报答你……
text.en: I ... I couldn't repay you, Granny Jenner...

text.cn: 她竟然是我们这几个老家伙里走得最早的……
text.en: Can't believe Jenner's the first veteran to move on...

text.cn: 我才刚改良完那道黄油羽兽……詹娜女士……
text.en: I just upgraded the butter fowl ... but Miss Jenner's...

text.cn: 这也……太突然了……
text.en: This is just ... too unexpected...

text.cn: 明明昨天还看见她了……怎么会就……唉……
text.en: I just saw her yesterday... This is so sudden... How...?

text.cn: 当初他们来抓人时，我就在那儿……那位女工友喊得整个谷地都听见了。
text.en: I was there during the arrest... That crew mate was shouting so loud the entire Valley could hear her.

text.cn: 现在大家都在猜是谁……再这样下去，迟早要出事。
text.en: Everyone's guessing who they are... Something's bound to happen if this goes on.

text.cn: 要怎么才能帮上你呢……
text.en: What can I do to help you...?

text.cn: 小灰……
text.en: Gray-Gray...

text.cn: 小、小灰？你感觉怎么样啦？
text.en: Gray-Gray? How are you feeling?

text.cn: 唔，是又晕乎乎了吗……
text.en: Oooh. Are you feeling dizzy again...?

text.cn: 没关系，打起精神就好！
text.en: Don't worry. You'll get better soon!

text.cn: 这绝对是第一手资料……
text.en: This is definitely first-hand data...

text.cn: 哼哼，我一定会让他们刮目相看的！
text.en: Hurhur. I'll show them some hard science this time!

text.cn: 都结束了吗……简直跟做梦似的……
text.en: Is this really the end...? It felt like a dream to me...

text.cn: 小灰好像突然就不困了……好神奇！
text.en: Gray-Gray isn't tired all of a sudden... It's like the Arts!

text.cn: 不……我的研究……不……
text.en: No... My research project... Noooo...

text.cn: 唔……在那边啊……
text.en: Huh... Over there...

text.cn: 好饿啊，那几个人真靠谱吗……
text.en: Man, my stomach is growling. Can we really count on them...?

text.cn: 不像我，从一而终，初心不改……
text.en: Unlike me ... I've always stayed true to my dream.

text.cn: 我年轻的时候有这么活泼吗……
text.en: Was I ever this lively when I was young...?

text.cn: 看来今年也没希望了。
text.en: Looks like graduation isn't happening for you this year either...

text.cn: 这比赛，听上去有点意思。
text.en: This competition ... sounds interesting.

text.cn: 不好办啊，两边都是邻居……
text.en: This is a real dilemma... Both of them are neighbors...

text.cn: 老师他吉人自有天相……一定会平安无事……
text.en: Mr. Mo has been lucky all his life. He should be alright.

text.cn: 不处理掉这些侵蚀，田地都会被破坏！
text.en: Gotta de-blight this mess before every field gets ruined!

text.cn: 老师曾在这里工作过，可能还有其他线索。
text.en: Mr. Mo used to work here. We might find something useful.

text.cn: 希望老师留下了什么线索……
text.en: I really hope Mr. Mo did leave something here...

text.cn: 师姐……老师那次失败后，就像丢了魂一样……
text.en: Chun He... That failure sucked the soul out of Mr. Mo...

text.cn: 我觉得……你的离开对他才是最大的打击……
text.en: But your departure ... did worse ... it crushed him...

text.cn: 几位恩人，我们在老师的旧居会合吧。
text.en: Let's meet at Mr. Mo's old residence.

text.cn: 恩人们，我会先去安思园等你们……
text.en: Heroes, I'll wait for you at Serenity Garden...

text.cn: 我会再去一趟老师家，那儿还有他的研究……
text.en: I must head back to Mr. Mo's home for his research...

text.cn: 得好好准备一下……
text.en: Gotta get ready for this...

text.cn: 希望杜鸣哥平安……
text.en: I hope Brother Du Ming is safe...

text.cn: 偏偏是腿伤了，不然真想跟你们一起……
text.en: Damn my leg wound. I could've joined the rescue team.

text.cn: 杜兄弟……他讲的祖泉仙人的故事老有趣了。
text.en: Brother Du has an interesting story of the Spring Sage.

text.cn: 哈……哈……都不是我的对手！
text.en: Hur... hur... None of you can stand against me!

text.cn: 仔细观察一下？或许……
text.en: We can try looking closely. Maybe...

text.cn: 我本泉中客，今日方得真……
text.en: Patron of the Spring was I, now the very truth is mine...

text.cn: 这回……就是最后一次了……
text.en: This ... is definitely the last time...

text.cn: 作为纪念，给水竹铃拍张照吧。
text.en: Take a photo of the bamboo water chimes as a special memento.

text.cn: 俺的眼罩……到底掉哪儿去了……
text.en: My eye mask... Where did it go?

text.cn: 呼噜噜……呼噜噜……
text.en: *Snore*... *snore*...

text.cn: 工作再忙，也别忘了体检！
text.en: Do not skip your health examination! Busy is not an excuse.

text.cn: 希望他们都没事……
text.en: I hope everyone's alright...

text.cn: 好人总是命不长。
text.en: Good people never live long.

text.cn: 他们都是英雄。
text.en: Heroes. All of them.

text.cn: 原来是阿构啊……
text.en: Isn't this Ah Gou...?

text.cn: 唉……姜天师从来没有怪过他们呀……
text.en: *Sigh*... Tianshi Jiang never blamed them for anything...

text.cn: 现在才当上见习巡卫，也不算迟吧……
text.en: I guess it's never too late to be a trainee watchguard...

text.cn: 今天我们可得好好喝一杯！
text.en: I say we celebrate this day with some drinks!

text.cn: 以茶代酒吧，公务期间不便饮酒。
text.en: How about tea? I can't drink kohl while on duty.

text.cn: 那就去武陵城，好好品一品新上的春茶。
text.en: Sure. Let's head to Wuling for some quality spring tea.

text.cn: 定位上显示就在附近……
text.en: The signal's showing ... right around here.

text.cn: 这里这里！
text.en: Over here!

text.cn: 要用液化重息壤才行……
text.en: We need Liquid Heavy Xiranite...

text.cn: 小陆真是长大了啊！
text.en: Lulu really grew up!

text.cn: 接下来应该升级哪些部件呢？
text.en: What's the next component to upgrade?

text.cn: 不知道那些溜进去的家伙都干了什么……
text.en: I wonder what those sneaks are up to...

text.cn: 我受了点伤，麻烦你们先行开路。
text.en: I got a little bruised. Just go ahead. I'll catch up soon.

text.cn: 泰拉的宝贝，我来了！
text.en: Treasures of Terra, here I come!

text.cn: 让我找找，属于哥伦比亚的技术宝藏……
text.en: Gotta find all the Columbian tech treasures...

text.cn: 呼，原来吹笛子，比书里写的累多了啊……
text.en: Hoo. Playing the flute is harder than what I read from the manual...

text.cn: 看来要做的练习还不少。
text.en: I seem to need a lot more practice.

text.cn: 沈海大叔，这边的食材都整理好了。
text.en: Uncle Shen Hai, I've prepped the ingredients on this side.

text.cn: 哦，辛苦辛苦。
text.en: Oh, nice! Thanks a lot.

text.cn: 先歇会儿吧，给你尝尝我的手艺。
text.en: Go take a break. I'm making you a feast.

text.cn: 这里应该就是他生前工作的地方……
text.en: This is where he worked when he was still around...

text.cn: 现在我证明自己了，可你们，你们去哪儿了！
text.en: I proved myself! WHERE ARE YOU? COME OUT!

text.cn: 当初他们是用命来填的口子……
text.en: They paid dearly with their lives to seal this...

text.cn: 原本这里的东西……都没了。
text.en: Everything here ... is gone.

text.cn: 这里最后发生的超域活动现象……一定骇人。
text.en: The last throes of Æther must've been terrible to behold.

text.cn: 当初说好的做一辈子的朋友！结果……
text.en: What happened to best friends for life...?

text.cn: 你们就这样走了十年……
text.en: And then everyone left for ten years...

text.cn: 为什么那天留在这里的是你，而不是我？
text.en: I should be the one here on that day, not you...

text.cn: 老师，学生无能，没能实现你的设计。
text.en: My mentor, I still couldn't achieve that design of yours.

text.cn: 但你指出了正确的路……
text.en: But you pointed out the true path...

text.cn: 得留心物品上沾染的超域能量……
text.en: Watch out for residual Æther on the items...

text.cn: 这些是什么？刚搬过来的？
text.en: What are these? Did someone just move them here?

text.cn: 帮把手，别让这些杂物挡道！
text.en: Got a hand? Move these things out of the way!

text.cn: 要让这里恢复到当初的模样……
text.en: Are we really going to restore this place?

text.cn: 不，要比过去更好。让逝者见证我们的进境。
text.en: No. We make it better. Our loved ones must see our progress.

text.cn: 要耐心，从这里找起吧……
text.en: Gotta be patient. I should start here...

text.cn: 哥哥一定在这里买过兵器……
text.en: My brother probably bought some weapons at this place.

text.cn: 爸爸以前就是在这里做研究的……
text.en: Dad used to do research work at this place...

text.cn: 当年小然的母亲曾在这里工作……
text.en: Xiao Ran's mom used to work here...

text.cn: 是这个吗……还是那个……
text.en: Is this it...? Hmm. Maybe it's that one.

text.cn: 爸爸妈妈，请保佑我找到你们的踪迹……
text.en: Mom ... Dad... please lead me to you...

text.cn: 他们无愧于天师之名……
text.en: They have proved their worth as Tianshi...

text.cn: 这份情，我会记一辈子……
text.en: I shall remember what you did for us for the rest of my life...

text.cn: 愿他们始终伴你同行……
text.en: May they walk with you, always...

text.cn: 爸爸，妈妈……
text.en: Mom, Dad...

text.cn: 十年不见，这棵树还是这么大，就没变过。
text.en: Ten years passed but this tree is as big as ever.

text.cn: 我们倒是老了。
text.en: We got older, though.

text.cn: 我听说，管理员已经出发去应龙关了。
text.en: I heard the Endmin has left for Yinglung Pass.

text.cn: 真的？那我们是不是很快就能回去了？
text.en: Really? That means we'll be back home soon, right?

text.cn: 太好了，爸爸妈妈……
text.en: Awesome! My Mom and Dad...

text.cn: 爸爸，妈妈，你们知道吗……
text.en: Mom, Dad, do you know what happened...?

text.cn: 霜露既降，仰见明月……
text.en: In frost and dew, the bright moon hangs in the heavens...

text.cn: 呼，该继续任务了。
text.en: Hoo. Gotta get back to my mission.

text.cn: 阿生，看起来，你的心情不错嘛。
text.en: Ah Sheng, you look happy today.

text.cn: 哈哈，我刚才见到我哥了。
text.en: Hah! I just met my brother, you know.

text.cn: 看，这是他的信物。
text.en: Look, I found his keepsake.

text.cn: 不错嘛。等等，我记得你哥不是……
text.en: Not bad. Wait, didn't your brother...

text.cn: 老田，正言，贺姐，阿绾……
text.en: Old Tian, Zhengyan, Big Sis He, Ah Wan...

text.cn: 是他们的在天之灵保佑着我们……
text.en: Their spirits are looking out for us.

text.cn: 当初半途丢下的实验，终于有机会做完了。
text.en: Finally! Time to finish the projects we left undone.

text.cn: 实验报告就交给我来写吧。
text.en: I can definitely write the research papers.

text.cn: 爸爸……
text.en: Dad...

text.cn: 嘶——呜呜呜呜……嘶嘶嘶——哇啊……
text.en: Ssss — Hik hik... Ssss — WAAAAHHH...

text.cn: 当时如果我在的话……就能把你们都救出来。
text.en: If I were here ... I would've rescued the lot of you.

text.cn: 但是……但是……为什么！为什么会这样！
text.en: But ... HOW ... WHY?! This wasn't supposed to happen.

text.cn: 单人行动……我的专长。
text.en: Solo action... My field of expertise.

text.cn: 我不能代表罗德岛发言，但我带来了罗德岛的态度。
text.en: Can't speak for Rhodes Island, but I relay their vibes.

text.cn: 终末地与罗德岛的合作可以为这片地区带来很多好处……
text.en: Rhodes Island plus Endfield will transform this region.

text.cn: 好巧呀，管理员！一起去舰桥散散步吧！
text.en: Endmin! What a coincidence! How about we take a stroll along the Bridge?

text.cn: 还在忙吗？管理员，要注意休息哦。
text.en: Busy, Endmin? Don't forget to take a break, okay?
Hi!

text.cn: 源石器械上的事都可以来找我，别的事也行。
text.en: I am open to questions related to Originium devices, in addition to other things.

text.cn: 很奇怪，一见到您，我的分享欲就格外强烈。
text.en: Curiously, your presence greatly amplifies my eagerness to share my vast knowledge.

text.cn: 你好。
text.en: Greetings.

text.cn: 要一起吃岩石千层蛋糕吗，前辈？
text.en: Professor, would you like to share this mille crêpe with me?

text.cn: 我正想找您呢，前辈。
text.en: Oh, I was just about to go look for you, Professor.

text.cn: 你好呀~
text.en: Good to see you!

text.cn: 你好啊，管理员。
text.en: Greetings, Endmin.

text.cn: 需要帮忙吗，管理员？我可以当你的护卫。
text.en: Need a hand, Endmin? I can be your defender!

text.cn: 你好啊！
text.en: Hi there!

text.cn: 是你呀，管理员，要去哪儿？
text.en: Hey, Endmin! How's it going?

text.cn: 你好啊，管理员，没有在躲着我吧？
text.en: Endmin, mate! Ace to see you! Not avoiding me, are ya?

text.cn: 嗨~
text.en: Hi!

text.cn: 有需要我的作战任务吗？
text.en: Do you have a combat mission that requires my presence?

text.cn: 欢迎回来，管理员。下一场战斗在哪里？
text.en: Welcome back, Endmin. Where will the next battle take us?

text.cn: 你好。
text.en: Greetings.

text.cn: 真忙呀，大英雄。
text.en: Busy day, huh, big hero?

text.cn: 又有多久没休息了？
text.en: When was the last time you actually rested?

text.cn: 你好呀~
text.en: Hey there!

text.cn: 有什么行动吗？
text.en: Any orders?

text.cn: 有什么行动吗？
text.en: Any orders?

text.cn: 管理员。并非巧遇，我在等你。
text.en: Endmin, this meeting was no coincidence. I've been waiting.

text.cn: 管理员。并非巧遇，我在等你。
text.en: Endmin, this meeting was no coincidence. I've been waiting.

text.cn: 你好。
text.en: Good day.

text.cn: 你好呀，管理员。要陪我练练剑吗？
text.en: How are you doing, Endmin? Interested in sparring with me?

text.cn: 哎呀，管理员，剩下的还是交给我吧。劳逸结合！
text.en: Just leave the rest to me, Endmin. Go enjoy a breather — you've earned it!

text.cn: 嘿~
text.en: Heeey!

text.cn: 有空陪您撮顿好的！
text.en: Once you have time, I'll throw a feast for you!

text.cn: 要是帝江号的伙食吃腻味了，您随时招呼我！
text.en: Hungry for something not offered in the Dijiang cafeteria? I can help.

text.cn: 呦呵！
text.en: Hiya!

text.cn: 哟，又见面了，今天工作怎么样？
text.en: Yo! I bump into you all the time. How's work today?

text.cn: 你不累吗？可以学我找个时间休息一下。
text.en: Boss, don't you feel tired? I can teach you how to sneak in a nap, you know.

text.cn: 嘿诶！
text.en: Hey there!

text.cn: 管理员，今天的风向如何？
text.en: Where do the winds hail from today, Endmin?

text.cn: 管理员，刚从外面回来吗？你身上有荒野的味道。
text.en: Coming back from a trip on the surface, Endmin? You smell of the wildlands.

text.cn: 你好。
text.en: Good day.

text.cn: 好巧，管理员，您也刚出完任务吗？
text.en: Small world, Endmin! You just wrapped up a mission as well?

text.cn: 管理员，要我帮你煮一壶热咖啡吗？
text.en: Coffee break, Endmin? I can whip up a fresh pot for you!

text.cn: 您好！
text.en: Greetings!

text.cn: 啊，你在这里。
text.en: Ah, here you are.

text.cn: 是你……别误会，我没在特意等你。
text.en: It's you... Oh, I wasn't waiting for you specifically.

text.cn: 说吧。
text.en: I'm listening.

text.cn: 管理员？！您、您好呀……
text.en: Endministrator?! H-ho-how are you...?

text.cn: 有需要帮忙的吗，管理员？
text.en: Need help with anything, Endmin?

text.cn: 你、你好……
text.en: H-hi there...

text.cn: 管理员，你好忙啊！好难得见你一回！
text.en: Hi Endmin! You look tied up, but it's good to see you.

text.cn: 管理员有空吗？我学了个新招，给你看看！
text.en: Got a sec, Endmin? I've picked up a new move. Wanna check it out?

text.cn: 你好啊！
text.en: Hey, how are you?

text.cn: 管理员，你好呀！要陪我去看演出场地吗？
text.en: Endmin! Care to join me? I'm about to scout some venues.

text.cn: 管理员，你好呀！要陪我去看演出场地吗？
text.en: Endmin! Care to join me? I'm about to scout some venues.

text.cn: 我正找你呢，管理员！快来听我的新歌小样！
text.en: There you are, Endmin! Come listen to my new demo!

text.cn: 我正找你呢，管理员！快来听我的新歌小样！
text.en: There you are, Endmin! Come listen to my new demo!

text.cn: 你好。
text.en: Hiya.

text.cn: 终于有空了吗？管理员。
text.en: Finally got a moment, Endmin?

text.cn: 终于有空了吗？管理员。
text.en: Finally got a moment, Endmin?

text.cn: 远远地就看到你了，有什么新情报吗？
text.en: Saw you from a distance. Any new intel?

text.cn: 远远地就看到你了，有什么新情报吗？
text.en: Saw you from a distance. Any new intel?

text.cn: 你好。
text.en: Greetings.

text.cn: 管理员，您好，又有新任务了吗？
text.en: Greetings, Endmin. Is there another assignment?

text.cn: 管理员，我又整理了十卷Z7的作战总结，要看看吗？
text.en: Endmin, I've compiled ten folders of post-battle summaries for Team Z7. Do you wish to review them?

text.cn: 你好。
text.en: Greetings.

text.cn: 嘿，来了啊！
text.en: Yo, you're here!

text.cn: 嘿，来了啊！
text.en: Yo, you're here!

text.cn: 忙着呢？好久没跟你过过招了。
text.en: Busy? It's been a while since we last sparred.

text.cn: 忙着呢？好久没跟你过过招了。
text.en: Busy? It's been a while since we last sparred.

text.cn: 你好。
text.en: Greetings.

text.cn: 适应得还好吗，管理员？
text.en: How are you holding up, Endministrator?

text.cn: 管理员，注意休息，不要勉强自己。
text.en: Don't push yourself too hard, Endministrator. Keep yourself rested and well.

text.cn: 你好。
text.en: Greetings.

text.cn: 你好，管理员，又来巡视了吗？
text.en: Greetings, Endministrator. Here for another inspection tour?

text.cn: 向你致敬，管理员。
text.en: Salutations, Endministrator.

text.cn: 嗯。
text.en: Hmm.

text.cn: 愿您平安。
text.en: May peace and safety be with you.

text.cn: 管理员，您又出现在我的计算结果中了。
text.en: Endministrator, you appear once again in my calculated result.

text.cn: 您好……
text.en: Greetings...

text.cn: 黑面煞，我在这儿呢！
text.en: Darkmask, over here!

text.cn: 可别偷偷凑热闹不叫我哦！
text.en: Let me know if anything fun comes up. I don't wanna miss out!

text.cn: 哟！
text.en: Yo!

text.cn: 管理员……休息得怎么样？
text.en: Endmin... How goes your break?

text.cn: 难得看到管理员这么有空。
text.en: Endmin, I hardly see you taking a break.

text.cn: 嗯……你好。
text.en: Mmh ... hi.

text.cn: 管理员。
text.en: Endmin.

text.cn: 管理员，要我同行吗？我抽得出空。
text.en: Need me to tag along, Endmin? I can make time for you.

text.cn: 你好。
text.en: Hello.

text.cn: 管、管理员！今天有什么任务要交给我吗？
text.en: E-Endmin! Do you have any missions for me today?

text.cn: 管理员，可以传授我一些作为领导者的经验吗？
text.en: Endmin, could you share some leadership experience with me?

text.cn: 嘿！
text.en: Hey!

text.cn: 管理员，装备测试间今天我先预定了哦！
text.en: Endmin! I'm calling dibs on the equipment testing chamber. Thanks a lot!

text.cn: 最新一期的《MARTHE 月刊》到了，要一起看吗？
text.en: The latest issue of Monthly MARTHE just arrived. Wanna read it with me?

text.cn: 你好你好——
text.en: Hello, hello!

text.cn: 我正好要去实验室，顺路的话一起走？
text.en: I'm heading to the lab. Care to join me if it's on your way?

text.cn: 真巧，刚还说要去找你呢。
text.en: Lovely coincidence. I was just thinking of coming to see you.

text.cn: 您好。
text.en: Greetings.
